title.en: Trump doubles down on Canada trade war as talks remain stalled – US politics live
title.zh: 哈基姆·杰弗里斯誓言“严肃回应”，因两名众议院民主党人与共和党人投票

summary.en: House minority leader Hakeem Jeffries stated that the decision by two Democrats to advance a resolution condemning socialism represents a "significant breach of trust." This comes as US military forces resume strikes on Iran, and Donald Trump makes social media posts about his construction projects.
summary.zh: 众议院少数党领袖哈基姆·杰弗里斯表示，两名民主党人推进一项谴责社会主义的决议的决定“严重破坏了信任”。与此同时，美军恢复了对伊朗的打击，唐纳德·特朗普则在社交媒体上发布了关于他建筑项目的帖子。

body.en: Trump has imposed 50% tariffs on $20bn in Canadian goods and Canada threatened retaliatory tariffs starting 8 September Sign up for the US Breaking News email As tensions flare in the mideast with American military forces resuming strikes on Iran, Donald Trump has taken to social media to discuss his ballroom project. “We have hundreds of happy construction workers in D.C. busily doing their job building the finest Ballroom/Military complex anywhere in the World,” Trump said in a truth social post Wednesday morning. “There is nothing like it, and never will be! It was a long, hard, fight in the Court System, but the winner is, as always under ‘TRUMP,’ the U.S.A.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 众议院少数党领袖表示，两名民主党人决定推进谴责社会主义的决议，“代表着对信任的严重破坏”。随着美国军队恢复对伊朗的打击，中东局势紧张，唐纳德·特朗普在社交媒体上讨论了他的舞厅项目。特朗普周三早上在一篇真实的社交帖子中表示：“我们在华盛顿有数百名快乐的建筑工人正忙着建造世界上最好的宴会厅/军事综合体。” “没有什么比这更好的了，也永远不会有这样的事！这是法院系统中一场漫长而艰苦的斗争，但胜利者是一如既往，在‘特朗普’统治下的美国。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: Political maneuvering and party loyalty are tested when individuals cross lines. The principle of righteous rule, as described in Proverbs 16:12, calls leaders to govern with integrity and justice, ensuring that their actions build trust rather than fracture it. The breach of trust mentioned by Leader Jeffries underscores the importance of ethical conduct...
reflection.zh: 当个人跨越界限时，政治策略和党派忠诚将受到考验。箴言16:12所描述的公义统治原则，呼吁领导者以正直和公正来治理，确保他们的行为建立信任而非破坏信任。杰弗里斯领袖提到的信任破裂，凸显了道德行为在维持治理机构的稳定和功能方面的重要性。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: Epstein survivors urge billionaire Leon Black to cooperate with House panel
title.zh: 埃普斯泰因幸存者敦促亿万富翁莱昂·布莱克配合众议院小组调查

summary.en: More than a dozen survivors of Jeffrey Epstein’s abuse have urged billionaire Leon Black to appear before the House oversight committee to clarify his connections to the convicted sex offender. They released a letter calling for Black to comply with congressional subpoenas ahead of his deposition.
summary.zh: 十多名杰弗里·爱泼斯坦虐待案的幸存者敦促亿万富翁莱昂·布莱克出席众议院监督委员会的听证会，以澄清他与被定罪的性犯罪者的关系。他们发布了一封信，呼吁布莱克在接受众议院监督委员会的质询前遵守国会传票。

body.en: Black called on to comply with subpoenas and appear as required to clarify connections to convicted sex offender More than a dozen survivors of Jeffrey Epstein’s abuse have called on billionaire Leon Black to appear before the House oversight committee in order to clarify his connections to the late disgraced financier and convicted sex offender. In a letter released on Wednesday, the survivors urged Black to comply with congressional subpoenas ahead of Thursday’s deposition before the House oversight committee. Continue reading...
body.zh: 布莱克呼吁遵守传票，并按要求出庭澄清与已定罪的性犯罪者的关系杰弗里·爱泼斯坦性侵事件的十多名幸存者呼吁亿万富翁莱昂·布莱克出庭出席众议院监督委员会，以澄清他与已故名誉扫地的金融家和已定罪的性犯罪者的关系。在周三发布的一封信中，幸存者敦促布莱克在周四向众议院监督委员会作证之前遵守国会传票。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Survivors of profound abuse are calling for transparency and accountability from those connected to their abuser. This echoes the call for justice and ethical conduct, reminding us that true healing requires facing difficult truths and holding individuals responsible for their actions and associations.
reflection.zh: 遭受了深刻虐待的幸存者呼吁与施虐者有关联的人坦诚相待并承担责任。这呼应了对公正和道德行为的要求，提醒我们真正的疗愈需要面对艰难的真相，并追究个人行为和关联的责任。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

reflection.en: The news from Sydney is grim: a violent act has left a young person with a devastating injury. The cycle of violence, where harm begets more harm, is a tragic reality that leaves deep wounds, both physical and emotional. "Put your sword back in its place," Jesus told Peter, "for all who draw the sword will die by the sword." This incident serves as a stark...
reflection.zh: 悉尼传来的消息令人沮丧：一起暴力事件导致一名年轻人遭受了毁灭性的伤害。暴力循环，即伤害滋生更多伤害，是一个悲惨的现实，会留下身心俱疲的创伤。耶稣对彼得说：“收刀入鞘吧！因为凡动刀的，必死在刀下。”这起事件令人警醒地提醒我们，攻击性的道路是毁灭性的。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: Cassandra Wilson, Grammy-winning jazz singer, dies aged 70
title.zh: 卡桑德拉·威尔逊，格莱美获奖爵士歌手，享年70岁

summary.en: Cassandra Wilson, a two-time Grammy Award-winning jazz singer, songwriter, and producer, has died at the age of 70. Known for her genre-bending voice that spanned folk, pop, R&B, and country, she was once called 'America's best singer' by Time magazine in 2001.
summary.zh: 两届格莱美奖得主、爵士歌手、词曲作者兼制作人卡桑德拉·威尔逊（Cassandra Wilson）去世，享年70岁。她以跨越民谣、流行、R&B和乡村的音乐风格以及独特的嗓音而闻名，曾于2001年被《时代》杂志誉为“美国最棒的歌手”。

body.en: Mississippi-born Wilson, who worked across folk, pop, R&B and country, was once dubbed America’s best singer Cassandra Wilson, the two-time Grammy Award-winning jazz singer, songwriter and producer has died. She was 70. Dubbed America’s best singer by Time magazine in 2001, Wilson was best known for her genre-bending voice, which expanded the boundaries of traditional blues-based jazz and worked effortlessly across folk, pop, R&B, country and beyond. At the heart of all her work was her idiosyncratic contralto, a soulful sound distinctly tied to her roots. Continue reading...
body.zh: 出生于密西西比州的威尔逊，横跨民谣、流行、R&B 和乡村音乐，曾被誉为美国最佳歌手、两届格莱美奖得主、爵士乐歌手、词曲作者和制作人卡桑德拉·威尔逊去世。她现年 70 岁。 2001 年，威尔逊被《时代》杂志评为美国最佳歌手，她最出名的是她跨流派的嗓音，她的嗓音拓展了传统蓝调爵士乐的界限，轻松跨过民谣、流行、R&B、乡村等领域。她所有作品的核心是她独特的女低音，一种深情的声音，明显与她的根源紧密相连。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of Cassandra Wilson's passing at 70 reminds us of the universal truth that life is a precious, finite gift. Hebrews 9:27 speaks to this reality, stating that death is appointed for all humanity. Her rich musical legacy, however, continues to resonate, a testament to a life lived with creative passion.
reflection.zh: 卡桑德拉·威尔逊（Cassandra Wilson）去世的消息，享年70岁，提醒我们生命是宝贵且有限的恩赐这一普遍真理。《希伯来书》9章27节谈到这一现实，指出死是人类的定命。然而，她丰富的音乐遗产将继续流传，证明了她曾以充满创造力的热情度过一生。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: From 'Lake America' to 'Trump Strait': How the White House is renaming the globe
title.zh: 从‘美国湖’到‘特朗普海峡’：白宫如何重塑全球地名

summary.en: As the US president floats a new name for the Strait of Hormuz, Canadians are resisting his "Lake America" decree. President Trump suggested renaming the Strait of Hormuz to "Trump Strait" amid ongoing conflict with Iran, though he later implied he was not serious. This follows a pattern of the president renaming...
summary.zh: 在美国总统提出‘美国湖’的指令后，加拿大人正在抵制。美国总统特朗普在与伊朗的持续冲突中，建议将霍尔木兹海峡更名为‘特朗普海峡’，尽管他后来又暗示并非当真。这延续了他试图通过更改国际水域名称来挑衅他国的模式。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump has suggested renaming the Strait of Hormuz as "Trump Strait" during his ongoing war with Iran — before implying he wasn't serious just hours later.

Trump has made a series of geographical name changes to international bodies of water in his second term, at least partly with the aim of provoking others.

The latest suggestion came as Trump insisted the US had full control of the crucial waterway, even as fresh clashes continued there with Iran.

"Now that we have it under U.S.A. control, should we change the name Hormuz Strait to TRUMP STRAIT??? Like America itself, it would be 'hotter' than ever before!" Trump wrote on his Truth Social platform.

The White House later posted a map of the Gulf on social media with his suggested name, adding: "It's got a nice ring to it."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Trump has repeatedly threatened in recent weeks to claim sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz, even posting a map depicting the waterway as "new US territory".

"It was just thrown out there," Trump said with a chuckle after an Agence-France Presse news agency reporter asked him if he was serious.

But a number of the 80-year-old Republican's previous suggestions were dismissed as humorous before they came to pass.

Last week Trump signed an order renaming Lake Ontario as "Lake America" amid a trade war with neighbouring Canada, just days after apparently raising the idea in jest.

For local resident Liam Mooney, Lake Ontario will always be Lake Ontario. Now other Canadians who feel the same way can buy a baseball cap he's designed that pushes back at Trump's order.

It's not Mooney's first cap caper. Last year, the 40-year-old entrepreneur made a splash with a hat similar to the ubiquitous red cap of Trump's MAGA movement, emblazoned with the message "Canada is not for sale".

The move was inspired by Trump's repeated calls to make Canada the 51st US state. Sales soared after Ontario Premier Doug Ford wore it to a meeting with then-prime minister Justin Trudeau and other officials to discuss the brewing trade war with the United States.

Mooney began producing his new hat after Trump signed an executive order on the renaming. The new cap has "Lake Ontario" with a small maple leaf on the front and "Canada is not for sale" on the back.

"We've received several thousand orders at this time all around the world," Mooney told AFP. To him, the renaming is "absurd" and "extremely dangerous". Lake Ontario is "a shared responsibility" between the two countries and there should be mutual respect in how it is managed, he said.

Proceeds from hat sales will go to an organisation dedicated to protecting the lake, according...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在与伊朗持续的战争期间建议将霍尔木兹海峡重新命名为“特朗普海峡”，然后在几小时后暗示他不是认真的。 特朗普在第二个任期内对国际水域进行了一系列地名变更，至少部分是为了激怒其他国家。 最新的建议是在特朗普坚称美国完全控制这条重要水道之际提出的，尽管与伊朗的新冲突仍在继续。 “既然我们已将其置于美国控制之下，我们是否应该将霍尔木兹海峡改名为特朗普海峡？？？就像美国本身一样，它会比以往任何时候都‘更热’！”特朗普在他的“真相社交”平台上写道。 白宫后来在社交媒体上发布了一张海湾地图，上面写着他建议的名字，并补充道：“它听起来很漂亮。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 特朗普最近几周多次威胁要对霍尔木兹海峡宣示主权，甚至张贴了一张地图，将这条水道描绘成“新的美国领土”。 在法新社记者问他是否是认真的后，特朗普笑着说：“它就被扔在那里了。” 但这位 80 岁的共和党人之前提出的一些建议在付诸实施之前都被认为是幽默而被驳回。 上周，在与邻国加拿大的贸易战中，特朗普签署了一项将安大略湖更名为“美国湖”的命令，而就在几天前，特朗普显然是开玩笑地提出了这个想法。 对于当地居民 Liam Mooney 来说，安大略湖永远是安大略湖。现在，其他有同样想法的加拿大人可以购买他设计的棒球帽，以抵制特朗普的命令。 这并不是穆尼的第一次帽子戏法。去年，这位40岁的企业家因戴着一顶类似于特朗普MAGA运动中随处可见的红帽的帽子而引起轰动，帽子上印有“加拿大非卖品”的字样。 此举是受到特朗普多次呼吁让加拿大成为美国第51个州的启发。安大略省省长道格·福特 (Doug Ford) 穿着它出席与时任总理贾斯汀·特鲁多 (Justin Trudeau) 和其他官员的会议，讨论与美国酝酿的贸易战后，销量猛增。 在特朗普签署关于更名的行政命令后，穆尼开始生产他的新帽子。新帽子正面印有小枫叶“安大略湖”字样，背面印有“加拿大非卖品”字样。 穆尼告诉法新社：“目前我们已收到世界各地的数千份订单。”对他来说，更名是“荒谬的”和“极其危险的”。他说，安大略湖是两国之间的“共同责任”，其管理方式应该相互尊重。 据报道，帽子销售收入将捐献给一个致力于保护湖泊的组织。

reflection.en: The renaming of geographical features, especially in sensitive geopolitical areas like the Strait of Hormuz, can escalate tensions rather than foster understanding. The pursuit of peace requires careful diplomacy and respect for established names that carry historical and cultural weight, rather than actions intended to provoke.
reflection.zh: 重新命名地理特征，尤其是在霍尔木兹海峡这样的敏感地缘政治区域，可能会加剧紧张局势而非促进理解。追求和平需要谨慎的外交和对承载历史文化意义的既有名称的尊重，而不是采取旨在挑衅的行动。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Protests in Spain over government's handling of Ceuta migrant crisis
title.zh: 西班牙就休达移民危机处理不当问题爆发抗议

summary.en: Thousands protested across Spain over the government's handling of a migrant influx to the Spanish exclave of Ceuta. Opposition parties accuse Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez of abandoning Ceuta's residents, while the government claims right-wing parties are exploiting the crisis. A police report indicated Moroccan...
summary.zh: 西班牙各地爆发了数千人抗议，反对政府处理休达飞地移民涌入问题的方式。反对党指责首相佩德罗·桑切斯抛弃了休达的居民，而政府则声称右翼政党在利用这场危机。一份警方报告指出，摩洛哥安全部队在史无前例的涌入事件中表现出“完全的纵容”，这与桑切斯早些时候关于摩洛哥责任的说法相矛盾。

body.en:
Thousands of people have protested in cities across Spain over the government's handling of the influx of migrants to the Spanish exclave of Ceuta on the north African coast.

Spanish opposition parties accuse Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez of abandoning the residents of Ceuta, while the government says right-wing parties are exploiting the crisis.

On Wednesday a police report said Moroccan security forces showed "total permissiveness" during the unprecedented influx, days after Sánchez insisted Morocco was not responsible.

He has blamed trafficking gangs and online misinformation for encouraging people to cross the border. Morocco has denied orchestrating or being involved in the mass crossing.

At least 72,000 migrants crossed from Morocco into Ceuta on 30 and 31 July and although most have returned, as many as 5,000 remain in makeshift camps or scattered across the city's streets or on the beach - leading to unrest in the autonomous city in North Africa and a crisis for Sánchez.

There have been near-daily protests by locals, with demonstrators calling for the migrants to be sent back to their countries of origin or redistributed across Spain.

Wednesday's rallies were called by city councils across Spain where opposition parties - the conservative Partido Popular (PP) and the far-right Vox party - govern or have significant popularity.

PP leader Alberto Núñez Feijóo was at the rally in Madrid, where more than 50,000 people gathered, according to government figures.

"A Spanish city has been invaded, occupied and, unfortunately, this happened with the knowledge of the Government of Spain," he said.

Vox leader Santiago Abascal meanwhile said Sánchez was "at the service, like a lackey, of the Moroccan regime".

There was also a major rally in Ceuta itself, with participants chanting: "Ceuta is not for sale, Ceuta must be defended."

"The response has been inadequate, late and, to top it all, has involved a complete dereliction of duty on the part of the government," 45-year-old teacher David Hernandez told Reuters.

Pressure on Sánchez's government has intensified after Spanish media said the report submitted by the National Police's National Immigration and Borders Centre (CENIF) to the National Court pointed to the involvement of Moroccan gendarmes in the migrant crossings.

The police report claimed that the Moroccan police deployment around the border "was clearly smaller than usual" and cited migrants who spoke of a "passive attitude" as the crossings happened.

However the report did not categorically accuse Morocco of being behind the influx.

Morocco has a long-standing claim over Ceuta and its fellow autonomous city of Melilla, which have long been a flashpoint in diplomatic relations between the two countries.

body.zh: 数千人在西班牙各地城市抗议政府处理移民涌入北非海岸西班牙飞地休达的方式。 西班牙反对党指责总理佩德罗·桑切斯抛弃了休达居民，而政府则表示右翼政党正在利用这场危机。 周三，一份警方报告称，在桑切斯坚称摩洛哥不负有责任的几天后，摩洛哥安全部队在前所未有的涌入事件中表现出“完全纵容”。 他指责贩运团伙和网上错误信息鼓励人们越境。摩洛哥否认策划或参与大规模穿越。 7 月 30 日至 31 日，至少有 72,000 名移民从摩洛哥越境进入休达，尽管大多数人已经返回，但仍有多达 5,000 人留在临时营地或分散在该市的街道或海滩上 - 导致北非自治城市的骚乱和桑切斯的危机。 当地人几乎每天都会举行抗议活动，示威者呼吁将移民送回原籍国或在西班牙各地重新分配。 周三的集会是由西班牙各地的市议会召集的，这些反对党——保守的人民党（PP）和极右翼的 Vox 党——执政或拥有很高的支持率。 据政府数据显示，人民党领导人阿尔贝托·努涅斯·费霍 (Alberto Núñez Feijóo) 参加了马德里的集会，现场聚集了 50,000 多人。 他说：“一座西班牙城市遭到入侵、占领，不幸的是，这是在西班牙政府知情的情况下发生的。” 与此同时，Vox 领导人圣地亚哥·阿巴斯卡 (Santiago Abascal) 表示，桑切斯“像走狗一样为摩洛哥政权服务”。 休达本身也举行了一场大型集会，参与者高呼：“休达是非卖品，必须保卫休达。” 45 岁的教师戴维·埃尔南德斯 (David Hernandez) 告诉路透社，“反应不充分、迟到，最重要的是，政府完全失职”。 西班牙媒体称，国家警察国家移民和边境中心（CENIF）向国家法院提交的报告指出摩洛哥宪兵参与移民过境，桑切斯政府面临的压力加大。 警方报告称，摩洛哥在边境周围部署的警察“明显比平常少”，并援引移民的话说，他们在过境时表现出“消极态度”。 然而，该报告并没有明确指责摩洛哥是人口涌入的幕后黑手。 摩洛哥对休达及其同乡梅利利亚自治区长期以来一直拥有主权，这两个城市长期以来一直是两国外交关系的热点。 大量社会...

title.en: South African airline behind daring stadium stunt cancels next flyby
title.zh: 南非航空公司取消了下一次飞行表演，监管机构称其为大胆的体育场特技

summary.en: South Africa's civil aviation authority is investigating an aerial display that took place last Saturday and has confirmed that the airline responsible has cancelled a planned flyby for this weekend.
summary.zh: 南非民航局正在调查上周六举行的空中表演，并已确认负责的航空公司已取消了本周末的计划飞行。

body.en:
The South African airline behind a stunt which saw two planes flying in close formation low over a packed stadium, has cancelled a similar operation this weekend.

Airlink confirmed it had withdrawn its application for the display set to take place before South Africa's rugby match with New Zealand in Johannesburg on Saturday, citing a poor weather forecast.

The airline's flying feat divided opinion, with some labelling the startling manoeuvre reckless while others praised the precision and expertise.

It comes as the the country's aviation regulator said that while it had approved the application for the flyby, it was now reviewing the operation following "discussions in the media".

Footage of last weekend's air show before the start of the match in Cape Town was shared around the world.

Flight tracking website Flightradar24 said that according to its analysis "the lead aircraft passed less than 50ft (15m) above the top of the stadium".

From some angles the jets appeared very close to the roof of the DHL Stadium as they roared over amid coloured flare smoke.

The South African Civil Aviation Authority (SACAA) said on Wednesday it would review the incident.

"Following various discussions in the media relating to the events of the past weekend, the SACAA initiated compliance verifications, engaged the operator, obtained the Flight Data Recording downloads as well as other additional requirements," it said in a statement.

It also revealed a flight simulator to practice for the Saturday flight was used as part of the approvals process.

In a separate statement on Wednesday, the airline confirmed the display planned for the upcoming weekend would not go ahead.

"Although we have also heard the widespread enthusiasm for a flyby at FNB Stadium this weekend, the forecast weather points to unfavourable conditions for a safe formation flyby," CEO de Villiers Engelbrecht said.

He said last weekend's flights were performed with "approved and rehearsed safety altitude and speed limits for the flypast" and were conducted by a "highly experienced crew".

Airlink said that it had volunteered to provide the aircraft's digital flight data recordings following "unprecedented public interest" in the flyby.

The airline said it was "grateful for the enthusiastic appreciation" people had expressed in response, but also noted "the valid questions and concerns raised".

"We never intended to become the news or upstage Rugby's Greatest Rivalry," Engelbrecht added.

The flyby has been a feature at major sporting and presidential events in South Africa several times over the years - using both military jets and commercial airlines.
body.zh: 南非航空监管机构 SACAA 表示，上周六，南非航空公司进行了一次大胆的空中特技表演，两架飞机在拥挤的体育场上空以紧密编队低空飞行，该航空公司本周末已停止进行类似的行动。 Airlink 的飞行壮举意见不一，一些人认为这一令人震惊的动作是鲁莽的，而另一些人则赞扬了所展示的精确性和专业知识。 SACAA表示，虽然它已经批准了飞越的申请和安全措施，但在“媒体讨论”后，它现在正在进一步调查。 Airlink 尚未对周六的表演被取消的报道发表评论，该表演原定在索韦托的一个体育场上空进行。 上周末在开普敦举行的橄榄球比赛开始前的飞行表演片段在全世界传播，比赛双方是激烈的对手南非和新西兰。 航班跟踪网站Flightradar24表示，根据其分析，“领头飞机飞过体育场顶部不到50英尺（15m）”。 从某些角度看，这些喷气式飞机在彩色耀斑烟雾中呼啸而过，看起来非常靠近 DHL 体育场的屋顶。 该航空公司表示，这些飞行是在“经过批准和排练的飞越安全高度和速度限制”下进行的，并由“经验丰富的机组人员”进行。 但据 SACAA 称，Airlink 将不会重复飞越约翰内斯堡索韦托体育场的航班，该体育场正在举办跳羚队和全黑队之间的第三次决定性测试。 监管机构表示，虽然该公司遵循了所有正确的程序，但现在已经“获得了飞行数据记录下载以及其他附加要求”以进行进一步分析。 南非航空管理局在一份声明中表示，“南非航空管理局作为南非天空的安全网，向公众保证航空安全和安保合规始终至关重要，不容谈判”，强调了该国出色的航空安全记录。 多年来，这次飞越活动多次成为南非重大体育和总统活动的一大特色——使用军用飞机和商业航空公司。

reflection.en: The daring aerial maneuver over a packed stadium sparked immediate debate, with reactions ranging from condemnation to praise. This highlights how quickly public opinion can form, sometimes without full understanding. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that 'The first to speak in a dispute sounds convincing, until someone else comes and probes deeper.' In situations...
reflection.zh: 在挤满观众的体育场上空进行的惊险空中机动表演立即引发了争论，反应从谴责到赞扬不等。这凸显了公众舆论形成的速度之快，有时甚至没有完全理解。箴言 18:17 提醒我们：“在争讼的事上，先开口的似乎有理，但邻舍 Comes and 探究。”...

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: 'Like one family': Australia's Nepali community faces anxious wait for answers
title.zh: “像一家人”：澳大利亚尼泊尔社区焦急等待答案

summary.en: More than a week after deadly flash floods struck Nepal and Tibet, thousands of people remain missing, with Australian officials holding grave concerns for 38 citizens still unaccounted for.
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔和西藏发生致命的洪水灾害一个多星期后，仍有数千人失踪，澳大利亚官员对仍有38名澳大利亚公民下落不明表示严重关切。

body.en:
Australia's Nepali community remains hopeful for the welfare of loved ones missing in a cataclysmic flood that lashed the nation's border with Tibet one week ago.

Local officials fear many are buried under debris left by the floods that tore through towns and valleys near the ‌Chinese border, as the death toll reaches at least 1,204 people and more than 4,200 remain missing.

Authorities hold grave concerns for 38 Australians still missing in the flood impact zone despite five citizens being confirmed safe , the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) confirmed on Wednesday.

Rescuers are racing the clock in the search for survivors more than one week on from the disaster, but grieving community members in Australia continue to cling to hope.

"Lots of people are stuck in the tunnels over there as well, and most don't have any contact ... we are still hopeful that maybe we can get good news," Non-Resident Nepali Association Victorian co-ordinator Mahadev Dhanuk told Australian Associated Press (AAP).

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The association has raised almost $75,000 through community donations for relief efforts in the region as part of the Nepali Prime Minister's Disaster Relief Fund.

The tight-knit Victorian Nepali community of less than 30,000 is wrapping its arms around those affected by the tragedy, with hundreds uniting at a candlelight vigil in memory of the victims in Melbourne on Monday.

"Many are not personally affected, but culturally we feel like one family. That's why everyone is devastated," Dhanuk said.

"All of the community is trying to overcome their own plight and trying to help and think how can we stand with the Nepal?"

Five Australians had been confirmed safe by officials in Nepal and Tibet, while three others were located outside the crisis zone, the government said.

On the Sunshine Coast, community members are "doing everything they can" to rally around loved ones of missing disability support worker Renee Spry.

The Queensland mother of twin daughters was returning from the religious Mount Kailash pilgrimage, at an immigration centre near the Nepal-Tibet border, minutes before the catastrophic flood swept through the area.

"Every time we hear news of another person being found alive is a moment of extraordinary joy and relief," Sunshine Coast-based Opposition foreign affairs spokesman Ted O'Brien told AAP.

"We all, of course, on the Sunshine Coast then turn our minds to Renee and it is with hope that we think of her predicament."

The family of another missing Australian, Luke Costanzo, released a statement on Tuesday about the "unimaginably difficult situation" confronting them.

body.zh: 澳大利亚尼泊尔社区仍然对一周前袭击该国与西藏边境的灾难性洪水中失踪亲人的福祉充满希望。 当地官员担心，许多人被埋在中国边境附近城镇和山谷的洪水留下的废墟下，死亡人数至少达到 1,204 人，仍有 4,200 多人失踪。 外交和贸易部 (DFAT) 周三证实，尽管已确认 5 名公民安全，但仍有 38 名澳大利亚人在洪水影响区失踪，当局对此表示严重关切。 灾难发生一个多星期后，救援人员正在争分夺秒地寻找幸存者，但澳大利亚悲痛的社区成员仍然抱有希望。 “很多人也被困在那边的隧道里，大多数人都没有任何联系……我们仍然希望能得到好消息，”非居民尼泊尔协会维多利亚州协调员马哈德夫·达努克告诉澳大利亚美联社（AAP）。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 作为尼泊尔总理救灾基金的一部分，该协会已通过社区捐款筹集了近 75,000 美元用于该地区的救灾工作。 不到 30,000 人的紧密团结的维多利亚尼泊尔社区正在拥抱那些受悲剧影响的人，周一，数百人在墨尔本举行烛光守夜活动，悼念遇难者。 达努克说：“许多人个人并未受到影响，但从文化上来说，我们感觉就像一个家庭。这就是为什么每个人都感到震惊。” “所有社区都在努力克服自己的困境，并试图提供帮助，并思考我们如何才能与尼泊尔站在一起？” 政府表示，尼泊尔和西藏的官员已确认五名澳大利亚人安全，另外三人则位于危机地区之外。 在阳光海岸，社区成员正在“尽其所能”团结在失踪的残疾支持人员蕾妮·斯普里 (Renee Spry) 的亲人周围。 昆士兰州一位双胞胎女儿的母亲刚刚从尼泊尔-西藏边境附近的一个移民中心的冈仁波齐峰朝圣回来，几分钟后灾难性洪水席卷了该地区。 阳光海岸反对党外交事务发言人泰德·奥布莱恩 (Ted O'Brien) 告诉澳联社：“每次听到有人被发现生还的消息，我们都会感到无比的喜悦和宽慰。” “当然，阳光海岸的我们所有人都会把注意力转向蕾妮，我们满怀希望地想到她的困境。” 另一位失踪的澳大利亚人卢克·科斯坦佐的家人周二发表声明，讲述他们面临的“难以想象的困难局面”。 像斯普瑞一样，...

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet have left a community in Australia anxiously awaiting news of loved ones. In the face of such loss and uncertainty, the call to practical compassion resonates deeply. Sharing what we have—food, shelter, and comfort—is a tangible way to reflect Yahweh's love to those suffering.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏毁灭性的洪水灾害，让澳大利亚的一个社区焦急地等待着亲人的消息。面对如此的损失和不确定性，实际的怜悯呼召深刻地引起共鸣。分享我们所拥有的——食物、住所和安慰——是体现雅伟之爱给那些受苦之人的切实方式。

verse.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verse.textZh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？

title.en: Uber shuts operations in Nigeria and Uganda with immediate effect
title.zh: Uber 在尼日利亚和乌干达停止运营

summary.en: Ride-hailing giant Uber has ceased operations in Nigeria and Uganda with immediate effect, citing a difficult decision after a thorough business review. The company had been operating in Nigeria since 2014 and Uganda since 2016, facing challenges such as driver complaints about low prices and high commissions, and...
summary.zh: 打车巨头 Uber 即日起在尼日利亚和乌干达停止运营，称这是经过彻底业务审查后做出的“艰难决定”。该公司自 2014 年起在尼日利亚运营，自 2016 年起在乌干达运营，面临着司机对低价和高佣金的抱怨以及来自竞争对手的压力等挑战。此次退出紧随其去年退出科特迪瓦和坦桑尼亚的步伐，使其在非洲的运营国家所剩无几。

body.en:
The global ride-hailing giant said it had come to the "difficult decision" after a thorough review of its business. It began operating in Nigeria in 2014 and in Uganda two years later.

Uber taxi drivers in Nigeria have long complained that prices on the app are too low, given the rising cost of fuel, and that commission charges are too high. The company has also faced pressure from rival platforms.

The announcement came as Uber's chief executive, Dara Khosrowshahi, said the company was cutting its global workforce by 10%.

Over the last year, Uber has also pulled out of Ivory Coast and Tanzania. The latest announcement means Egypt, Ghana, Kenya and South Africa are the only African countries in which the firm now operates.

"This decision is limited strictly to these two markets and does not impact our operations across the rest of the continent," Uber's statement to the BBC said.

"We remain committed to sub-Saharan Africa, where we continue to see strong growth and opportunity."

Over its 12 years operating in Nigeria, Uber had expanded its services. In the commercial hub of Lagos, it launched a boat service in 2019 in an effort to help commuters bypass the city's notorious congestion.

Lagos, one of Africa's largest and busiest cities, is infamous for its long traffic jams that cause gridlock and hamper business activity.

Other ride-hailing taxi apps have launched in the West African nation over the last decade, including international competitors such as Bolt and inDrive, as well as a number of local operators.

But the Nigerian market has become increasingly challenging for them all, with drivers staging protests and industrial action in recent years over rising operating costs, low fares and working conditions.

The removal of Nigeria's fuel subsidy after President Bola Tinubu's election in 2023 saw the cost of living rise. The subsidy had kept down the price of petroleum products low for decades.

This year, motorists have been hit again by the rise in petrol prices following the US's war with Iran.

Uganda's Daily Monitor newspaper said Uber's departure would mean a major change for commuters in the capital, Kampala. But it said the void was likely to be filled by other taxi apps such as Faras, Bolt and SafeBoda.

Uber pledged to support employees and drivers affected by the decision and said its help centre would remain open for those in Nigeria and Uganda until 23 September to deal with outstanding issues.
body.zh: 这家全球网约车巨头表示，在对其业务进行彻底审查后，它做出了“艰难的决定”。该公司于 2014 年开始在尼日利亚运营，两年后又在乌干达运营。 尼日利亚的优步出租车司机长期以来一直抱怨，鉴于燃油成本不断上涨，该应用程序的价格太低，而且佣金费用太高。该公司还面临着来自竞争对手平台的压力。 这一消息发布之际，Uber 首席执行官达拉·科斯罗萨西 (Dara Khosrowshahi) 表示，该公司将在全球范围内裁员 10%。 去年，优步还退出了科特迪瓦和坦桑尼亚。最新公告意味着埃及、加纳、肯尼亚和南非是该公司目前开展业务的仅有的非洲国家。 Uber 在给 BBC 的声明中表示：“这一决定严格限于这两个市场，不会影响我们在非洲大陆其他地区的运营。” “我们仍然致力于撒哈拉以南非洲地区，在那里我们继续看到强劲的增长和机遇。” Uber 在尼日利亚运营 12 年来，不断扩大其服务范围。在拉各斯商业中心，该公司于 2019 年推出了轮船服务，以帮助通勤者绕过该市臭名昭著的拥堵状况。 拉各斯是非洲最大、最繁忙的城市之一，因其长期交通堵塞而臭名昭著，导致交通堵塞并阻碍商业活动。 过去十年来，这个西非国家也推出了其他叫车出租车应用程序，其中包括 Bolt 和 inDrive 等国际竞争对手以及一些当地运营商。 但尼日利亚市场对他们来说变得越来越具有挑战性，近年来，司机们因运营成本上升、票价低廉和工作条件而举行抗议和罢工行动。 2023 年总统博拉·蒂努布当选后，尼日利亚取消了燃料补贴，导致生活成本上升。几十年来，补贴一直将石油产品的价格压得很低。 今年，美国与伊朗战争后汽油价格上涨再次对驾车者造成打击。 乌干达《每日监测报》称，Uber 的退出将意味着首都坎帕拉的通勤者发生重大变化。但该公司表示，这一空白可能会被 Faras、Bolt 和 SafeBoda 等其他出租车应用程序填补。 Uber 承诺为受该决定影响的员工和司机提供支持，并表示其帮助中心将在 9 月 23 日之前继续向尼日利亚和乌干达的员工开放，以解决未决问题。

reflection.en: Uber's departure from Nigeria and Uganda marks the end of an era for the ride-hailing service in these markets. Such business decisions, often complex and driven by market realities, remind us of the need for wisdom and discernment in all endeavors. Committing our plans to Yahweh, as Proverbs 16:3 suggests, invites divine guidance, whether in launching new...
reflection.zh: Uber 退出尼日利亚和乌干达标志着该公司在这些市场的一个时代的结束。此类商业决策往往复杂且受市场现实驱动，提醒我们在所有事业中都需要智慧和辨别力。《箴言》16:3 建议我们将计划交托给雅伟，这邀请神圣的指引，无论是在启动新事业还是在做出艰难的退出决定时。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Watch: Jury still unable to reach unanimous decision in Lindsay Clancy case
title.zh: 观看：陪审团在林赛·克兰西案中仍无法达成一致裁决

summary.en: For the second time in two days, jurors have informed the judge that they cannot reach a unanimous verdict in the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, a mother accused of killing her three young children.
summary.zh: 陪审团在林赛·克兰西谋杀案审判中，已连续两天告知法官他们无法达成一致裁决。克兰西被指控杀害了她的三个年幼的孩子。

body.en:
For a second time in two days, jurors in the trial of Lindsay Clancy told the judge they could not agree on a verdict.

Clancy is a 36-year-old Massachusetts mother and former labour and delivery nurse who is on trial for the murder of her three young children in 2023. She is accused of strangling her kids - Cora, five, Dawson, three, and Callan, who was eight months - in their Massachusetts home.
body.zh: 林赛·克兰西审判中的陪审员在两天内第二次告诉法官，他们无法就判决达成一致。 克兰西是马萨诸塞州的一名 36 岁母亲，曾任助产护士，因 2023 年谋杀自己的三个孩子而受审。她被指控在马萨诸塞州的家中勒死自己的孩子——五岁的科拉、三岁的道森和八个月大的卡兰。

reflection.en: The persistent deadlock among jurors in the Lindsay Clancy trial underscores the profound difficulty of navigating complex legal and emotional terrain. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that 'The first to present his case seems right, till another comes and cross-examines him.' This highlights the need for careful consideration and the challenge of finding a...
reflection.zh: 在林赛·克兰西案的审判中，陪审团持续的僵局凸显了在复杂法律和情感困境中前行的艰巨性。《箴言》18:17 提醒我们：“先说话似乎有理，直到别人来盘问他。”这强调了在面对深刻的冲突观点和悲剧性结局时，审慎考量和寻找单一真相的挑战。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Israel and Türkiye are trading barbs over Syria. Could tensions escalate?
title.zh: 以色列和土耳其就叙利亚问题互相指责，紧张局势是否会升级？

summary.en: While outright war between Israel and Türkiye is currently unlikely, diplomatic tensions have escalated significantly following an Israeli airstrike on a Syrian airbase. Israel claimed the strike was to prevent Turkish forces from deploying there, a claim denied by Türkiye and Syria, with US intelligence finding no...
summary.zh: 尽管以色列和土耳其之间爆发全面战争的可能性不大，但在以色列袭击叙利亚一空军基地后，外交紧张局势显著升级。以色列声称此次袭击是为了阻止土耳其军队部署在那里，但土耳其和叙利亚对此予以否认，美国情报部门也未发现相关证据。这导致两国多年来最严厉的言辞交锋，双方领导人互相指责。

body.en:
When Israeli jets struck the Abu al-Duhur airbase in northern Syria on 18 August, Israel said the attack was meant to stop Turkish forces from deploying there to help rebuild Syria’s army.

United States intelligence found no evidence to support the claim, and Türkiye and Syria denied any such plan.

In the weeks since, Israel and Türkiye — the two countries with the most powerful militaries in the region — have traded their harshest words in years.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s office has branded Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan an "antisemitic tyrant", while Erdoğan has accused Israel of being a "terror state".

Israeli media also reported this week that Turkish warships have approached Israeli vessels in the Mediterranean Sea and forced them to change course.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Both governments say they do not want war. So, why are two close US allies — one a North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) member, the other a nuclear power — suddenly circling each other over Syria?

The tensions are tied to Syria’s collapse in late 2024 when a rebel army led by now-President Ahmed al-Sharaa overthrew dictator Bashar al-Assad’s regime.

Syria’s two powerful neighbours have since exploited this moment very differently: Türkiye has acted at the invitation of the Syrian authorities, while Israel has not. It therefore has no legal basis to police Syria’s territory or determine its security and political future.

When al-Sharaa came into power as Syria’s new leader, Türkiye became the main backer and military partner of his new government.

Türkiye undoubtedly wants a strong, unified state anchored to Ankara and has agreed to train and equip Syria’s army. Ankara has also stationed about 20,000 troops inside Syria, ostensibly to help maintain Syria’s territorial integrity and prevent attacks from Kurdish separatists over the border.

Turkish tensions with Israel did not begin over Syria. The countries’ relations began hardening in 2023 over Israel’s war in Gaza. Erdoğan called Israel’s campaign a genocide and joined South Africa’s case against Israel at the International Court of Justice. Türkiye also suspended trade with Israel over the war.

Israel, meanwhile, wants a Syria too weak and fragmented to threaten its northern frontier.

In the hours after al-Assad fell, Israeli aircraft destroyed much of what remained of Syria’s military. Israel has since pushed past the Syrian border to Mount Hermon, declaring southern Syria off-limits to the...
body.zh: 8 月 18 日，当以色列战机袭击叙利亚北部的阿布杜胡尔空军基地时，以色列表示，这次袭击的目的是阻止土耳其军队在那里部署，帮助重建叙利亚军队。 美国情报部门没有发现任何证据支持这一说法，土耳其和叙利亚也否认有任何此类计划。 此后几周，以色列和土耳其这两个该地区军事实力最强大的国家相互发表了多年来最严厉的言论。 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的办公室将土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安称为“反犹太暴君”，而埃尔多安则指责以色列是“恐怖国家”。 以色列媒体本周还报道称，土耳其军舰在地中海逼近以色列船只，迫使它们改变航向。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 两国政府均表示不希望发生战争。那么，为什么美国的两个亲密盟友——一个是北大西洋公约组织（NATO）成员国，另一个是核国家——突然在叙利亚问题上互相围攻？ 紧张局势与2024年底叙利亚的崩溃有关，当时现任总统艾哈迈德·沙拉领导的叛军推翻了独裁者巴沙尔·阿萨德的政权。 此后，叙利亚的两个强大邻国以截然不同的方式利用了这一时机：土耳其是应叙利亚当局的邀请采取行动的，而以色列却没有。因此，它没有法律依据来监管叙利亚领土或决定其安全和政治未来。 当沙拉作为叙利亚新领导人上台时，土耳其成为其新政府的主要支持者和军事伙伴。 土耳其无疑希望建立一个以安卡拉为基地的强大、统一的国家，并同意训练和装备叙利亚军队。安卡拉还在叙利亚境内驻扎了约2万名士兵，表面上是为了帮助维护叙利亚的领土完整，并防止库尔德分裂分子越过边境发动袭击。 土耳其与以色列的紧张关系并非始于叙利亚。 2023 年，两国关系因以色列加沙战争而开始紧张。埃尔多安称以色列的行动是种族灭绝，并加入了南非在国际法院针对以色列的诉讼。土耳其还因战争暂停了与以色列的贸易。 与此同时，以色列希望叙利亚过于虚弱和分裂，无法威胁其北部边境。 阿萨德倒台后的几个小时内，以色列飞机摧毁了叙利亚军队的大部分残骸。此后，以色列越过叙利亚边境到达赫尔蒙山，宣布叙利亚南部禁止进入……

reflection.en: The escalating rhetoric between Israel and Türkiye over actions in Syria illustrates a breakdown in communication and a dangerous increase in tension. In such moments, the call to 'live peaceably with all' becomes a profound challenge, urging a path away from verbal conflict towards seeking understanding, even amidst deep disagreement.
reflection.zh: 以色列和土耳其之间就叙利亚局势不断升级的言辞，凸显了沟通的破裂和危险的紧张局势加剧。在这样的时刻，“与众人和睦”的呼吁成为一个深刻的挑战，敦促人们在深刻分歧中寻求理解，远离言语冲突的道路。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Unity at last: Is Libya's damaging power struggle at an end?
title.zh: 终于团结：利比亚破坏性的权力斗争是否结束了？

summary.en: For over a decade, Libya has been divided between two opposing governments. Elections, intended to end the rivalry and unite the country, are now scheduled within two years.
summary.zh: 十多年来，利比亚一直分裂为两个对立的政府。旨在结束竞争并统一国家的选举现已定于两年内举行。

body.en:
For over a decade, Libya has been split between two opposing governments. Elections, meant to end the rivalry and unite the country, are now scheduled within two years.

There have been other attempts made in the past but this time, those involved hope it will finally work out: Thanks to mediation by the United Nations , the two opposing governments in the west and east of Libya have agreed that they will hold parliamentary and presidential elections within the next two years.

"The agreement marks an important step in advancing Libya towards national elections and ending the transitional period," the UN's Support Mission in Libya, or UNSMIL, said in a statement.

Among other things, the country's electoral commission will be restructured and, according to the UN, various points about the legal framework for the elections that had previously led to disagreements have now been resolved.

But whether all this will actually result in free and fair elections in Libya remains to be seen.

After former Libyan dictator Moammar Gadhafi was overthrown in 2011, Libya ended up divided in two.

Since 2014, the country has been split between opposing governments located in the east and west of the country. A UN-backed administration known as the Government of National Unity is based in Tripoli in the west, and its rival, known as the House of Representatives, is based in the east, in Tobruk.

Former warlord-turned-politician Khalifa Haftar, is based in the east while Prime Minister Abdul-Hamid Dbeibah is in charge in the west.

Each is supported by a number of local militias and foreign powers, and each has tried to wrest control from the other. Up until now, attempts to hold an election that would unite the country have failed.

For Andreas Dittmann, a geographic conflict expert and professor at the University of Giessen in Hesse, central Germany, the apparent unity is a positive .

After years of civil war and political division, the desire of many Libyans to end the fighting permanently has only grown. Dittmann believes the attitudes of political actors have also changed in this regard.

Previously foreign actors had supported just one Libyan government, but now that has also changed and the prevailing argument seems to be that Libya can only develop further if both sides are incorporated into one administration.

This is why the UN is trying to go beyond simply arranging a date for elections. It also wants to strengthen the electoral commission and work on electoral laws. The new and united government will be responsible for establishing the conditions for a secure and trusted electoral process . 

The UN has also set up what it calls "Structured Dialogues," during which consensus was...
body.zh: 十多年来，利比亚一直分裂为两个对立的政府。旨在结束竞争并团结国家的选举现在定于两年内举行。 过去也曾进行过其他尝试，但这一次，相关人士希望最终能够成功：在联合国的调解下，利比亚西部和东部的两个对立政府已同意在未来两年内举行议会和总统选举。 联合国利比亚支持团（联利支助团）在一份声明中表示：“该协议标志着推动利比亚走向全国选举和结束过渡期的重要一步。” 除其他事项外，该国的选举委员会将进行重组，根据联合国的说法，此前导致分歧的有关选举法律框架的各种问题现已得到解决。 但这一切是否真的会导致利比亚举行自由公正的选举还有待观察。 2011 年，前利比亚独裁者卡扎菲被推翻后，利比亚最终分裂为两部分。 自 2014 年以来，该国在东部和西部的对立政府之间分裂。联合国支持的政府，称为民族团结政府，总部位于西部的黎波里，其竞争对手，即众议院，总部位于东部托布鲁克。 前军阀出身的政治家哈利法·哈夫塔尔（Khalifa Haftar）驻扎东部，而总理阿卜杜勒·哈米德·德贝巴（Abdul-Hamid Dbeibah）负责西部。 每个国家都得到了一些当地民兵和外国势力的支持，并且每个国家都试图从对方手中夺取控制权。到目前为止，举行全国团结选举的尝试都以失败告终。 对于地理冲突专家、德国中部黑森州吉森大学教授安德烈亚斯·迪特曼 (Andreas Dittmann) 来说，表面上的团结是积极的。 经过多年的内战和政治分裂，许多利比亚人永久结束战斗的愿望有增无减。迪特曼认为，政治参与者的态度在这方面也发生了变化。 以前外国势力只支持利比亚一个政府，但现在情况也发生了变化，普遍的观点似乎是，只有双方都并入一个政府，利比亚才能进一步发展。 这就是为什么联合国不仅仅只是安排选举日期。它还希望加强选举委员会和选举法方面的工作。新的联合政府将负责为安全和可信的选举进程创造条件。 联合国还建立了所谓的“结构性对话”，在此期间达成了共识……

reflection.en: After more than ten years of division, the UN's mediation has brought Libya's opposing governments to an agreement for elections within two years. This marks a hopeful step towards national unity and an end to the prolonged conflict. May this fragile peace hold and lead to lasting stability for the Libyan people.
reflection.zh: 经过十多年的分裂，在联合国的斡旋下，利比亚的对立政府已达成协议，将在两年内举行选举。这标志着迈向国家团结和结束长期冲突的希望一步。愿这脆弱的和平得以维持，并为利比亚人民带来持久的稳定。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Macron visits Bayeux Tapestry with King Charles, PM Andy Burnham
title.zh: 马克龙与国王查尔斯、首相安迪·伯纳姆一同参观贝叶挂毯

summary.en: French President Emmanuel Macron began a two-day trip to the UK by viewing the 11th-century Bayeux Tapestry at the British Museum with King Charles III and Prime Minister Andy Burnham. The tapestry, on loan from France, is 70 meters long. King Charles described the loan as a 'precious symbol of trust' between the UK...
summary.zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙开始为期两天的英国之行，他在大英博物馆与英国国王查尔斯三世和首相安迪·伯纳姆一同参观了11世纪的贝叶挂毯。这幅挂毯是法国的借展品，长70米。查尔斯国王称此次借展是英法之间“信任的宝贵象征”。

body.zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙 (Emmanuel Macron) 对英国的访问时间比著名的租借的 11 世纪挂毯要短。他与英国君主和新任首相安迪·伯纳姆一起参观了这些古代艺术品。 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙开始了为期两天的英国之行，与国王查理三世和首相安迪·伯纳姆一起参观了另一位来自法国的著名新来者贝叶挂毯。 马克龙和他的妻子布丽吉特、伯纳姆和他的妻子玛丽-弗朗斯·范·希尔与查尔斯国王和卡米拉王后一起走过大英博物馆 70 米长的挂毯。 查尔斯称赞这笔“史无前例的贷款”是英国和法国之间“信任的宝贵象征”，而马克龙则表示两国“就像艺术品中的线一样亲密”。 这幅挂毯描绘了 1066 年诺曼底征服者威廉夺取英国王位的重大事件，是从其通常所在地法国临时借出的。自 11 世纪诞生以来，这是它首次踏入英国土地。 这些刺绣品已被租借用于下周（即 9 月 10 日）向公众开放的为期 10 个月的展览。此次交换是在去年马克龙进行国事访问期间首次宣布的。 尽管人们认为它是在不列颠群岛制造的，但它自 11 世纪以来就一直在法国土​​地上生产。它通常在法国北部诺曼底的贝叶展出，因此得名。这件实际上无价的文物于七月秘密穿越英吉利海峡。 六周前上任的总理伯纳姆称挂毯的回归是两国历史上的“一个里程碑式的时刻”。 周三，他还在下议院普遍赞扬了与马克龙法国政府的关系，暗示减少了英吉利海峡的非法移民——此举是为了反驳英国改革派夏季最喜欢的话题之一。 伯纳姆说：“借出挂毯是法英合作的一个很好的例子——同样的合作帮助我们将夏季小船过境量减少到七年来的最低水平。” 这是伯纳姆上任以来马克龙首次访问英国，也是他们作为领导人的第一次面对面会面。 贝叶挂毯是一件 70 米长的艺术品，被认为是不完整的，描绘了 1066 年诺曼征服英格兰。 由征服者威廉领导的诺曼军队在一场战役中击败并废黜了哈罗德·戈德温森国王，最终在黑斯廷斯战役中取得了胜利。挂毯上著名的描绘了哈罗德被箭射中眼睛，据说他已经死了——诚然，现代历史学家认为这可能是神话或艺术夸张。 这次征服是一个关键的贡献时刻......

reflection.en: The visit of President Macron, King Charles, and Prime Minister Burnham to the Bayeux Tapestry brings together leaders from different nations and roles. Their presence underscores the public trust placed in them to govern justly and serve their people, a responsibility echoed in Jeremiah's call for rulers to 'execute justice and righteousness.' May they,...
reflection.zh: 马克龙总统、查尔斯国王和安迪·伯纳姆首相参观贝叶挂毯的访问，汇聚了来自不同国家和角色的领导人。他们的出席突显了公众对他们公正治理和为人民服务的信任，这一责任在耶利米呼吁统治者“施行公平和公义”的经文中得到了呼应。愿他们以及所有领导人都能牢记维护公平和保护弱者的职责。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: US sanctions halt TOEFL and GRE tests in Iran, disrupting study plans
title.zh: 美国制裁叫停伊朗托福和GRE考试，打乱留学计划

summary.en: Students in Iran are unable to take TOEFL and GRE exams due to the suspension of a US sanctions exemption. Applicants report that this decision jeopardizes their university application deadlines and imposes costly travel requirements.
summary.zh: 由于美国制裁豁免被暂停，伊朗学生无法参加托福和GRE考试。申请者表示，此举威胁到他们的大学申请截止日期，并增加了昂贵的旅行负担。

body.en:
Students in Iran can no longer take TOEFL and GRE exams after a US sanctions exemption was suspended. Applicants say the move threatens university deadlines and adds costly travel obligations.

Iranian students hoping to study abroad are facing a new obstacle after TOEFL and GRE testing was suspended inside the country following changes to US sanctions regulations .

"My entire plan was built around taking this exam," a TOEFL candidate in Tehran told DW.

She said she had spent months preparing applications for a PhD program, contacting professors and gathering documents despite internet disruptions and other challenges.

ETS, the US-based organization that administers both exams, announced it suspended testing in Iran after the US Treasury Department's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) froze General License G, which had allowed certain educational services to continue in Iran .

"Following OFAC's suspension of General License G, ETS has paused administration of the TOEFL and GRE tests in Iran effective immediately," the organization said in an official notice.

ETS added that Iranian nationals can still take the exams outside Iran and that it is exploring options to restore testing.

TOEFL is a US-based English-language proficiency test accepted by universities worldwide. The GRE is a standardized test required by some graduate programs, particularly in the United States and Canada.

Since the  Iran war  began in late February, the US has increasingly expanded sanctions targeting Iranian trade and exports, contributing to broader disruptions throughout the Iranian economy .

An Iranian institution that administered TOEFL exams told DW that new registrations had stopped following the latest sanctions changes .

The institution added that the suspension could be temporary, but no date had been given for exams to resume.

That uncertainty is particularly serious for students approaching university and scholarship deadlines who have spent months preparing and paying application-related costs.

The suspension follows earlier problems with IELTS (British equivalent of TOEFL) testing in Iran. An IELTS center in Tehran  told DW that sanctions-related difficulties transferring money had become one of the main obstacles to continuing exams.

Some Iranian applicants had already been traveling to countries such as Turkey and Armenia to take IELTS. TOEFL and GRE candidates may now have to do the same.

Alireza, who is preparing to apply to a university in Italy, said the suspension of TOEFL had disrupted a backup plan he had arranged after IELTS testing became unavailable.

"European universities usually accept IELTS. But because IELTS has been suspended in Iran, after extensive correspondence with the university, they agreed...
body.zh: 在美国制裁豁免暂停后，伊朗的学生不能再参加托福和GRE考试。申请人表示，此举威胁到大学的最后期限，并增加了昂贵的旅行义务。希望出国留学的伊朗学生在美国制裁法规变更后，托福和GRE考试在国内暂停后面临新的障碍。“我的整个计划都是围绕着参加这次考试制定的，”德黑兰的一名托福考生告诉DW。她说，尽管互联网中断和其他挑战，她还是花了几个月的时间准备博士学位课程的申请，联系教授并收集文件。管理这两项考试的美国组织ETS宣布，在美国财政部外国资产控制办公室（ OFAC ）冻结通用许可证G后，它暂停了在伊朗的考试，该许可证允许某些教育服务继续在伊朗进行。“在OFAC暂停通用许可证G之后， ETS已暂停在伊朗进行托福和GRE考试，立即生效，”该组织在一份官方通知中表示。ETS补充说，伊朗国民仍然可以在伊朗境外参加考试，并且正在探索恢复测试的选项。托福是全球各大学接受的美国英语水平考试。GRE也由同一个美国组织管理，是一些研究生课程要求的标准化考试，特别是在美国和加拿大。自2月下旬伊朗战争开始以来，美国越来越多地扩大针对伊朗贸易和出口的制裁，导致整个伊朗经济出现更广泛的混乱。一家管理托福考试的伊朗机构告诉德国之声，在最近的制裁变更后，新的注册已经停止。该机构补充说，暂停考试可能是暂时的，但没有给出恢复考试的日期。对于接近大学和奖学金截止日期的学生来说，这种不确定性尤其严重，他们花了数月时间准备文件，联系教授并支付与申请相关的费用。此前，伊朗雅思（英国相当于托福）考试出现了问题。德黑兰雅思考试中心告诉德国之声，与制裁有关的转账困难已成为继续考试的主要障碍之一。一些伊朗申请人已经前往土耳其和亚美尼亚等国家参加雅思考试。托福和GRE考生现在可能必须做同样的事情。准备申请意大利一所大学的Alireza表示，暂停托福考试打乱了他在雅思考试不可用后安排的备考计划。“欧洲大学通常接受雅思考试。但由于雅思考试已被暂停...

reflection.en: The suspension of TOEFL and GRE tests in Iran, a consequence of US sanctions, leaves many students in a difficult position, threatening their academic timelines and forcing them to incur additional expenses. These students, who have worked diligently to prepare their applications, find their voices unheard and their futures uncertain due to decisions made...
reflection.zh: 美国制裁暂停了伊朗的托福和GRE考试，这使得许多学生陷入困境，威胁到他们的学业时间表，并迫使他们承担额外费用。这些学生辛勤准备申请材料，却发现自己的声音被忽视，未来变得不确定，这一切都源于远方的决定。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为不能说话的开口，为所有孤苦者辨明是非”。这段经文提醒我们要为那些机会受到不公正限制的人们发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Guinea-Bissau referendum tests democratic future
title.zh: 几内亚比绍公投考验民主未来

summary.en: Following voter approval of a constitutional change that expands presidential powers, Guinea-Bissau faces renewed debate over legitimacy, civilian rule and democratic safeguards.
summary.zh: 在选民批准了一项扩大总统权力的宪法修正案后，几内亚比绍面临着关于合法性、文官统治和民主保障的新一轮辩论。

body.en:
Following voter approval of a constitutional change that expands presidential powers, Guinea-Bissau faces renewed debate over legitimacy, civilian rule and democratic safeguards.

Guinea-Bissau is facing a new political test after voters approved a referendum on a proposed charter that will give the president the power to appoint and dismiss the prime minister and government ministers, while reducing the number of seats in parliament from 102 to 65..

Sunday's referendum came less than 10 months after a coup in which the military seized power and three months ahead of presidential and parliamentary elections scheduled to take place on December 6.

The transitional authorities say the constitutional reform is intended to bring stability to the impoverished West African country and prepare it for a return to civilian rule.

On Monday, the National Transitional Council claimed victory for the "Yes" camp. "The majority of those who went to vote voted yes. In conclusion, the victory of yes is guaranteed," council spokesman Alberto Pinto Pereira said.

On Tuesday, the National Electoral Commission (NEC) confirmed victory for the "Yes" side, saying it had received 70% of the vote, compared with 30% for the "No" camp, and that voter turnout exceeded 50%.

NEC chairperson Carmen Izaura Lobo described the Guinea-Bissau referendum as a success, due to the "organizational capacity, professionalism and dedication" of teams on the ground, Agence France-Presse (AFP) reported.

The opposition, however, says the referendum has no legal basis because it was organized by institutions created after the military coup . It had called on voters to boycott the vote.

Domingos Simoes Pereira, leader of the African Party for the Independence of Guinea and Cape Verde (PAIGC), who was  detained after the military coup and later released into house arrest , rejected the referendum as legally invalid.

Speaking to DW from Portugal, he said the institutions established by the military have no democratic mandate to rewrite Guinea-Bissau's constitution.

The PAIGC and other opposition groups maintain that the vote is a continuation of the November coup.

Fernando Dias Costa, the main challenger to then-President Umaro Sissoco Embalo in the November 2025 presidential election that was annulled by the military, disputed the official turnout figures.

"Very few citizens took part in this referendum," he said, noting that the people have sent an important message that must not be ignored.

"They are not prepared to simply accept political changes that are clearly unconstitutional and have not been publicly debated."

The proposed constitution would move Guinea-Bissau toward a much stronger presidential system. The president would appoint and dismiss the prime minister and...
body.zh: 在选民批准扩大总统权力的宪法修正案后，几内亚比绍面临着关于合法性、文官统治和民主保障的新辩论。 几内亚比绍正面临新的政治考验，选民批准了对拟议宪章的全民公投，该宪章将赋予总统任命和罢免总理和政府部长的权力，同时将议会席位从102个减少到65个。 周日的公投是在军方夺取政权的政变发生后不到 10 个月举行的，距离定于 12 月 6 日举行的总统和议会选举还有三个月。 过渡当局表示，宪法改革的目的是为这个贫穷的西非国家带来稳定，并为恢复文官统治做好准备。 On Monday, the National Transitional Council claimed victory for the "Yes" camp. “大多数去投票的人都投了赞成票。总之，赞成票的胜利是有保证的，”议会发言人阿尔贝托·平托·佩雷拉说。 周二，国家选举委员会（NEC）确认“赞成”阵营获胜，称其获得了70%的选票，而“反对”阵营则只有30%，投票率超过了50%。 据法新社报道，国家选举委员会主席卡门·伊扎乌拉·洛博 (Carmen Izaura Lobo) 表示，几内亚比绍公投取得了成功，这要归功于当地团队的“组织能力、专业精神和奉献精神”。 The opposition, however, says the referendum has no legal basis because it was organized by institutions created after the military coup . It had called on voters to boycott the vote. 几内亚和佛得角非洲独立党 (PAIGC) 领导人多明戈斯·西莫斯·佩雷拉 (Domingos Simoes Pereira) 在军事政变后被拘留，后来被软禁，他拒绝接受公投，认为公投在法律上无效。 他在葡萄牙接受德国之声采访时表示，军方建立的机构没有民主授权重写几内亚比绍宪法。 The PAIGC and other opposition groups maintain that the vote is a continuation of the November coup. 费尔南多·迪亚斯·科斯塔 (Fernando Dias Costa) 是时任总统乌马罗·西索科·恩巴洛 (Umaro Sissoco Embalo) 在被军方取消的 2025 年 11 月总统选举中的主要挑战者，他对官方投票率数据提出异议。 "Very few citizens took part in this referendum," he said, noting that the people have sent an important message that must not be ignored. "They are not prepared to simply accept political changes that are clearly unconstitutional and have not been publicly debated." The proposed constitution would move Guinea-Bissau toward a much stronger presidential system. The president would appoint and dismiss the prime minister and...

reflection.en: Guinea-Bissau's recent referendum, which shifts power towards the presidency by reducing parliamentary seats and granting the president authority over ministerial appointments, raises concerns about democratic safeguards. Proverbs 29:2 reminds us that the stability and well-being of a nation are deeply tied to the character and actions of its rulers, urging...
reflection.zh: 几内亚比绍最近的公投，通过减少议会席位并授予总统任命部长的权力，将权力向总统转移，这引发了对民主保障的担忧。《箴言》29:2提醒我们，国家的稳定和福祉与其统治者的品格和行为息息相关，因此需要警惕权力的平衡和对文官统治的保护。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: The shifting ties in Australia's backyard as 'deep pockets' beckon
title.zh: 澳大利亚后院的变动关系：‘深口袋’的诱惑

summary.en: While China stirs tensions over Taiwan in Palau, island leaders are urging Canberra to focus on climate and drug crime.
summary.zh: 在中国试图在帕劳挑起关于台湾的紧张局势之际，岛屿领导人正敦促堪培拉关注气候变化和毒品犯罪。

body.en:
China and Taiwan's diplomatic tug-of-war is casting a shadow over the ongoing Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) as a handful of national leaders declined to attend — however, experts on the ground caution that a geopolitical focus risks ignoring the core priorities of Australia's neighbours.

The annual 18-member gathering in the Taiwanese-allied nation of Palau opened on Monday with climate change, economic security, and the rising influence of the transnational drug trade top of the agenda.

China has said it has "serious concerns" that Taiwan was invited to attend in its own right, while questions have been raised about whether China has influenced five of 18 national leaders from the forum (those of Kiribati, Fiji, Vanuatu, Samoa and Solomon Island) not to attend.

The cornerstone regional political forum began this year with a pointed message from Palau's President Surangel Whipps Jr, who urged nations to adhere to this year's theme of unity and reminded outside partners that they "do not choose our destination".

This year's PIF takes place as Kiribati moves to constitutionally restrict diplomatic recognition to UN member states only — thus excluding Taiwan — while China actively seeks to strip Taiwan of its 'development partner' status in the forum. This comes nearly two months after a Chinese ballistic missile test in the Pacific Ocean .

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Taiwan, a self-governing democracy, broke away from mainland China in 1949. China views it as Chinese territory that must be brought under its control by force if necessary.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has made strengthening regional ties a key focus of his administration's foreign policy, signing multiple bilateral agreements with countries like Fiji, Vanuatu, and Tuvalu.

But despite the noise around China, "leaders have made it clear they're here to work" Tess Newton Cain, principal consultant at Asia-Pacific strategic firm Sustineo, told SBS News from Koror.

"The issue of the China-Taiwan tussle is largely a distraction, and one that they try to minimise."

On Wednesday, $600 million in Australian funding was announced to tackle transnational drug smuggling from South America that is increasingly causing harm across the Pacific.

China has made the PIF something of a battleground, maintaining that Taiwan ought to be sidelined during talks, as it is not technically a "dialogue partner" due to a difficult compromise that PIF members have reached over its status for the past three decades.

Palau, one of the few nations that maintains official diplomatic ties with Taiwan, has accused China of running a coercion campaign against it after travel...
body.zh: 由于少数国家领导人拒绝出席，中国和台湾的外交拉锯战给正在进行的太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）蒙上了阴影。然而，现场专家警告称，地缘政治焦点可能会忽视澳大利亚邻国的核心优先事项。 一年一度的 18 名成员聚会于周一在台湾盟友帕劳开幕，气候变化、经济安全和跨国毒品贸易影响力不断上升成为首要议题。 中国表示，它“严重关切”台湾本身受邀参加，同时也有人质疑中国是否影响论坛 18 个国家领导人中的 5 个（基里巴斯、斐济、瓦努阿图、萨摩亚和所罗门群岛）不参加。 这一基石区域政治论坛于今年拉开帷幕，帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯发出了尖锐的信息，他敦促各国坚持今年的团结主题，并提醒外部伙伴“我们的目的地不是他们选择的”。 今年的PIF召开之际，基里巴斯从宪法上采取行动，限制仅对联合国成员国进行外交承认，从而将台湾排除在外，而中国则积极寻求剥夺台湾在论坛中的“发展伙伴”地位。这是中国在太平洋进行弹道导弹试验近两个月后的事。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 台湾是一个自治民主国家，于 1949 年脱离中国大陆。中国将其视为中国领土，必要时必须使用武力将其置于其控制之下。 安东尼·阿尔巴内塞总理将加强区域关系作为其政府外交政策的重点，与斐济、瓦努阿图和图瓦卢等国签署了多项双边协议。 不过，尽管中国周围一片喧嚣，“领导人已经明确表示，他们来这里是为了工作”，亚太战略公司 Sustineo 的首席顾问泰丝·牛顿·凯恩 (Tess Newton Cain) 在科罗尔告诉 SBS 新闻。 “中国与台湾的争斗问题在很大程度上是一种干扰，他们试图将其最小化。” 周三，澳大利亚宣布提供 6 亿美元资金，用于打击来自南美洲的跨国毒品走私，这种走私在太平洋沿岸造成的危害日益严重。 中国已将太平洋岛礁论坛变成了一个战场，坚持认为台湾应该在谈判中靠边站，因为过去三十年来，太平洋岛礁论坛成员就其地位达成了艰难的妥协，因此从技术上讲，台湾并不是“对话伙伴”。 帕劳是少数几个与台湾保持正式外交关系的国家之一，该国指责中国在旅行后对其进行胁迫行动......

These are matters of justice and well-being for their people, echoing the prophet Micah's call to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh. Their focus on...
reflection.zh: 太平洋岛国领导人正驾驭复杂的地缘政治暗流，但他们向澳大利亚发出的紧急呼吁，凸显了他们眼前的关切：气候变化和毒品交易。这些关乎其人民的福祉和公义，呼应了先知弥迦的呼召，要行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。他们关注切实的需要而非遥远的冲突，提醒我们真正的优先事项往往在哪里。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: US warship arrives in Thailand after record 286 days at sea
title.zh: 美国军舰在海上创纪录航行286天后抵达泰国

summary.en: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier arrived in Thailand after a record 286 consecutive days at sea. The extended deployment, which included time in the Middle East and participation in combat operations during the war with Iran, reportedly led to mental health concerns among the approximately 5,000 sailors and...
summary.zh: 美国海军航空母舰“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号在海上连续航行286天，创下纪录后抵达泰国。此次延长的部署任务包括在中东地区停留，并参与了与伊朗的战争中的战斗行动。据报道，船上约5000名海军和海军陆战队员因此出现了心理健康问题。

body.en:
The United States Navy aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln arrived at Thailand's Laem Chabang port on Wednesday after spending 286 consecutive days at sea.

The record-long deployment included an extended period in the Middle East, amid reports of mounting mental health concerns and deteriorating conditions aboard the vessel.

The carrier, which has around 5,000 sailors and marines on board, was deployed in November last year and took part in the US naval blockade and combat operations during the war with Iran.

US Navy deployments typically last between six and nine months, although they can be extended during periods of conflict.

This deployment set a modern-era record for consecutive days at sea, according to US officials.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The Abraham Lincoln, accompanied by other US naval vessels, will spend five days in Thailand for rest and recuperation, according to Thai officials.

"Our arrival in Laem Chabang provides a well-deserved opportunity for our Sailors and Marines to rest and recharge. It also underscores the strong and enduring partnership and alliance between the United States and Thailand," the commander of Carrier Strike Group 3, Rear Admiral Robert E. Loughran, said in a statement.

"What this strike group has accomplished is truly historic. I could not be prouder of the exceptional professionalism and expertise demonstrated by every member of this team during our operations."

Thailand became a US treaty ally in 1954, before being designated a major non-NATO ally in 2003. Thailand's armed forces have long been reliant on US defence hardware and both countries' militaries maintain strong relations and hold annual exercises together.

Thailand has made it clear the visit is for logistics, rest, and recuperation, in line with its treaty commitments, and is not connected to the conflict in the Middle East.

The arrival of thousands of military personnel has raised hopes of an economic boost for the nearby ‌resort city of Pattaya, which also has a longstanding reputation as a sex tourism destination.

A fleet of around 40 buses will ferry the military personnel between Pattaya and the port at Laem Chabang where the vessels will dock, Pattaya Mayor Poramase Ngampiches said. Pattaya sits on the Gulf of Thailand, about 150km southeast of Bangkok.

"There are certain places and activities that the personnel are prohibited from participating in, such as all kinds of water sports, jet skiing, bungee jumping, wrestling, and boxing," he told the Reuters news agency.

Police will deploy additional patrols around Pattaya's main beachfront and nightlife district, following raids over the weekend that led to 40 to...
body.zh: 美国海军航空母舰亚伯拉罕·林肯号在连续海上航行286天后于周三抵达泰国林查班港。 这次创纪录的部署时间包括在中东的较长一段时间，有报道称，船上的心理健康问题日益严重，船上的情况不断恶化。 这艘航母载有约5000名水手和海军陆战队员，于去年11月部署，并在与伊朗的战争期间参加了美国的海上封锁和作战行动。 美国海军的部署通常持续六到九个月，但在冲突期间可能会延长。 美国官员称，这次部署创下了海上连续几天的现代记录。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 据泰国官员称，亚伯拉罕·林肯号将在其他美国海军舰艇的陪同下在泰国休养五天。 “我们抵达林查班为我们的水手和海军陆战队员提供了一个当之无愧的休息和充电的机会。这也凸显了美国和泰国之间强大而持久的伙伴关系和联盟，”第三航母战斗群司令罗伯特·E·洛夫兰少将在一份声明中说。 “这个打击群所取得的成就确实具有历史意义。我对这个团队的每个成员在行动中所表现出的卓越专业精神和专业知识感到无比自豪。” 泰国于 1954 年成为美国的条约盟友，并于 2003 年被指定为主要的非北约盟友。泰国武装部队长期以来一直依赖美国的国防硬件，两国军队保持着牢固的关系，并每年举行联合演习。 泰国已明确表示，此次访问是为了履行其条约承诺，进行后勤、休息和休养，与中东冲突无关。 数千名军事人员的到来给附近的度假城市芭堤雅带来了经济增长的希望，芭堤雅也素有性旅游目的地的美誉。 芭堤雅市长 Poramase Ngampiches 表示，由约 40 辆巴士组成的车队将在芭堤雅和军舰停靠的林查班港之间运送军事人员。芭堤雅位于泰国湾，距曼谷东南约 150 公里。 他对路透社表示：“有些场所和活动是禁止人员参加的，例如各种水上运动、水上摩托艇、蹦极、摔跤和拳击。” 继周末突袭导致 40 人受伤后，警方将在芭堤雅主要海滨和夜生活区周围部署更多巡逻人员。

reflection.en: After an unprecedented 286 days at sea, the USS Abraham Lincoln has reached port. This extended deployment, reportedly taking a toll on the mental well-being of its 5,000 crew members, highlights the profound exhaustion that prolonged service can bring. Yet, the prophet Isaiah offers a timeless promise: 'those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength.'...
reflection.zh: 在创纪录的286天海上航行后，“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号航母终于抵达港口。这次延长的部署任务据报道给船上5000名船员的心理健康带来了影响，凸显了长期服役可能带来的巨大疲惫。然而，先知以赛亚提供了一个永恒的应许：“那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。”愿我们记念那些服役的人们，愿他们能找到安息和重燃的希望。

verse.textEn: Those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary.
verse.textZh: 但那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾。

title.en: 'Like one family': Australia's Nepali community faces anxious wait for answers
title.zh: “一家人”：澳大利亚尼泊尔社区焦急等待答案

summary.en: More than a week after deadly flash floods hit Nepal and Tibet, thousands of people remain missing, including 38 Australians, with rescue efforts ongoing.
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔和西藏发生致命的洪水灾害一个多星期后，仍有数千人失踪，其中包括38名澳大利亚人，救援工作仍在进行中。

body.en:
Australia's Nepali community remains hopeful for the welfare of loved ones missing in a cataclysmic flood that lashed the nation's border with Tibet one week ago.

Local officials fear many are buried under debris left by the floods that tore through towns and valleys near the ‌Chinese border, as the death toll reaches at least 1,204 people and more than 4,200 remain missing.

Authorities hold grave concerns for 38 Australians still missing in the flood impact zone despite five citizens being confirmed safe , the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) confirmed on Wednesday.

Rescuers are racing the clock in the search for survivors more than one week on from the disaster, but grieving community members in Australia continue to cling to hope.

"Lots of people are stuck in the tunnels over there as well, and most don't have any contact ... we are still hopeful that maybe we can get good news," Non-Resident Nepali Association Victorian co-ordinator Mahadev Dhanuk told Australian Associated Press (AAP).

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The association has raised almost $75,000 through community donations for relief efforts in the region as part of the Nepali Prime Minister's Disaster Relief Fund.

The tight-knit Victorian Nepali community of less than 30,000 is wrapping its arms around those affected by the tragedy, with hundreds uniting at a candlelight vigil in memory of the victims in Melbourne on Monday.

"Many are not personally affected, but culturally we feel like one family. That's why everyone is devastated," Dhanuk said.

"All of the community is trying to overcome their own plight and trying to help and think how can we stand with the Nepal?"

Five Australians had been confirmed safe by officials in Nepal and Tibet, while three others were located outside the crisis zone, the government said.

On the Sunshine Coast, community members are "doing everything they can" to rally around loved ones of missing disability support worker Renee Spry.

The Queensland mother of twin daughters was returning from the religious Mount Kailash pilgrimage, at an immigration centre near the Nepal-Tibet border, minutes before the catastrophic flood swept through the area.

"Every time we hear news of another person being found alive is a moment of extraordinary joy and relief," Sunshine Coast-based Opposition foreign affairs spokesman Ted O'Brien told AAP.

"We all, of course, on the Sunshine Coast then turn our minds to Renee and it is with hope that we think of her predicament."

The family of another missing Australian, Luke Costanzo, released a statement on Tuesday about the "unimaginably difficult situation" confronting them.

body.zh: 澳大利亚尼泊尔社区仍然对一周前袭击该国与西藏边境的灾难性洪水中失踪亲人的福祉充满希望。 当地官员担心，许多人被埋在中国边境附近城镇和山谷的洪水留下的废墟下，死亡人数至少达到 1,204 人，仍有 4,200 多人失踪。 外交和贸易部 (DFAT) 周三证实，尽管已确认 5 名公民安全，但仍有 38 名澳大利亚人在洪水影响区失踪，当局对此表示严重关切。 灾难发生一个多星期后，救援人员正在争分夺秒地寻找幸存者，但澳大利亚悲痛的社区成员仍然抱有希望。 “很多人也被困在那边的隧道里，大多数人都没有任何联系……我们仍然希望能得到好消息，”非居民尼泊尔协会维多利亚州协调员马哈德夫·达努克告诉澳大利亚美联社（AAP）。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 作为尼泊尔总理救灾基金的一部分，该协会已通过社区捐款筹集了近 75,000 美元用于该地区的救灾工作。 不到 30,000 人的紧密团结的维多利亚尼泊尔社区正在拥抱那些受悲剧影响的人，周一，数百人在墨尔本举行烛光守夜活动，悼念遇难者。 达努克说：“许多人个人并未受到影响，但从文化上来说，我们感觉就像一个家庭。这就是为什么每个人都感到震惊。” “所有社区都在努力克服自己的困境，并试图提供帮助，并思考我们如何才能与尼泊尔站在一起？” 政府表示，尼泊尔和西藏的官员已确认五名澳大利亚人安全，另外三人则位于危机地区之外。 在阳光海岸，社区成员正在“尽其所能”团结在失踪的残疾支持人员蕾妮·斯普里 (Renee Spry) 的亲人周围。 昆士兰州一位双胞胎女儿的母亲刚刚从尼泊尔-西藏边境附近的一个移民中心的冈仁波齐峰朝圣回来，几分钟后灾难性洪水席卷了该地区。 阳光海岸反对党外交事务发言人泰德·奥布莱恩 (Ted O'Brien) 告诉澳联社：“每次听到有人被发现生还的消息，我们都会感到无比的喜悦和宽慰。” “当然，阳光海岸的我们所有人都会把注意力转向蕾妮，我们满怀希望地想到她的困境。” 另一位失踪的澳大利亚人卢克·科斯坦佐的家人周二发表声明，讲述他们面临的“难以想象的困难局面”。 像斯普瑞一样，...

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Nepal have left many families in Australia anxiously awaiting news of loved ones. In times of such profound uncertainty and loss, we are reminded to extend compassion to those affected, recognizing them as our neighbors in need. May we pray for the missing, the rescuers, and the comfort of those grieving.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔毁灭性的洪水灾害让澳大利亚的许多家庭焦急地等待着亲人的消息。在如此深刻的不确定和失落时期，我们被提醒要向受灾者伸出援手，视他们为有需要的邻居。愿我们为失踪者、救援人员以及那些哀伤者祈祷，求安慰。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

reflection.en: The Bhotekoshi River's devastating flood on the Nepal-Tibet border has brought unimaginable loss, with over a thousand dead and thousands more missing. In the face of such profound grief and destruction, we hold onto the hope of a future where all tears are wiped away and suffering ceases. May Yahweh comfort those who mourn and guide efforts toward healing...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏边境博特科西河的毁灭性洪水带来了难以想象的损失，造成一千多人死亡，数千人失踪。面对如此深切的悲痛和毁灭，我们紧握着对未来的希望，那是一个所有眼泪都被擦干、痛苦将停止的未来。愿雅伟安慰那些哀恸的人，并指引疗愈和重建的努力。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: The shifting ties in Australia's backyard as 'deep pockets' beckon
title.zh: 澳大利亚后院的变动关系：‘深口袋’的诱惑

summary.en: While China stirs tensions over Taiwan in Palau, island leaders are urging Canberra to focus on climate and drug crime.
summary.zh: 在中国试图在帕劳挑起关于台湾的紧张局势之际，岛屿领导人正敦促堪培拉关注气候变化和毒品犯罪。

body.en:
China and Taiwan's diplomatic tug-of-war is casting a shadow over the ongoing Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) as a handful of national leaders declined to attend — however, experts on the ground caution that a geopolitical focus risks ignoring the core priorities of Australia's neighbours.

The annual 18-member gathering in the Taiwanese-allied nation of Palau opened on Monday with climate change, economic security, and the rising influence of the transnational drug trade top of the agenda.

China has said it has "serious concerns" that Taiwan was invited to attend in its own right, while questions have been raised about whether China has influenced five of 18 national leaders from the forum (those of Kiribati, Fiji, Vanuatu, Samoa and Solomon Island) not to attend.

The cornerstone regional political forum began this year with a pointed message from Palau's President Surangel Whipps Jr, who urged nations to adhere to this year's theme of unity and reminded outside partners that they "do not choose our destination".

This year's PIF takes place as Kiribati moves to constitutionally restrict diplomatic recognition to UN member states only — thus excluding Taiwan — while China actively seeks to strip Taiwan of its 'development partner' status in the forum. This comes nearly two months after a Chinese ballistic missile test in the Pacific Ocean .

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Taiwan, a self-governing democracy, broke away from mainland China in 1949. China views it as Chinese territory that must be brought under its control by force if necessary.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has made strengthening regional ties a key focus of his administration's foreign policy, signing multiple bilateral agreements with countries like Fiji, Vanuatu, and Tuvalu.

But despite the noise around China, "leaders have made it clear they're here to work" Tess Newton Cain, principal consultant at Asia-Pacific strategic firm Sustineo, told SBS News from Koror.

"The issue of the China-Taiwan tussle is largely a distraction, and one that they try to minimise."

On Wednesday, $600 million in Australian funding was announced to tackle transnational drug smuggling from South America that is increasingly causing harm across the Pacific.

China has made the PIF something of a battleground, maintaining that Taiwan ought to be sidelined during talks, as it is not technically a "dialogue partner" due to a difficult compromise that PIF members have reached over its status for the past three decades.

body.zh: 由于少数国家领导人拒绝出席，中国和台湾的外交拉锯战给正在进行的太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）蒙上了阴影。然而，现场专家警告称，地缘政治焦点可能会忽视澳大利亚邻国的核心优先事项。 一年一度的 18 名成员聚会于周一在台湾盟友帕劳开幕，气候变化、经济安全和跨国毒品贸易影响力不断上升成为首要议题。 中国表示，它“严重关切”台湾本身受邀参加，同时也有人质疑中国是否影响论坛 18 个国家领导人中的 5 个（基里巴斯、斐济、瓦努阿图、萨摩亚和所罗门群岛）不参加。 这一基石区域政治论坛于今年拉开帷幕，帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯发出了尖锐的信息，他敦促各国坚持今年的团结主题，并提醒外部伙伴“我们的目的地不是他们选择的”。 今年的PIF召开之际，基里巴斯从宪法上采取行动，限制仅对联合国成员国进行外交承认，从而将台湾排除在外，而中国则积极寻求剥夺台湾在论坛中的“发展伙伴”地位。这是中国在太平洋进行弹道导弹试验近两个月后的事。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 台湾是一个自治民主国家，于 1949 年脱离中国大陆。中国将其视为中国领土，必要时必须使用武力将其置于其控制之下。 安东尼·阿尔巴内塞总理将加强区域关系作为其政府外交政策的重点，与斐济、瓦努阿图和图瓦卢等国签署了多项双边协议。 不过，尽管中国周围一片喧嚣，“领导人已经明确表示，他们来这里是为了工作”，亚太战略公司 Sustineo 的首席顾问泰丝·牛顿·凯恩 (Tess Newton Cain) 在科罗尔告诉 SBS 新闻。 “中国与台湾的争斗问题在很大程度上是一种干扰，他们试图将其最小化。” 周三，澳大利亚宣布提供 6 亿美元资金，用于打击来自南美洲的跨国毒品走私，这种走私在太平洋沿岸造成的危害日益严重。 中国已将太平洋岛礁论坛变成了一个战场，坚持认为台湾应该在谈判中靠边站，因为过去三十年来，太平洋岛礁论坛成员就其地位达成了艰难的妥协，因此从技术上讲，台湾并不是“对话伙伴”。 帕劳是少数几个与台湾保持正式外交关系的国家之一，该国指责中国在旅行后对其进行胁迫行动......

These are matters of justice and well-being for their people, echoing the prophet Micah's call to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh. Their focus on...
reflection.zh: 太平洋岛国领导人正驾驭复杂的地缘政治暗流，但他们向澳大利亚发出的紧急呼吁，凸显了他们眼前的关切：气候变化和毒品交易。这些关乎其人民的福祉和公义，呼应了先知弥迦的呼召，要行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。他们关注切实的需要而非遥远的冲突，提醒我们真正的优先事项往往在哪里。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...
