title.en: Man, woman arrested as DH seizes unregistered jabs
title.zh: 卫生署检获未注册针剂拘捕一男一女

summary.en: Hong Kong authorities have seized approximately 50 suspected unregistered injections from over 13 locations and arrested a man and a woman. The operation targeted the use of a WT1 vaccine advertised for cancer prevention, though the Assistant Director of Health stated that the seized items were mostly healthcare...
summary.zh: 香港当局在超过13个地点检获约50支疑似未注册的针剂，并拘捕了一男一女。此次行动针对一种宣传能预防多种癌症的WT1疫苗的使用，但卫生署助理署长表示，检获的物品主要是维生素等保健产品，而WT1疫苗仍在调查中。

body.en: Authorities have seized some 50 suspected unregistered injections from over 13 premises and arrested two people in a recent operation. They arrested a 28-year-old man and a woman. The operation was carried out jointly by the Department of Health and police, to crack down on the usage of the Wilms' tumor 1 (WT1) vaccine, which is advertised as being able to prevent multiple cancers. But Assistant Director of Health Frank Chan on Wednesday said authorities have so far not found any of the vaccines in the operation. “The over 50 suspected unregistered injections we found are mostly healthcare products like vitamins,” he said. “As for the WT1 vaccine, we are still carrying out an investigation. “So far, we have no report of adverse reactions to the vaccine. But we still hope to find the product in the investigation so that we can hold those responsible accountable.” Chan also said the seized injections belong to Part 1 poisons, adding relevant companies and those in charge are suspected of the illegal sale and possession of unregistered pharmaceutical products. He said the operation is still ongoing and more arrests could be made. _____________________________ Last updated: 2026-09-02 HKT 22:44 Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 当局在最近的一次行动中，从超过 13 个场所查获了约 50 支疑似未经登记的注射剂，并逮捕了两人。他们逮捕了一名 28 岁的男子和一名女子。此次行动由卫生部和警方联合开展，旨在打击使用被宣传为能够预防多种癌症的维尔姆斯肿瘤1号（WT1）疫苗。但卫生部助理总监 Frank Chan 周三表示，迄今为止，当局尚未在行动中发现任何疫苗。 “我们发现的50多个疑似未注册注射剂大多是维生素等保健品，”他说。 “至于WT1疫苗，我们还在进行调查。”到目前为止，我们还没有收到疫苗不良反应的报告。但我们还是希望能在调查中找到该产品，以便追究相关责任人的责任。”陈又表示，检获的注射剂属于第1部毒药，相关公司及负责人涉嫌非法售卖及管有未经注册药剂制品。他表示，行动仍在进行中，可能会逮捕更多人。 _____________________________ 最后更新：2026-09-02 香港时间 22:44 编辑：谭咏麟

reflection.en: In Hong Kong, authorities are investigating unregistered injections and a specific vaccine, arresting two individuals in the process. This action underscores the importance of integrity and accountability in public health, ensuring that treatments are safe and properly regulated. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God....
reflection.zh: 在香港，当局正在调查未注册的针剂和一种特定疫苗，并在此过程中逮捕了两人。这一行动凸显了公共卫生领域诚信和问责制的重要性，确保治疗方法安全且得到妥善监管。 弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、谦卑与神同行。这一原则指导掌权者维护保护市民的标准，同时也提醒我们，真正的公义在所有事业中都包含慈爱和道德行为，包括医疗保健领域。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: 'AFCD won't label fighting dogs based on a glance'
title.zh: 渔护署：不会仅凭一眼就判定斗牛犬

summary.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) has refuted claims that its officers would classify a dog as a fighting breed based solely on a cursory glance. The department clarified that such identifications are made by veterinarians who conduct thorough examinations of a dog's physical...
summary.zh: 渔业、农业及养护署（渔护署）周三否认其官员会仅凭快速观察就将犬只列为斗牛犬。该部门在一份声明中表示，斗牛犬的识别由兽医处理，他们会仔细检查犬只的身体特征——头部、耳朵和眼睛的形状，体型、身高和体长，以及身体结构。“这是国际公认的识别斗牛犬品种的做法，既科学又专业，充分考虑了犬只的实际安全风险，”声明说。

body.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) on Wednesday dismissed a claim that its officers would label a canine as a fighting dog based merely on a quick observation. In a statement, the department said the identification of fighting dogs is handled by veterinarians, who will carefully examine the dogs’ physical features – the shape of their head, ears and eyes, their stature, height and body length, as well as body structures. “This is the internationally accepted practice for identifying fighting dog breeds, and it is both scientifically and professionally sound, taking full account of the actual safety risks posed by the dog,” it said. The department also said genetic testing is not the best method for identifying fighting dogs. Most dogs carry mixed-breed genes, and those with genes from the fighting dog breeds may not necessarily develop relevant characteristics, it explained. But the department said authorities would monitor developments in the technology and consider the possibility of using it as a supplementary tool in the future. The AFCD said the purpose of identifying fighting dogs is to safeguard the safety of the public and animals, and officers would actively communicate with dog owners in enforcement operations. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 渔农自然护理署（渔护署）周三驳回了有关官员仅根据快速观察就将犬科动物标记为斗犬的说法。该部门在一份声明中表示，斗犬的识别工作由兽医负责，他们会仔细检查斗犬的身体特征，包括头部、耳朵和眼睛的形状、身材、身高和体长以及身体结构。声明称：“这是国际上通行的斗犬品种认定做法，既科学又专业，充分考虑了斗犬带来的实际安全风险。”该部门还表示，基因测试并不是识别斗犬的最佳方法。报告解释说，大多数狗都携带混种基因，而那些带有斗犬品种基因的狗不一定会发展出相关特征。但该部门表示，当局将监控该技术的发展，并考虑未来将其用作补充工具的可能性。渔护署表示，识别斗狗的目的是保障公众及动物的安全，执法人员会积极与狗主人沟通。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: In a world quick to judge, the AFCD's approach to identifying dogs emphasizes careful, professional assessment over snap decisions. This echoes Micah 6:8, which calls us to act justly and to love mercy. True discernment requires looking beyond the surface, understanding the complexities, and applying standards with both fairness and compassion.
reflection.zh: 在这个急于评判的世界里，渔护署识别犬只的方法强调仔细、专业的评估，而非草率的决定。这呼应了弥迦书6:8，它呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯。真正的辨别力需要超越表面，理解复杂性，并以公正和怜悯之心运用标准。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: China’s Xi Jinping holds talks with Sisi in first Egypt visit in a decade
title.zh: 中国国家主席习近平与塞西举行会谈，这是十年来埃及首次迎来习主席到访

summary.en: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping in Cairo, marking Xi's first visit in a decade. The leaders engaged in talks, underscored by a 21-gun salute at Ittihadiya Palace, focusing on the Middle East conflict's impact, maritime trade security, and increasing Chinese investment in...
summary.zh: 埃及总统阿卜杜勒-法塔赫·塞西周三在开罗接待了到访的中国国家主席习近平，这是习近平十年来首次访问埃及。两国元首在伊蒂哈迪亚宫举行了会谈，仪式以21响礼炮开始。会谈议题包括中东冲突及其影响、海上贸易安全，以及增加中国在埃及的投资。两国均为金砖国家成员。

body.en: Egypt’s President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi on Wednesday received his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping on his first visit to Cairo in a decade, as Beijing seeks a greater foothold in the region against the backdrop of the US-Iran war. China’s Xi Jinping arrived in Egypt to meet President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi on Wednesday, September 2, 2026. Photo: Egypt Gov’t. The 21-gun salute at Cairo’s Ittihadiya Palace marked the start of a day of talks expected to cover the Middle East war and its fallout, including on maritime trade security, as well as boosting Chinese investment in the Arab world’s most populous country. The two BRICS members are expected to sign a slate of economic agreements, including on artificial intelligence, transport and manufacturing. Egypt currently estimates Chinese investments at around US$10 billion. Beijing has key stakes in the Suez Canal Economic Zone, which are only expected to grow as the US-Iran war threatens global maritime trade. Beijing has also played a key role in Sisi’s megaprojects, the crowning jewel of which is the New Administrative Capital 50 kilometres (30 miles) east of Cairo, large swathes of which have been bankrolled by Chinese investment. China is a major exporter to Egypt, with its trade surplus reaching US$12 billion in the first seven months of 2026, according to Chinese customs data. Across Cairo, a megalopolis home to over 26 million people, major streets have been lined with Chinese and Egyptian flags, as well as billboards showing Sisi and Xi. Street signs boast of “generations of Egyptian-Chinese friendship flowing like the Nile River”, while residents have been warned to plan for substantial traffic delays on their commutes. Xi is expected to traverse the entire capital during his visit Wednesday, including a stop at the Grand Egyptian Museum overlooking the Giza Pyramids. ‘Independent foreign policy’ According to analysts, Cairo will use the summit to underscore its strategic autonomy, showing it can leverage its close ties with both Washington and Beijing. President Abdel Fattah Al-Sisi of Egypt in 2020. File photo: Graham Carlow, via UK Gov’t. Sisi, in an op-ed published in Egyptian media on Tuesday, highlighted Cairo’s “independent foreign policy”, days after a branch of Egypt’s second-largest bank was targeted by US sanctions. He wrote that Egypt and China were partners in “strengthening the role of the global south” in an increasingly polarised world. Washington vowed last month to isolate Iran economically, threatening expanded sanctions that could also hit Chinese banks, among others. China, a major buyer of Iranian oil, has vowed to safeguard its interests. Chinese leader Xi Jinping. Photo:...
body.zh: 埃及总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西周三会见了中国国家主席习近平，这是他十年来首次访问开罗，北京在美伊战争的背景下寻求在该地区取得更大的立足点。中国国家主席习近平于 2026 年 9 月 2 日星期三抵达埃及会见总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西。照片：埃及政府。开罗伊蒂哈迪亚宫鸣放21响礼炮，标志着一天会谈的开始，预计将讨论中东战争及其后果，包括海上贸易安全，以及促进中国对阿拉伯世界人口最多国家的投资。预计这两个金砖国家成员将签署一系列经济协议，包括人工智能、运输和制造领域的协议。埃及目前估计中国投资约为100亿美元。北京在苏伊士运河经济区拥有重要利益，随着美伊战争威胁全球海上贸易，这一利益预计只会增长。北京也在塞西的大型项目中发挥了关键作用，其中最重要的一颗明珠是位于开罗以东 50 公里（30 英里）的新行政首都，其中大片地区由中国投资提供资金。中国是埃及的主要出口国，根据中国海关数据，2026年前7个月中国的贸易顺差达到120亿美元。开罗这座拥有超过 2600 万人口的大都市，在整个主要街道上都挂满了中国和埃及国旗，以及印有塞西和习近平的广告牌。街道标牌上写着“埃中世代友谊像尼罗河一样流淌”，居民们也被警告要做好通勤路上严重交通延误的准备。预计习近平在周三访问期间将穿越整个首都，包括在俯瞰吉萨金字塔的大埃及博物馆停留。 “独立的外交政策” 分析人士称，开罗将利用这次峰会强调其战略自主权，表明它可以利用与华盛顿和北京的密切关系。 2020 年埃及总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西。资料图片：格雷厄姆·卡洛，来自英国政府。就在埃及第二大银行的一家分行遭到美国制裁的几天后，塞西在埃及媒体周二发表的一篇专栏文章中强调了开罗的“独立外交政策”。他写道，埃及和中国是在日益两极分化的世界中“加强南半球的作用”的合作伙伴。华盛顿上个月誓言要在经济上孤立伊朗，并威胁扩大制裁，这也可能打击中国的银行等。中国是伊朗石油的主要买家，誓言维护自身利益。中国领导人习近平。照片：...

reflection.en: As leaders from Egypt and China convene for high-level talks, the world watches for signs of diplomatic engagement. The pursuit of peace and stability, even amidst complex geopolitical currents, is a vital endeavor. May these discussions foster understanding and lay groundwork for a more secure and prosperous future for the region and beyond.
reflection.zh: 埃及和中国领导人举行高级别会谈，世界正关注外交互动的迹象。即使在复杂的地缘政治背景下，追求和平与稳定也是一项至关重要的事业。愿此次会谈能增进理解，为该地区及更广泛范围的未来安全与繁荣奠定基础。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Lawmaker urges Hong Kong gov’t to introduce comprehensive population policy amid record-low births
title.zh: 议员敦促香港政府推出全面人口政策，应对生育率创纪录新低

summary.en: A pro-Beijing lawmaker in Hong Kong has called on the government to implement a comprehensive population policy and to investigate young people's views on childbearing, citing record-low birth rates over the past year. Nixie Lam, a legislator, suggested forming a dedicated task force to research the issue.
summary.zh: 一位亲北京的香港议员呼吁政府实施一项全面的人口政策，并研究年轻人对生育的看法，因为过去一年记录到的出生率创下新低。议员林素蔚建议成立一个专门的工作小组进行研究。

body.en: A pro-Beijing Hong Kong lawmaker has urged the government to introduce a comprehensive population policy and to study young people’s thoughts on childbearing amid record-low births logged over the past year. Nixie Lam, a legislator with the Democratic Alliance for the Betterment and Progress of Hong Kong (DAB), told RTHK Radio 1 on Wednesday that although the government has introduced measures to boost fertility, it has so far presented “no comprehensive population policy.” DAB Legislative Council lawmaker Nixie Lam. Photo: Candice Chau/HKFP. Lam urged authorities to set up a population policy task force, led by secretarial-grade officers, to conduct research into what young people think about starting families and raising children. “Different policies [linked to fertility] are scattered around different bureaux and government departments,” Lam said in Cantonese, “but without a comprehensive policy people will wonder if the government is actually doing anything to help.“ “In particular, with regard to whether young people want to have children and what impacts [that decision], what pressures they are facing… the government has not conducted any research in recent years,” Lam said. “Without research, we are still using ideas from the last century to formulate relevant policies.” Fewer than 30,000 babies were born in Hong Kong over the past year – a record low for the territory. The number of new births in 2025 came in at around half that of 2015, according to figures from the Census and Statistics Department. Children in Hong Kong. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. These figures come in spite of new measures introduced to boost the local fertility rate, including a new tax allowance for residents receiving assisted reproductive services. In late 2023, a one-off cash allowance of HK$20,000 was offered as a financial incentive to eligible parents. It is unclear whether the “Newborn Baby Bonus” scheme, which was implemented for a period of three years, will be extended when it expires in October. Speaking to the public broadcaster, Lam called on the government to continue providing these payments. Children look at the skyline of Hong Kong. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. She said authorities should not simply cancel the bonus scheme without introducing a comprehensive population policy. Shrinking primary school classes Enrolment at Hong Kong’s kindergartens and primary schools has been dipping amid the record-low birth rate and emigration from the city. Ming Pao reported on Wednesday that, in the new school year, 127 of 446 government-subsidised primary schools in Hong Kong had cut back on Primary One classes. Of these, 60 offered only one Primary One class in the new academic year and...
body.zh: 一位亲北京的香港立法会议员敦促政府推出全面的人口政策，并在过去一年的出生率创历史新低的情况下研究年轻人对生育的想法。民主建港联盟（民建联）立法会议员林郑月娥周三对香港电台第一台表示，尽管政府出台了提高生育率的措施，但迄今为止“尚未提出全面的人口政策”。民建联立法会议员林郑月娥。照片：Candice Chau/HKFP。林郑月娥敦促当局成立一个由秘书级人员领导的人口政策专责小组，研究年轻人对组建家庭和抚养孩子的看法。 “（与生育相关的）不同政策分散在不同的政策局和政府部门，”林郑月娥用粤语说道，“但如果没有一项全面的政策，人们会怀疑政府是否真的在采取任何措施来提供帮助。” “特别是，关于年轻人是否想要孩子以及什么影响（这个决定）、他们面临什么压力……政府近年来没有进行任何研究，”林说。 “没有研究，我们还在用上个世纪的想法来制定相关政策。”过去一年，香港的出生人数不足 30,000 人，创下香港历史新低。根据政府统计处的数据，2025 年的新生儿数量约为 2015 年的一半。香港的孩子们。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。尽管采取了新措施来提高当地生育率，包括为接受辅助生殖服务的居民提供新的税收补贴，但这些数字还是出现了。 2023年底，政府向合资格家长提供一次性20,000港元现金津贴，作为经济奖励。目前尚不清楚为期三年的“新生婴儿奖金”计划在10月份到期后是否会延长。林郑月娥在接受公共广播公司采访时呼吁政府继续提供这些款项。孩子们眺望香港的天际线。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。她表示，当局不应在没有出台全面人口政策的情况下简单地取消奖金计划。小学班级规模缩小 由于出生率创历史新低以及人口外流，香港幼儿园和小学的入学率一直在下降。 《明报》周三报道称，新学年，香港446所政府资助小学中，有127所削减了小一课程。其中，60所学校在新学年只开设一门小一课程，并且......

reflection.en: The news from Hong Kong highlights a growing concern over declining birth rates, prompting calls for government intervention. This situation invites reflection on the profound gift of children, as Psalm 127:3 reminds us, "Children are a heritage from Yahweh, the fruit of the womb a reward." May leaders and citizens alike consider the value and blessing of...
reflection.zh: 香港传来的消息凸显了人们对出生率下降日益增长的担忧，并呼吁政府介入。这种情况引人反思子女的宝贵恩赐，正如诗篇127:3所提醒我们的：“儿女是雅伟所赐的产业；所怀的胎是他所给的赏赐。”愿领导者和民众都能珍视新生命的价值与祝福。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: Shein股票上市首日下跌，快时尚零售商估值缩水

summary.en: Shares of the fast-fashion brand Shein fell as much as 10% on their debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was valued at just over $26 billion, a significant drop from its previous valuation of nearly $100 billion.
summary.zh: 快时尚品牌Shein在香港证券交易所上市首日股价下跌高达10%。这家中国创立、现总部设在新加坡的公司，估值略高于260亿美元，远低于其此前近1000亿美元的估值。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped by as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾估值 1000 亿美元的公司在香港发行 260 亿美元，此前该公司未能在美国和英国上市。快时尚品牌 Shein 在香港证券交易所首次上市后，其股价下跌了 10%。这家总部位于新加坡的公司一度估值近 1000 亿美元（740 亿英镑），周二上市，股价为 48.56 港元，业务估值略高于 260 亿美元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic drop in Shein's valuation on its Hong Kong stock market debut, from nearly $100 billion to just over $26 billion, serves as a potent reminder of the volatile nature of commerce. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans, a wisdom that transcends market highs and lows.
reflection.zh: Shein在香港股市上市首日估值从近1000亿美元暴跌至略高于260亿美元，这有力地提醒我们商业的波动性。箴言16:3鼓励我们将所做的事交托给雅伟，信靠祂必成就我们的计划，这智慧超越了市场的起伏。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Europe facing housing affordability crisis, continental study of more than 22 million property listings suggests
title.zh: 欧洲面临住房负担能力危机，一项涵盖2200万套房源的欧洲研究表明

summary.en: A continental study analyzing over 22 million property listings suggests Europe is facing a housing affordability crisis. Nearly half of average-income Europeans can only afford to buy a one-bedroom or studio apartment, and 39% cannot even afford to rent one.
summary.zh: 一项对超过2200万处房产进行的欧洲大陆研究表明，欧洲正面临住房负担能力危机。近一半的平均收入欧洲人只能负担得起购买一居室或单间公寓，而39%的欧洲人甚至负担不起租用此类房产。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Nearly half of people living in Europe on an average income can only afford to buy the equivalent of a one-bedroom apartment or studio apartment, while 39% of Europeans cannot afford to rent a property this size.

The data highlights the emerging crisis over affordable housing, with densely populated areas such as towns and cities worst affected.

The authors from TU Wien (Vienna), Austria, used property and financial data from more than 30 European countries to map "hotspots" where some homes are beyond the means of average earners. Areas around Paris, Berlin and Madrid are among the urban locations most affected by the housing affordability crisis.

The results show that around two in five (44%) of Europe's urban population lives in a city where less than 50 square meters (538 square feet, around the size of a small one-bedroom apartment or a studio apartment) are affordable on an average income.

Another key finding is that more than 70% of the European population lives in regions where a 30-year mortgage only buys up to 75 square meters (807 square feet), again based on an average income.

The maps also reveal that tourist areas are affected, with second-home owners and short-term renters pricing local people out of the market.

"Our study reveals pronounced hotspots of unaffordability," says lead author Franziska Sielker, a professor of urban and regional research at the Institute of Spatial Planning at TU Wien.

"It points to a substantial housing affordability crisis in the making, one that already disproportionately affects newcomers to the market as well as people who change their location frequently for personal or professional reasons. This is the case in capital regions, major urban centers, coastal zones and tourism-intensive alpine areas, alongside large rural supply gaps in rental markets."

The maps highlight an emerging affordability crisis, particularly when accounting for higher population density in the least affordable regions.

Affordable housing is an issue affecting many countries worldwide. In Europe, evidence suggests that house prices have risen faster than incomes for more than a decade.

For this study, the authors set out to establish how many square meters can be affordable on an average regional income.

The authors based their research on 22 million property listings gathered by the ESPON HOUSE4ALL project across 30 countries. They calculated the affordable floor area based on average regional incomes.

The data was then used to create maps showing the geography of housing affordability at a municipal level. The maps included privately...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 生活在欧洲的近一半人的平均收入只能购买相当于一居室公寓或单间公寓的费用，而 39% 的欧洲人无法租用这种规模的房产。 该数据突显了经济适用房正在出现的危机，城镇等人口稠密的地区受到的影响最严重。 来自奥地利维也纳工业大学的作者利用 30 多个欧洲国家的房地产和金融数据绘制了“热点”地图，其中一些住房超出了普通收入者的承受能力。巴黎、柏林和马德里周边地区是受住房负担能力危机影响最严重的城市地区。 结果显示，大约五分之二 (44%) 的欧洲城市人口所居住的城市的面积小于 50 平方米（538 平方英尺，大约相当于小型一居室公寓或单间公寓的大小），平均收入可以负担得起。 另一个重要发现是，超过 70% 的欧洲人口生活在 30 年期抵押贷款只能购买最多 75 平方米（807 平方英尺）的地区，同样基于平均收入。 地图还显示，旅游区受到了影响，第二套房主和短期租房者将当地人挤出市场。 “我们的研究揭示了明显的负担不起的热点，”主要作者、维也纳工业大学空间规划研究所城市和区域研究教授弗兰齐斯卡·西尔克（Franziska Sielker）说。 “这表明一场严重的住房负担能力危机正在形成，这场危机已经对新进入市场的人以及因个人或职业原因经常改变居住地点的人产生了不成比例的影响。首都地区、主要城市中心、沿海地区和旅游密集的高山地区就是这种情况，同时租赁市场的农村供应缺口也很大。” 这些地图突显了正在出现的负担能力危机，特别是考虑到负担能力最差地区的人口密度较高时。 经济适用房是一个影响全球许多国家的问题。在欧洲，有证据表明十多年来房价的上涨速度快于收入的上涨速度。 在这项研究中，作者着手确定平均地区收入可以负担多少平方米。 作者的研究基于 ESPON HOUSE4ALL 项目在 30 个国家/地区收集的 2200 万份房产清单。他们根据地区平均收入计算了可负担建筑面积。 然后，这些数据被用来创建地图，显示市级住房负担能力的地理情况。这些地图包括私人...

reflection.en: The dream of a stable home is out of reach for many in Europe, with housing costs consuming disproportionate amounts of income. This economic pressure can feel like a form of bondage, where the pursuit of basic shelter leads to financial servitude. The challenge calls for systemic solutions that prioritize human dignity and access to affordable living.
reflection.zh: 在欧洲，拥有一个稳定住所的梦想对许多人来说遥不可及，住房成本占去了收入的很大一部分。这种经济压力可能感觉像是一种束缚，追求基本住所却导致了经济上的奴役。这一挑战需要系统性的解决方案，优先考虑人的尊严和可负担的生活。

verse.textEn: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
verse.textZh: 富户管辖穷人；欠债的是债主的仆人。

title.en: AI-designed proteins enable a new generation of RNA transporters
title.zh: 人工智能设计的蛋白质促成新一代RNA转运体

summary.en: RNA-based therapeutics, which use RNA as a blueprint for cells to produce specific proteins, require efficient delivery into cells. Current methods using virus-derived vehicles or lipid nanoparticles have limitations. Researchers are developing new, more selective RNA delivery mechanisms, with AI playing a role in...
summary.zh: 基于RNA的疗法使用RNA作为细胞生产特定蛋白质的蓝图，需要有效地将其递送到细胞内部。目前使用病毒衍生载体或脂质纳米颗粒的方法存在局限性。研究人员正在开发新的、更具选择性的RNA递送机制，人工智能在设计用于此目的的新型蛋白质方面发挥着作用。

body.en: RNA-based therapeutics use RNA as a blueprint that enables cells to produce specific proteins—including proteins that can precisely modify genes. For this to work, the RNA must reach the inside of the cell intact. Delivery systems currently used for this purpose include virus-derived vehicles and lipid nanoparticles, tiny particles made of fat-like molecules. Both approaches have limitations. Researchers are therefore working on new mechanisms that can deliver RNA into cells more efficiently and, in the future, more selectively.
body.zh: 基于 RNA 的疗法使用 RNA 作为蓝图，使细胞能够产生特定的蛋白质，包括可以精确修饰基因的蛋白质。为此，RNA 必须完好无损地到达细胞内部。目前用于此目的的递送系统包括病毒衍生的载体和脂质纳米颗粒，即由脂肪类分子制成的微小颗粒。两种方法都有局限性。因此，研究人员正在研究新的机制，以便在未来更有效、更有选择性地将 RNA 递送到细胞中。

reflection.en: The development of AI-designed proteins for RNA transport showcases humanity's growing ability to understand and manipulate the building blocks of life. This scientific pursuit, by observing and learning from the intricate design of creation, reflects the ancient wisdom that true understanding can be found in the natural world around us. It is a testament...
reflection.zh: 人工智能设计的蛋白质用于RNA转运的发展，展示了人类日益增长的理解和操纵生命基本构件的能力。这项科学探索，通过观察和学习造物精妙的设计，体现了古老的智慧——真正的理解可以在我们周围的自然世界中找到。这是对雅伟赐予我们好奇心和创造力的证明。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Widow whose husband died after falling into slurry pit warns of pressure on farmers
title.zh: 丈夫死于粪坑的寡妇警告农民面临的压力

summary.en: Margaret Owen states that 'things are getting worse' following an increase in worker fatalities on British farms. Her husband, Islwyn, died after falling into a slurry pit in 2024, a tragedy that has been brought back to her by the recent deaths of a father and son in similar circumstances. Official figures show 22...
summary.zh: 玛格丽特·欧文表示，“情况正在变得更糟”，此前英国农场工人的死亡人数有所增加。她的丈夫伊斯林于2024年 fall into a slurry pit，这一悲剧因上周一对父子在类似情况下死亡而再次浮现在她脑海中。官方数据显示，2025-26年度有22名农场工人死亡，是十年来最高纪录。

body.en:
The widow of a farmer who died after he fell into a slurry pit has spoken about the stresses facing workers after a rise in deaths.

Margaret Owen said the impact of husband Islwyn's death had been brought back to her once again following reports that a father and son had died in similar circumstances last week.

She said Islwyn had worried about bad weather and recently-introduced rules on slurry spreading when he had fallen at his farm in Bala, Gwynedd, in 2024.

Latest figures from the Health and Safety Executive (HSE) show 22 workers died on British farms during 2025-26 - the highest number in a decade.

Margaret said the number of deaths had made it appear "things are getting worse and worse".

An inquest into Islwyn's death found he had fallen into the slurry pit after he had climbed on to a short wall to adjust some machinery at Cefn Bodig farm in Llanycil, Bala.

He suffered asphyxia along with serious injuries to his right arm and chest caused by the machinery, and his body was found by a neighbour 90 minutes after he was reported missing on the evening of 4 September 2024.

Margaret said that, although it had not been the cause of his death, Islwyn had been under pressure because of a combination of bad weather and the Welsh government's rules that banned farmers from spreading slurry between mid-October to January.

The ban on muck-spreading over winter months to protect rivers is something that Wales' environment minister Llyr Gruffydd has said he wanted to change after Plaid Cymru came into power.

"The weather had been wet and there was a problem with mixing the slurry and emptying the slurry before the cattle came in - it was quite a stressful situation," she told BBC Cymru Fyw.

The deaths of Alan Ford, 72, and his son Rick, 42, after they had fallen into an industrial slurry tank at a farm in Chester on 26 August, had brought back memories of her husband's death, she said.

The 22 deaths of workers on farms in Wales, England and Scotland during 2025-26 was the highest in a decade, and second only to the number of deaths of those working in construction (27), according to HSE figures. , external

But the rate of farm deaths was seven times higher per 100,000 workers, and 21 times more likely than the all-industry average.

"It seems that things are getting worse and worse", Margaret said, and that "four [people] within four miles of here have died in recent years - it's scary isn't it?"

"Islwyn was so careful - one of those rare farmers who wore a helmet," she said.

She said she had known something was wrong on the day Islwyn died "because he was never very late for dinner", and said the nature of his death had been "hard to accept".

Margaret had to sell their farm stock and arrange for other farmers to rent the majority of their...
body.zh: 一名掉入泥浆坑身亡的农民的遗孀谈到了死亡人数上升后工人们面临的压力。 玛格丽特·欧文 (Margaret Owen) 表示，上周有报道称，一对父子在类似情况下死亡，丈夫伊斯文 (Islwyn) 去世的影响再次浮现在她心头。 她说，伊斯文于 2024 年在圭内斯巴拉的农场摔倒，当时他担心恶劣天气，最近出台了关于泥浆扩散的规定。 英国健康与安全执行局 (HSE) 的最新数据显示，2025-26 年间，英国农场有 22 名工人死亡，这是十年来的最高数字。 玛格丽特说，死亡人数表明“情况变得越来越糟”。 对 Islwyn 死亡的调查发现，他在巴拉兰尼西尔的 Cefn Bodig 农场爬上一堵短墙调整一些机械后掉进了泥浆坑。 他因机器造成窒息，右臂和胸部严重受伤，2024 年 9 月 4 日晚，他被报告失踪 90 分钟后，他的尸体被邻居发现。 玛格丽特说，虽然这不是他的死因，但由于恶劣天气和威尔士政府禁止农民在十月中旬至一月期间撒播泥浆的规定，伊斯文一直承受着压力。 威尔士环境部长利尔·格鲁菲德 (Llyr Gruffydd) 表示，在格莱德·西姆鲁 (Plaid Cymru) 上台后，他希望改变冬季月份为保护河流而禁止撒播淤泥的禁令。 她告诉 BBC Cymru Fyw：“天气潮湿，在牛进来之前混合泥浆和清空泥浆存在问题 - 这是一个相当紧张的情况。” 她说，72 岁的艾伦·福特和 42 岁的儿子里克于 8 月 26 日掉进切斯特一家农场的工业泥浆罐后死亡，这让她回想起丈夫的死亡。 根据 HSE 数据，2025-26 年间，威尔士、英格兰和苏格兰农场工人死亡 22 人，为十年来最高，仅次于建筑业工人死亡人数（27 人）。 , external 但每 10 万名工人的农场死亡率高出 7 倍，比全行业平均水平高出 21 倍。 玛格丽特说，“情况似乎变得越来越糟”，“近年来，这里四英里范围内有四个人死亡——这很可怕不是吗？” “伊斯文非常小心——他是罕见的戴头盔的农民之一，”她说。 她说，伊斯文去世的那天，她就知道出了什么问题，“因为他吃晚饭从来没有迟到过”，并表示他的死亡性质“难以接受”。 玛格丽特不得不卖掉他们的农场库存并安排其他农民租用他们的大部分...

reflection.en: The tragic death of Islwyn Owen, and the subsequent warning from his widow Margaret, underscores the immense pressures faced by farmers. The rising number of fatalities, including Islwyn's, highlights a systemic vulnerability. In the face of such hardship and loss, we are called to advocate for those whose livelihoods are precarious and whose voices may be...
reflection.zh: 伊斯林·欧文的悲惨去世以及他的遗孀玛格丽特发出的警告，凸显了农民面临的巨大压力。包括伊斯林在内的死亡人数不断增加，表明存在系统性的脆弱性。面对这样的困境和损失，我们被呼召去为那些生计艰难、在挣扎中可能被忽视的声音发声。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Fish dads offer new insight into behavioral effects of receiving paternal care
title.zh: 鱼爸爸提供关于接受父爱行为影响的新见解

summary.en: The movie 'Finding Nemo' depicted an overprotective single father fish. A new study suggests this portrayal might be closer to reality than previously thought, as research indicates that baby freshwater fish raised by attentive fathers survive better in critical situations than those without such care.
summary.zh: 电影《海底总动员》描绘了一条过度保护的单身父亲鱼。一项新研究表明，这种描绘可能比以往认为的更接近现实，研究表明，由尽职的父亲抚养的淡水鱼宝宝在危急情况下比没有这种照顾的同类存活得更好。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The plot of "Finding Nemo," a film that features an overprotective single father fish taking on dangers at sea to care for his son, may be more reflective of actual fish dad behavior than was previously known. A new study led by a scientist at Penn State found that baby freshwater fish, when raised by dutiful fathers, fare far better than their non-dad-raised peers in life-or-death situations.

After conducting a novel study that included both behavioral observations and brain genomics analyses, the researchers concluded that early paternal care was associated with later behavioral differences and changes in brain gene regulation. The researchers recently reported their findings in Philosophical Transactions B of the Royal Society .

When the team led by Jason Keagy, associate research professor of wildlife behavioral ecology in Penn State's College of Agricultural Sciences, was looking for insight into whether the care a baby receives from its father early in life changes how it behaves later in life, they chose an unusual species to study: threespine stickleback fish . The small fish—adults typically are less than 3 inches long—are native to most waters in northern latitudes, and they have one important quality.

Only stickleback fathers provide care to their offspring. Stickleback mothers do not provide any post-laying parental care; instead, they lay their eggs in the male's nest and immediately leave the territory.

The researchers found that the fish that had received paternal care tended to behave in ways they interpreted as having greater boldness and sociability. And the team reported that paternal care affected brain gene expression.

"Having their father around during the first 10 days appeared to influence how the fish behaved later in life," said Keagy, the study's first author.

By far, most of the research on parental-care effects that has been done with model organisms has been conducted with mice and rats—which are very maternally driven, Keagy noted. Behavioral scientists don't understand the effects of fathers as well as those of mothers, he explained, so they turned to sticklebacks.

When it comes to parenting, fish brains share surprisingly similar deep hormonal and genetic building blocks with human brains, despite lacking the same complex outer cortical structure, Keagy pointed out.

"Sticklebacks are one of the rare species in which fathers exclusively take care of the babies, so it's a good system to study to try to understand what aspects are changed when a different parent is in charge," he said. "Eventually, we can leverage that knowledge to...

reflection.en: The dedication of a father fish, as highlighted in this study, offers a powerful image of nurturing care. It reminds us that positive actions, like devoted parenting, can lead to better outcomes, echoing the call to overcome negativity with goodness. This paternal instinct, seen even in the animal kingdom, points to a deeper principle of sacrificial love...
reflection.zh: 这项研究突显的鱼爸爸的奉献精神，提供了一个充满关爱的有力画面。它提醒我们，积极的行为，如忠诚的育儿，可以带来更好的结果，这与用良善克服消极的呼吁相呼应。这种父爱本能，即使在动物界也能看到，指向了牺牲的爱和保护的更深层原则。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Making superconductors thinner can change how they accommodate magnetic fields
title.zh: 改变超导体的厚度会改变其容纳磁场的方式

summary.en: Researchers are investigating how the behavior of electrons in superconducting films changes when the material becomes so thin that quantum confinement effects become significant. This work aims to understand why reducing the thickness of a superconducting film alters the temperature at which superconductivity appears.
summary.zh: 研究人员正在研究当超导薄膜的材料变得非常薄，以至于量子限制效应变得显著时，其中电子的行为会如何变化。这项工作旨在理解为什么减小超导薄膜的厚度会改变超导性出现的温度。

body.en: What happens when a superconductor becomes so thin that electrons can no longer behave as if they were moving through an ordinary three-dimensional piece of metal? This question has been at the center of my recent work on quantum confinement in metallic films. Over the past few years, I have been developing this line of theory with my colleague Giovanni Ummarino at Politecnico di Torino. Our initial goal was to understand something rather concrete: Why does shrinking the thickness of a superconducting film change the temperature at which superconductivity appears?
body.zh: 当超导体变得如此薄以至于电子不能再像在普通的三维金属片中移动时会发生什么？这个问题一直是我最近关于金属薄膜中量子限制的研究的核心。在过去的几年里，我一直在与都灵理工大学的同事乔瓦尼·乌马里诺（Giovanni Ummarino）一起发展这一理论。我们最初的目标是了解一些相当具体的东西：为什么超导薄膜厚度的缩小会改变超导性出现的温度？

reflection.en: The pursuit of understanding the physical world, even at the quantum level of thin films, reflects a deep human curiosity about creation's intricate workings. As Job 12:7-9 reminds us, 'Ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the sky, and they will tell you... In all these the hand of Yahweh has done this.' The discoveries made through...
reflection.zh: 对物质世界理解的追求，即使是在薄膜的量子层面，也反映了人类对受造界复杂运作的深刻好奇心。正如约伯记12:7-9所提醒我们的，“你可以问走兽，它们会教导你；天空的飞鸟，它们会告诉你……这一切都是雅伟的手所做的。” 通过仔细的观察和实验所取得的发现，揭示了自然秩序中蕴含的智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Hidden DNA in medieval gospels reveals history of deadly livestock virus
title.zh: 中世纪福音书中隐藏的DNA揭示了致命牲畜病毒的历史

summary.en: Some of Europe's most well-known historic manuscripts, including the York Gospels, have been used as biological time capsules to uncover the 3,500-year history of the sheeppox virus (SPPV). By extracting DNA from the animal skins used to make the parchment, researchers have found the first genetic evidence of how this...
summary.zh: 欧洲一些最著名的历史手稿，包括《约克福音书》，已被用作生物时间胶囊，揭示了绵羊痘病毒（SPPV）长达3500年的历史。通过从制作羊皮纸的动物皮中提取DNA，研究人员获得了首个遗传学证据，证明了这种疾病是如何影响欧洲农民的。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Some of Europe's most well-known historic manuscripts, including the York Gospels, have proven to be biological time capsules for uncovering the 3,500-year history of the sheeppox virus (SPPV).

By extracting DNA from the animal skins used to make the documents' centuries-old parchment, an international team of geneticists, historians, virologists, protein chemists and conservators, led by University College Dublin, has provided the first genetic evidence of how this devastating disease plagued European farmers' herds long before the modern era.

A highly contagious disease, sheeppox spreads rapidly and can affect large portions of a flock in a short time.

The disease is particularly dangerous because it can cause very high mortality rates, especially in young animals, and dramatically reduce productivity by damaging wool, meat and milk yields.

"The recovery of ancient DNA of pathogens has completely changed our understanding of infectious disease in the past, and here we show that parchment can also preserve animal pathogen DNA. It is possible that archives and libraries around the world also contain the genetic traces of disease outbreaks in animals in the past," said Louis L'Hôte, a Ph.D. candidate at UCD and lead author of the study.

"These genomes help us understand how these pathogens evolved and how they affected past societies—such as sheeppox virus, which we show has been affecting Eurasian sheep herds for at least three and a half millennia."

In a new study, published in Science Advances , researchers reconstructed more than 3,500 years of sheeppox virus evolution and identified traces of the disease in medieval manuscripts, including several of significant historical importance.

Among the works analyzed were the 1,000-year-old York Gospels, one of the finest illuminated manuscripts surviving from the early Anglo-Saxon period, and earlier manuscripts such as the Corpus Glossary of Corpus Christi College, Cambridge, one of the earliest English dictionaries, and other medieval codices from across Britain and continental Europe.

In several cases, multiple pages from the same manuscript were found to contain sheeppox virus DNA, indicating that infected animals were used in their production.

Because the parchment used to make these documents was made from the hides of livestock like sheep, goats and cattle, it serves as a unique bioarchive, preserving the health of the animal at the time of its death centuries ago.

One of the most unexpected findings from the new study was the detection of sheeppox virus on parchment made from calfskin and goatskin,...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 欧洲一些最著名的历史手稿，包括《约克福音书》，已被证明是揭示羊痘病毒 (SPPV) 3,500 年历史的生物时间胶囊。 由都柏林大学学院领导的一个由遗传学家、历史学家、病毒学家、蛋白质化学家和保护人员组成的国际团队通过从用于制作具有数百年历史的羊皮纸的动物皮毛中提取 DNA，提供了第一个遗传证据，证明这种毁灭性疾病如何在现代之前很久就困扰着欧洲农民的牛群。 羊痘是一种高度传染性的疾病，传播迅速，可在短时间内影响大部分羊群。 这种疾病特别危险，因为它会导致非常高的死亡率，尤其是幼小的动物，并通过损害羊毛、肉类和牛奶产量而大大降低生产力。 “古代病原体DNA的恢复彻底改变了我们对过去传染病的认识，在这里我们证明羊皮纸也可以保存动物病原体DNA。世界各地的档案馆和图书馆有可能也包含过去动物疾病爆发的遗传痕迹，”博士生Louis L'Hôte说道。都柏林大学的候选人和该研究的主要作者。 “这些基因组帮助我们了解这些病原体是如何进化的以及它们如何影响过去的社会——例如羊痘病毒，我们证明这种病毒已经影响欧亚羊群至少三个半世纪了。” 在《科学进展》杂志上发表的一项新研究中，研究人员重建了 3500 多年的羊痘病毒进化史，并在中世纪手稿中发现了该疾病的痕迹，其中包括一些具有重要历史意义的手稿。 分析的作品包括具有 1000 年历史的约克福音书（盎格鲁-撒克逊时期早期幸存的最精美的插图手稿之一）和更早的手稿，例如剑桥科珀斯克里斯蒂学院的语料库词汇表（最早的英语词典之一），以及来自英国和欧洲大陆的其他中世纪抄本。 在一些案例中，同一手稿的多页被发现含有羊痘病毒 DNA，表明其生产过程中使用了受感染的动物。 由于用于制作这些文件的羊皮纸是由绵羊、山羊和牛等牲畜的皮制成的，因此它可以作为独特的生物档案，保存几个世纪前动物死亡时的健康状况。 这项新研究最意想不到的发现之一是在小牛皮和山羊皮制成的羊皮纸上检测到了羊痘病毒，......

reflection.en: The ancient parchment of the York Gospels, once a vessel for sacred text, has become a surprising source of scientific knowledge. This reminds us that Yahweh's wisdom is revealed not only in scripture but also in the intricate details of His creation, accessible through diligent study and observation. Even the remnants of past life, preserved in unexpected...
reflection.zh: 《约克福音书》古老的羊皮纸，曾是神圣文本的载体，如今却成为了科学知识的意外来源。这提醒我们，雅伟的智慧不仅在经文中显明，也蕴藏在他创造的万物细节中，可以通过勤奋的学习和观察来认识。即使是过去生命的遗迹，以意想不到的方式保存下来，也能教导我们关于世界及其历史的知识。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Harnessing gold nanorods and light for targeted cancer therapy
title.zh: 利用金纳米棒和光进行靶向癌症治疗

summary.en: Researchers at IIT Gandhinagar have developed a gold nanorod-based platform that delivers therapeutic agents specifically to the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) within cells and generates heat when exposed to near-infrared light, aiming to selectively destroy cancer cells while sparing healthy ones.
summary.zh: 印度甘地讷格尔理工学院的研究人员开发了一个基于金纳米棒的平台，该平台能将治疗剂特异性地递送到细胞内的内质网（ER），并在暴露于近红外光时产生热量，旨在选择性地摧毁癌细胞，同时保护健康细胞。

body.en: One of the major challenges in the quest to beat cancer is developing treatments that can selectively destroy cancer cells while leaving healthy cells unharmed. With this in mind, researchers at the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IITGN) have devised a gold nanorod-based platform that delivers therapeutic agents specifically to the endoplasmic reticulum (ER), a structure responsible for protein production and processing within cells, while also generating heat when exposed to near-infrared light.
body.zh: 战胜癌症的主要挑战之一是开发能够选择性破坏癌细胞同时保持健康细胞不受伤害的治疗方法。考虑到这一点，印度甘地讷格尔理工学院 (IITGN) 的研究人员设计了一种基于金纳米棒的平台，可将治疗剂专门输送到内质网 (ER)，内质网是一种负责细胞内蛋白质生产和加工的结构，同时在暴露于近红外光时也会产生热量。

reflection.en: The pursuit of healing is a profound human endeavor, reflecting a deep longing for restoration. This research from IIT Gandhinagar offers a glimmer of hope in the difficult fight against cancer, reminding us of the importance of continued prayer and support for those battling illness and for the scientists seeking cures. May we continue to pray for the...
reflection.zh: 寻求治愈是人类一项深刻的追求，它反映了对复原的深切渴望。印度甘地讷格尔理工学院的这项研究为抗击癌症的艰难斗争带来了一线希望，提醒我们持续为病患祈祷和支持，并为寻求治愈的科学家们加油的重要性。 愿我们继续为病人祈祷，使他们能找到医治和力量；也为那些致力于医学研究的人们祈祷，愿他们的工作能为许多人带来安慰和新的希望。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Scientists may have found first hint of dark matter
title.zh: 科学家可能已发现暗物质的第一个迹象

summary.en: Scientists believe they may be one step closer to detecting dark matter for the first time, but the findings have not been verified by independent researchers. The material is thought to make up over 85% of the universe and has eluded detection for nearly a century.
summary.zh: 科学家们认为他们可能更接近于首次探测到暗物质，但这些发现尚未得到独立研究人员的核实。这种物质被认为占宇宙的85%以上，近一个世纪以来一直难以被探测到。

body.en:
Scientists believe they may be one step closer to detecting dark matter for the first time, but the findings have not been verified by independent researchers.

Scientists from the University of Bristol were part of a two-year study to try and measure the invisible substance thought to make up over 85% of the universe.

Using a sensitive detector in an an underground laboratory in the US, the researchers saw an atom and mystery particle colliding.

Lead researcher physicist Dr Sam Eriksen said it could be "the first step in understanding dark matter as a particle", but further research could also reveal that the particle is not related to dark matter.

"Following a huge amount of scientific effort, this is incredibly exciting," the University of Bristol senior research associate added.

Although scientists have long been certain of the existence of dark matter, because it is invisible as it reflects no light.

While it is thought to make up the majority of mass in the universe, it has never been directly detected.

For two years, 250 scientists and engineers from 39 institutions spanning six countries, including two universities from the UK, have rigorously scrutinised data from one of the world's most sensitive dark matter detectors called LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ).

It is managed by the US Department of Energy's Sanford Underground Research Facility in South Dakota - the deepest laboratory in the US at nearly a mile beneath the ground.

To search for dark matter, LZ uses extremely sensitive light detectors to capture particle interactions.

The study found one particle interaction which could potentially have been caused by a Weakly Interacting Massive Particle, (WIMP), which scientists believe make up dark matter.

But there is currently low statistical evidence in it being a true breakthrough.

The findings were revealed at a conference in Japan on Tuesday, but the research has yet to undergo peer-review by other scientists.

The findings have been rated 2.6 sigma, which is the system that marks the statistical significance of discoveries. The normal threshold is five.

"With only one event, we don't want to get ahead of ourselves," said Professor Rick Gaitskell from Brown University.

"We are not claiming to have seen dark matter. But we have seen something interesting that we want to share with the scientific community for their input."

Professor Henning Flaecher, an experimental particle physicist at the University of Bristol, said a "huge amount" of work had been carried out over "countless hours" to investigate any previously known reasons researchers might have observed the unusual reaction.

"It's an incredibly exciting time, the kind of event every astro-particle physicist dreams of, and we can't wait to analyse more data to see if additional...
body.zh: 科学家认为，他们可能距离首次探测暗物质又近了一步，但这一发现尚未得到独立研究人员的证实。 布里斯托大学的科学家参与了一项为期两年的研究，试图测量这种被认为占宇宙 85% 以上的无形物质。 研究人员在美国地下实验室使用灵敏探测器，看到了原子和神秘粒子的碰撞。 首席研究员物理学家萨姆·埃里克森博士表示，这可能是“将暗物质理解为粒子的第一步”，但进一步的研究也可能揭示该粒子与暗物质无关。 “经过大量的科学努力，这是非常令人兴奋的，”布里斯托大学高级研究员补充道。 尽管科学家们早已确定暗物质的存在，但因为它不反射光，所以是不可见的。 虽然它被认为构成了宇宙中的大部分质量，但它从未被直接探测到。 两年来，来自六个国家 39 个机构（包括两所英国大学）的 250 名科学家和工程师严格审查了来自世界上最灵敏的暗物质探测器之一 LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) 的数据。 它由美国能源部位于南达科他州的桑福德地下研究设施管理，该设施是美国最深的实验室，位于地下近一英里处。 为了寻找暗物质，LZ 使用极其灵敏的光探测器来捕捉粒子相互作用。 该研究发现一种粒子相互作用可能是由弱相互作用大质量粒子（WIMP）引起的，科学家认为它构成了暗物质。 但目前很少有统计证据表明它是真正的突破。 该研究结果于周二在日本举行的一次会议上公布，但该研究尚未经过其他科学家的同行评审。 研究结果的评级为 2.6 sigma，该系统标志着发现的统计显着性。正常阈值是五。 布朗大学的里克·盖茨克尔教授说：“只有一项活动，我们不想超出自己的预期。” “我们并不是声称看到了暗物质。但我们看到了一些有趣的东西，我们希望与科学界分享，以征求他们的意见。” 布里斯托大学实验粒子物理学家亨宁·弗莱彻教授表示，已经在“无数个小时”内进行了“大量”工作，以调查研究人员可能观察到这种不寻常反应的任何先前已知原因。 “这是一个令人难以置信的激动人心的时刻，是每个天体粒子物理学家都梦想的事件，我们迫不及待地想分析更多数据，看看是否还有更多……

Their recent, though unverified, potential detection highlights humanity's persistent quest for knowledge through observing the cosmos. As Job 12:7-9 reminds us, 'Ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the air,...

title.en: US medical groups urge people to get flu and Covid shots in counter to Trump guidance
title.zh: 美国医学团体呼吁接种流感和新冠疫苗，以对抗特朗普的指导方针

summary.en: Leading US medical groups are urging people to get updated flu and Covid-19 vaccinations this fall, banding together to issue shot guidelines and highlight the science behind them, aiming to ease confusion caused by the Trump administration’s changing immunization advice.

body.en: Top medical groups band together to ease confusion from Trump administration’s changing immunization advice Leading US medical groups are urging people to get updated flu and Covid-19 vaccinations this fall, banding together on Wednesday to issue shot guidelines – and highlight the science behind them – saying they hope to ease confusion caused by the Trump administration’s changing advice. Flu vaccinations are beginning and the latest coronavirus shots are starting to arrive after the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved this year’s updated versions last week. Winter also brings another vaccine-preventable risk called RSV. Continue reading...

reflection.en: In times of shifting public health guidance, clear, science-based advice is crucial. The collaboration of medical groups to offer unified recommendations demonstrates the value of seeking and heeding expert counsel, especially when navigating complex health decisions. This collective effort aims to bring clarity and confidence to the public.
reflection.zh: 在公共卫生指导方针不断变化的时期，清晰、基于科学的建议至关重要。医学团体联合起来提供统一的建议，这体现了在应对复杂的健康决策时，寻求和听取专家意见的价值。这种集体努力旨在为公众带来清晰和信心。

verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Interstellar solar sails hit a strange problem at 75% of light speed
title.zh: 星际太阳帆在光速的75%时遇到奇怪的问题

summary.en: Solar sails propelled by powerful lasers could achieve incredible speeds, but relativity might eventually cause the light itself to impede them. At approximately 75% of the speed of light, scattered photons can create drag, presenting a surprising obstacle to interstellar travel.
summary.zh: 由强大激光驱动的太阳帆可以达到惊人的速度，但相对论最终可能会使光本身成为阻碍。在光速的75%左右，散射的光子会产生阻力，为星际旅行带来了令人惊讶的障碍。

body.en:
Reaching another star within a practical amount of time will require something far more capable than chemical rockets. One of the leading ideas is a solar sail, a large reflective structure that can be pushed by light. If extremely powerful lasers are aimed at such a sail, they could accelerate it to speeds well beyond what current propulsion systems can achieve.

But there may be an unexpected problem once a lightsail begins traveling at a significant fraction of the speed of light. According to a new paper on arXiv by Chao Shen and Jiaze Li of the Harbin Institute of Technology, the same light used to propel the sail could eventually produce a drag effect.

The researchers separate the forces produced by photons striking a solar sail into three categories.

The strongest contribution comes from incident light (that raw momentum of the photons hitting the sail). Next is specular reflection (momentum imparted when photons bounce perfectly off the sail). The weakest contribution comes from diffuse scattering (momentum from photons that are absorbed by the sail then reemitted in random directions).

At relatively low speeds, these effects all contribute to pushing the sail forward. The situation becomes much more complicated once the spacecraft reaches relativistic velocities.

As the sail races away from the laser source, the light reaching it undergoes an increasingly strong Doppler shift. The frequency of the incoming light decreases, reducing the amount of thrust produced by all three components.

As a result, continued acceleration becomes progressively less efficient. The faster the sail travels, the harder it becomes for the laser to keep increasing its speed.

The situation changes even more dramatically once the lightsail reaches about 75% of the speed of light.

At that speed, relativistic light aberration becomes important. From the viewpoint of a stationary observer on Earth, diffusely scattered light begins to be directed forward, toward the direction in which the sail is traveling.

Because every action has an equal and opposite reaction, that forward-directed radiation produces a force in the opposite direction. This means diffuse scattering (admittedly the weakest of the three forces) begins acting as drag once the sail passes roughly 75% of the speed of light.

The laser is still pushing the sail forward overall, so the total force does not become negative. However, the efficiency of the propulsion system drops substantially.

The study is focused specifically on radiative dynamics. It does not include nonradiative effects such as collisions and drag from interstellar gas or dust.

It also leaves out the thermal limits of real sail materials. A sail exposed to an extremely powerful laser could potentially overheat or even melt.

body.zh: 在实际时间内到达另一颗恒星将需要比化学火箭能力更强的东西。其中一个领先的想法是太阳帆，这是一种可以由光推动的大型反射结构。如果极其强大的激光瞄准这样的帆，它们可以将其加速到远远超出当前推进系统所能达到的速度。 但一旦光帆开始以光速的很大一部分行驶，可能会出现意想不到的问题。根据哈尔滨工业大学沉超和李嘉泽在 arXiv 上发表的一篇新论文，用于推进帆的相同光最终可能会产生阻力效果。 研究人员将光子撞击太阳帆产生的力分为三类。 最强的贡献来自入射光（光子撞击帆的原始动量）。接下来是镜面反射（当光子从帆上完美反弹时产生的动量）。最弱的贡献来自漫散射（被帆吸收然后以随机方向重新发射的光子的动量）。 在相对较低的速度下，这些效应都有助于推动帆前进。一旦航天器达到相对论速度，情况就会变得更加复杂。 当帆远离激光源时，到达它的光会经历越来越强的多普勒频移。入射光的频率降低，从而减少了所有三个部件产生的推力。 结果，持续加速的效率逐渐降低。帆行进的速度越快，激光就越难保持其速度。 一旦光帆达到光速的 75% 左右，情况就会发生更大的变化。 在这样的速度下，相对论光像差变得很重要。从地球上静止的观察者的角度来看，漫散射光开始向前引导，朝向帆行驶的方向。 因为每个动作都有相等且相反的反应，所以向前的辐射会产生相反方向的力。这意味着一旦帆经过大约 75% 的光速，漫散射（公认的三种力中最弱的一种）就开始充当阻力。 激光仍然在整体上推动帆前进，因此总力不会变成负值。然而，推进系统的效率大幅下降。 该研究特别关注辐射动力学。它不包括非辐射效应，例如星际气体或尘埃的碰撞和阻力。 它还忽略了真实帆材料的热限制。暴露在极其强大的激光下的帆可能会过热甚至融化。 为了...

reflection.en: Humanity's quest to explore the stars, as described in this report on solar sails, is a testament to our God-given curiosity and ingenuity. Yet, as we push the boundaries of physics, we encounter the universe's intricate laws, reminding us that even our most advanced knowledge is still unfolding. The prophet Daniel foresaw a time when 'knowledge shall...
reflection.zh: 人类探索星辰的追求，正如这篇关于太阳帆的报道所述，证明了我们上帝所赐的好奇心和创造力。然而，当我们突破物理学的界限时，我们会遇到宇宙错综复杂的定律，这提醒我们，即使是我们最先进的知识仍在不断发展。先知但以理预见到一个“知识必增长”的时代——这恰如其分地描述了我们持续的科学探索。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Money problems may age your brain faster
title.zh: 金钱问题可能加速您的大脑衰老

summary.en: New research indicates that enduring financial difficulties in early and middle adulthood are associated with diminished cognitive abilities and increased signs of brain aging by later life. The study suggests that chronic stress and worry stemming from financial hardship may progressively harm the brain.
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，成年早期和中期持续的经济困难与晚年认知能力下降和大脑衰老迹象增加有关。研究表明，经济困难带来的慢性压力和担忧可能逐渐损害大脑。

body.en:
Persistent financial hardship may speed up age-related cognitive decline, according to new research led by University College London (UCL).

Published in Innovation in Aging , the study analyzed information from 2,759 people in the UK who completed questionnaires across much of their lives through the MRC National Survey of Health and Development (also known as the 1946 British cohort study).

Researchers found that people who faced ongoing financial difficulties or persistently low income during early and middle adulthood tended to perform worse on cognitive tests by the age of 53.

Among a subgroup who later underwent brain scans, persistent low income was also associated with poorer brain health (including more brain shrinkage) in later life (ages 69 to 71).

These associations remained after the researchers accounted for other factors that could have influenced the results, including childhood cognitive ability, education level and childhood disadvantage.

Corresponding author Dr. Jacques Wels (Unit for Lifelong Health & Ageing at UCL) said: "Most studies on cognitive aging look at financial hardship at only a single point in time. Our study using several decades of data allows us to see that it is the accumulation of hardship over many years that is linked to the worst cognitive health outcomes, rather than occasional episodes of adversity."

Senior author Professor Praveetha Patalay (Unit for Lifelong Health & Ageing and Centre for Longitudinal Studies, UCL) said: "Our findings suggest that supporting people facing financial hardship and reducing chronic poverty could also help prevent cognitive decline and dementia cases in the future."

The relationship between financial adversity and poorer brain health later in life appeared especially strong among men, people who had experienced childhood disadvantage, and those who carried APOE-ε4, a genetic variant associated with an increased risk of Alzheimer's disease.

Men who experienced persistent financial adversity also performed worse on cognitive tests at age 53 than their female counterparts.

The researchers suggested several possible explanations for this difference. Disadvantaged men may have been more likely than disadvantaged women to engage in unhealthy behaviors (such as smoking and alcohol misuse). Men in this generation may also have experienced financial strain differently because they were more likely to have been the primary breadwinners in this cohort born in 1946.

Several biological and psychological pathways could help explain the connection between financial hardship and cognitive aging.

One possibility is inflammation. Chronic stress can promote inflammation, which is known to contribute to faster brain aging.

Persistent concern about finances could also increase...
body.zh: 伦敦大学学院（UCL）领导的最新研究表明，持续的经济困难可能会加速与年龄相关的认知能力下降。 该研究发表在《老龄化创新》杂志上，分析了 2,759 名英国人的信息，这些人通过 MRC 国家健康与发展调查（也称为 1946 年英国队列研究）完成了一生中大部分时间的调查问卷。 研究人员发现，在成年早期和中期面临持续经济困难或持续低收入的人到 53 岁时在认知测试中往往表现较差。 在后来接受脑部扫描的一个亚群中，持续的低收入也与晚年（69 至 71 岁）大脑健康状况较差（包括更多的大脑萎缩）有关。 在研究人员考虑了可能影响结果的其他因素（包括儿童认知能力、教育水平和儿童劣势）后，这些关联仍然存在。 通讯作者雅克·韦尔斯博士（伦敦大学学院终身健康与老龄化部门）表示：“大多数关于认知衰老的研究只着眼于单个时间点的经济困难。我们使用数十年数据的研究使我们看到，与最糟糕的认知健康结果相关的是多年困难的积累，而不是偶尔的逆境。” 资深作者 Praveetha Patalay 教授（伦敦大学学院终身健康与老龄化部门和纵向研究中心）表示：“我们的研究结果表明，支持面临经济困难的人们和减少长期贫困也有助于预防未来的认知能力下降和痴呆症病例。” 经济逆境与晚年大脑健康状况不佳之间的关系在男性、童年经历过不利条件的人和携带 APOE-ε4（一种与阿尔茨海默氏病风险增加相关的基因变异）的人中显得尤其强烈。 经历持续的经济逆境的男性在 53 岁时的认知测试中也表现得比女性同行更差。 研究人员对这种差异提出了几种可能的解释。弱势男性可能比弱势女性更有可能从事不健康行为（例如吸烟和酗酒）。这一代的男性也可能经历了不同的经济压力，因为他们更有可能是 1946 年出生的这一代人中的主要养家糊口者。 一些生物和心理途径可以帮助解释经济困难和认知衰老之间的联系。 一种可能性是炎症。慢性压力会促进炎症，众所周知，炎症会加速大脑老化。 对财务状况的持续担忧也可能会增加......

reflection.en: This study highlights how persistent financial struggles can take a tangible toll on our cognitive health, accelerating brain aging. It serves as a somber reminder of the profound impact of our circumstances on our well-being, urging us to seek wisdom in how we navigate life's challenges and value our time.
reflection.zh: 这项研究强调，持续的经济困境会对我们的认知健康造成切实的损害，加速大脑衰老。它警示我们，生活环境对身心健康的深远影响，并促使我们在应对生活挑战和珍惜时光时寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
verse.textZh: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子，好叫我们得着智慧的心。

title.en: Alzheimer’s may leave a mark on the brain long before plaques appear
title.zh: 阿尔茨海默病可能在斑块出现前很久就在大脑留下印记

summary.en: New research suggests that brain changes linked to Alzheimer's disease may begin at least seven years before amyloid plaques are detectable by current PET scans. Scientists tracked healthy older adults using repeated brain imaging over nearly two decades, identifying structural changes years before plaques became...
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，与阿尔茨海默病相关的脑部变化可能在现有PET扫描可检测到淀粉样蛋白斑块之前的至少七年就开始出现。研究人员通过对健康老年人近二十年的重复脑部成像追踪，在斑块变得可见前数年就识别出了结构性变化。

body.en:
A new study suggests that brain imaging could reveal changes linked to Alzheimer's disease more than seven years earlier than researchers previously believed. The work was led by scientists in the Department of Psychology at the University of Oslo and was published in Nature Neuroscience.

The study suggests that the current gold standard for Alzheimer's imaging (amyloid-PET) may not be sensitive enough to capture some of the earliest brain changes associated with the disease. These include processes related to the buildup of amyloid plaques. The researchers identified structural changes in the brain at least seven years before plaques became visible on scans.

"We found that structural changes in the brain occur many years before high levels of plaque are seen on PET scans, which is the brain scan currently used to identify the earliest signs of Alzheimer's disease," says James Michael Roe.

At the time the research was carried out, Roe was a postdoctoral researcher at the Center for Lifespan Changes in Brain and Cognition (LCBC) at the Department of Psychology, University of Oslo. He now works as International Scientific Lead at Cercare Medical. Roe was the study's main researcher while working at LCBC.

According to Roe, the results suggest that disease-related processes may already be developing in the brain long before they can be seen with today's most sensitive imaging methods.

"We found the earliest signal detected on brain scans to date, which could be useful for tracking the disease before symptoms emerge and may help with earlier detection," he says.

To uncover these early changes, the researchers followed healthy individuals who underwent regular brain scans (MRI) for nearly 20 years. The long span of imaging data allowed the team to determine when plaques first became detectable and which participants eventually developed them.

The researchers then looked back at MRI scans collected during the previous decade. They compared changes in brain structure among people who later showed plaques with changes seen in people who did not.

"The most groundbreaking aspect of this study is that we found structural changes in the brain many years before the first signs of plaque buildup, which is considered to be the earliest sign of Alzheimer's disease," says Anders Martin Fjell, Professor at the Department of Psychology, and head of LCBC.

"These are cognitively well-functioning older individuals. What is unique here is that we have examined changes in brain structure in the years before the first scan revealed plaques," says Fjell.

Fjell notes that Alzheimer's disease remains extremely difficult to treat. One reason is that it is closely connected with aging and is probably influenced by several different biological factors.

"These findings...
body.zh: 一项新的研究表明，大脑成像可以比研究人员之前认为的早七年多揭示与阿尔茨海默病相关的变化。这项工作由奥斯陆大学心理学系的科学家领导，并发表在《自然神经科学》杂志上。 该研究表明，目前阿尔茨海默病成像的黄金标准（淀粉样蛋白-PET）可能不够灵敏，无法捕捉到与该疾病相关的一些最早的大脑变化。这些包括与淀粉样斑块形成相关的过程。研究人员在斑块在扫描中变得可见之前至少七年就发现了大脑的结构变化。 詹姆斯·迈克尔·罗伊 (James Michael Roe) 表示：“我们发现，在 PET 扫描中看到大量斑块之前，大脑的结构变化就已经发生了很多年，而 PET 扫描是目前用于识别阿尔茨海默病最早迹象的脑部扫描。” 在进行这项研究时，罗伊是奥斯陆大学心理学系大脑和认知寿命变化中心（LCBC）的博士后研究员。他现在担任 Cercare Medical 的国际科学主管。 Roe 在 LCBC 工作期间是该研究的主要研究员。 罗伊表示，研究结果表明，与疾病相关的过程可能早在当今最灵敏的成像方法能够看到之前就已经在大脑中形成了。 他说：“我们发现了迄今为止在脑部扫描中检测到的最早信号，这可能有助于在症状出现之前追踪疾病，并可能有助于早期检测。” 为了发现这些早期变化，研究人员对定期接受脑部扫描 (MRI) 的健康个体进行了近 20 年的跟踪调查。长跨度的成像数据使团队能够确定斑块首次被检测到的时间以及哪些参与者最终出现了斑块。 研究人员随后回顾了过去十年收集的核磁共振扫描结果。他们比较了后来出现斑块的人和没有出现斑块的人的大脑结构变化。 “这项研究最具开创性的一点是，我们在斑块形成的最初迹象出现之前很多年就发现了大脑的结构变化，这被认为是阿尔茨海默病的最早迹象，”心理学系教授兼 LCBC 负责人 Anders Martin Fjell 说。 “这些都是认知功能良好的老年人。这里的独特之处在于，我们在第一次扫描显示斑块之前的几年里就检查了大脑结构的变化，”菲杰尔说。 菲杰尔指出，阿尔茨海默病仍然极难治疗。原因之一是它与衰老密切相关，并且可能受到多种不同生物因素的影响。 “这些发现...

reflection.en: The intricate workings of the human brain, even in its earliest stages of decline, are a testament to the complex design of creation. This research, by observing and understanding these subtle changes, reflects a deep engagement with the mysteries Yahweh has woven into our physical being. It reminds us that even in the face of disease, the pursuit of...
reflection.zh: 人类大脑的复杂运作，即使在其衰退的早期阶段，也证明了造物主设计的精妙。这项研究通过观察和理解这些细微的变化，体现了对雅伟编织在我们物质存在中的奥秘的深刻探索。它提醒我们，即使面对疾病，对我们身体的知识追求也可以是对造物主工巧的尊崇。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: A coffee-table-size scorpion roamed Earth before forests existed
title.zh: 一种咖啡桌大小的蝎子在森林存在之前就已漫游地球

summary.en: A meter-long scorpion with massive pincers stalked ancient Britain 415 million years ago, long before forests and the better-known age of giant insects. Its surprising size and possible semi-aquatic lifestyle could reshape ideas about how early arthropods became giants.
summary.zh: 一种拥有巨大螯的、长达一米的蝎子在 4.15 亿年前的古代英国游荡，远在森林和更广为人知的巨型昆虫时代之前。它令人惊讶的体型和可能的半水生生活方式可能会重塑人们对早期节肢动物如何长成巨型的看法。

body.en:
A newly analyzed fossil predator from what is now England and Wales has been identified as the largest scorpion known to science. Researchers from The University of Manchester and the Natural History Museum reached the conclusion after revisiting fossils that had remained in museum collections for more than 150 years.

The animal, Praearcturus gigas , reached roughly one meter in length and carried pincers more than 16 centimeters long. Around 415 million years ago, it would have been an imposing predator in the floodplain environments of the Early Devonian.

A study published in Palaeontology used modern analytical methods and comparisons with more recently described fossil species to determine that Praearcturus was a scorpion and represented a distinct species.

Dr. Richard J. Howard, Curator of Fossil Arthropods at the Natural History Museum, London, and lead author of the study, said: "When we think of giant arthropods, people often picture Carboniferous rainforests with giant millipedes or dragonfly-like insects from later in Earth's history. But Praearcturus lived at least 50 million years earlier, well before the evolution of trees, when life on land was only just getting started.

"Confirming that this animal is a scorpion fundamentally changes our understanding of how and when these creatures evolved to such extraordinary sizes."

The discovery pushes the story of giant arthropods much further back in time than the period usually associated with enormous insects and other invertebrates.

Dr. Russell Garwood, Paleontologist at The University of Manchester, added: " Praearcturus has puzzled us paleontologists for more than a century. By bringing together material from several collections and using cutting-edge imaging techniques, we've been able to build a clearer picture of the animal than was previously possible, which is really exciting.

"What makes Praearcturus so interesting is that it became enormous at a time when life on land was otherwise very small. But it was a world that could somehow support a giant predator. To try and better understand this ancient world, we compared the size of fossil scorpions with other animals alive at the time. To reach such extraordinary sizes, and conclude that perhaps it lived in water, where life was bigger."

Praearcturus gigas lived during the Early Devonian, when terrestrial ecosystems were still in their infancy. Small plants and fungi had only recently begun spreading across the landscape, while forests and other complex land ecosystems had not yet developed.

That timing is important because Praearcturus lived before the high atmospheric oxygen levels associated with the later rise of forests. Those oxygen-rich conditions have often been linked to the enormous size of some later...
body.zh: 最近分析的来自现在英格兰和威尔士的捕食者化石已被确定为科学界已知的最大的蝎子。曼彻斯特大学和自然历史博物馆的研究人员在重新审视博物馆收藏了 150 多年的化石后得出了这一结论。 这种动物名为 Praearcturus gigas，体长约一米，钳子长度超过 16 厘米。大约 4.15 亿年前，它在早泥盆世的洪泛平原环境中是一种强大的掠食者。 发表在《古生物学》上的一项研究使用现代分析方法并与最近描述的化石物种进行比较，以确定 Praearcturus 是一种蝎子并且代表了一个独特的物种。 伦敦自然历史博物馆化石节肢动物馆长、该研究的主要作者理查德·J·霍华德博士说：“当我们想到巨型节肢动物时，人们经常会想到石炭纪雨林中生活着地球历史后期的巨型千足虫或蜻蜓状昆虫。但前陆龙生活在至少 5000 万年前，远远早于树木的进化，当时陆地上的生命才刚刚开始。 “确认这种动物是蝎子，从根本上改变了我们对这些生物如何以及何时进化到如此非凡体型的理解。” 这一发现将巨型节肢动物的故事推向了比通常与巨型昆虫和其他无脊椎动物相关的时期更早的时期。 曼彻斯特大学古生物学家拉塞尔·加伍德博士补充道：“近一个多世纪以来，近陆龙一直困扰着我们古生物学家。通过汇集多个收藏的材料并使用尖端的成像技术，我们已经能够比以前更清晰地了解该动物，这确实令人兴奋。 “使近地龙如此有趣的是，当陆地上的生命非常渺小时，它就变得非常巨大。但它是一个可以以某种方式支持巨型捕食者的世界。为了尝试更好地了解这个古老的世界，我们将蝎子化石的大小与当时活着的其他动物进行了比较。为了达到如此非凡的大小，并得出结论，它可能生活在水中，那里的生命更大。” Praearcturus gigas生活在泥盆纪早期，当时陆地生态系统仍处于起步阶段。小型植物和真菌最近才开始在这片土地上蔓延，而森林和其他复杂的陆地生态系统尚未发育。 这个时机很重要，因为近地龙生活在大气含氧量较高、森林后来兴起之前。这些富含氧气的条件通常与后来的一些巨大的尺寸有关......

reflection.en: The discovery of Praearcturus gigas, a scorpion that reached a meter in length 415 million years ago, reminds us that the natural world holds profound lessons. As Job observed, the creatures of the earth can teach us much about the Creator's wisdom and power. This ancient predator, existing long before forests, invites us to marvel at the deep history of...
reflection.zh: 发现长达一米的蝎子 Praearcturus gigas，生活在 4.15 亿年前，提醒我们自然界蕴含着深刻的教训。正如约伯所观察到的，地上的生物可以教会我们许多关于创造者的智慧和能力。这种古老的捕食者，存在于森林出现很久之前，邀请我们惊叹于生命的深厚历史以及编织在受造物中的精巧设计。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Astronauts set out on rare all-female spacewalk
title.zh: 宇航员进行罕见的首次全女性太空行走

summary.en: For the sixth time in history, a team of two women completed a spacewalk outside the International Space Station.
summary.zh: 历史上第六次，一支由两名女性组成的团队完成了在国际空间站外的太空行走。

title.en: Too much coffee may weaken bones, study finds
title.zh: 研究发现：过量饮用咖啡可能损害骨骼

summary.en: A decade-long study of nearly 10,000 women aged 65 and older found that while moderate coffee intake showed no harm, consuming more than five cups daily was linked to lower bone density. Tea consumption, conversely, was associated with slightly higher hip bone density. These findings are significant given the...
summary.zh: 一项对近一万名65岁及以上女性进行的为期十年的研究发现，适量饮用咖啡似乎没有危害，但每天饮用超过五杯与较低的骨密度相关。相比之下，饮茶与髋骨密度略高相关。鉴于咖啡和茶的广泛消费以及骨质疏松症这一全球性健康问题，这些发现具有重要意义。

body.en:
Researchers at Flinders University have found new evidence that coffee and tea may have different relationships with bone health in older women.

Published in Nutrients , the study tracked nearly 10,000 women aged 65 and older for 10 years. The researchers examined whether regular coffee and tea consumption was associated with changes in bone mineral density (BMD), an important measure used to assess osteoporosis risk.

Osteoporosis is a major health problem worldwide. It affects roughly one in three women over age 50 and is responsible for millions of fractures each year. Because billions of people drink coffee or tea every day, even small effects on bone health could have broad implications. Previous research on the subject has produced mixed findings, and relatively few studies have followed participants for such a long period.

The Flinders University researchers used data from the Study of Osteoporotic Fractures. They repeatedly assessed participants' beverage habits and measured BMD at both the hip and femoral neck, two areas closely linked to fracture risk.

During the 10-year study period, the women regularly reported how much coffee and tea they drank. Researchers also used advanced imaging methods to monitor changes in their bone density.

The results showed that women who drank tea had slightly higher total hip BMD than those who did not drink tea. The difference was small, but it was statistically significant and could still matter when considered across large populations.

"Even small improvements in bone density can translate into fewer fractures across large groups," says Adjunct Associate Professor Enwu Liu from the College of Medicine and Public Health.

Coffee showed a more complicated pattern. Drinking moderate amounts, about two to three cups per day, was not associated with harm to bone health. However, women who drank more than five cups a day had lower BMD, suggesting that very high coffee consumption could have negative effects.

The relationship also appeared to differ depending on other health and lifestyle factors. Women with higher lifetime alcohol consumption experienced stronger negative effects associated with coffee, while the apparent benefits of tea were more pronounced among women with obesity.

Ryan Liu, co-author on the paper, says that compounds called catechins, abundant in tea, may promote bone formation and slow bone breakdown.

"Coffee's caffeine content, by contrast, has been shown in laboratory studies to interfere with calcium absorption and bone metabolism, though these effects are small and can be offset by adding milk," says Ryan Liu from Flinders University.

Adjunct Associate Professor Enwu Liu adds that the findings suggest that regularly drinking tea could offer a simple way to support bone health...
body.zh: 弗林德斯大学的研究人员发现了新的证据，表明咖啡和茶可能与老年女性的骨骼健康有不同的关系。 该研究发表在《营养》杂志上，对近 10,000 名 65 岁及以上的女性进行了长达 10 年的跟踪调查。研究人员检查了经常饮用咖啡和茶是否与骨矿物质密度（BMD）的变化有关，骨矿物质密度是评估骨质疏松症风险的重要指标。 骨质疏松症是世界范围内的一个主要健康问题。它影响大约三分之一的 50 岁以上女性，每年导致数百万例骨折。由于数十亿人每天喝咖啡或茶，即使对骨骼健康的微小影响也可能产生广泛的影响。之前关于这一主题的研究得出了不同的结果，而且相对较少的研究对参与者进行了如此长时间的跟踪。 弗林德斯大学的研究人员使用了骨质疏松性骨折研究的数据。他们反复评估参与者的饮酒习惯，并测量髋部和股骨颈的骨密度，这两个区域与骨折风险密切相关。 在为期 10 年的研究期间，这些女性定期报告她们喝了多少咖啡和茶。研究人员还使用先进的成像方法来监测骨密度的变化。 结果显示，喝茶的女性髋部总骨密度略高于不喝茶的女性。差异很小，但具有统计显着性，并且在考虑到大量人群时仍然很重要。 医学与公共卫生学院的兼职副教授 Enwu Liu 表示：“即使骨密度的微小改善也可以减少大群体的骨折。” 咖啡呈现出更复杂的模式。适量饮酒（每天约两到三杯）不会对骨骼健康造成损害。然而，每天喝五杯以上的女性的骨密度较低，这表明大量喝咖啡可能会产生负面影响。 这种关系似乎也因其他健康和生活方式因素而异。终生饮酒量较高的女性与咖啡相关的负面影响更强，而茶的明显益处在肥胖女性中更为明显。 该论文的合著者 Ryan Liu 表示，茶叶中富含儿茶素，可能会促进骨骼形成并减缓骨骼分解。 “相比之下，实验室研究表明，咖啡中的咖啡因含量会干扰钙吸收和骨代谢，尽管这些影响很小，可以通过添加牛奶来抵消，”弗林德斯大学的 Ryan Liu 说。 兼职副教授刘恩武补充说，研究结果表明，经常喝茶可以提供一种支持骨骼健康的简单方法......

reflection.en: The study highlights how daily habits can impact our physical well-being, particularly bone health in older women. It prompts us to consider our bodies as intricate creations, wonderfully made and deserving of care. As we navigate lifestyle choices, we can reflect on the Psalmist's awe at being "fearfully and wonderfully made," recognizing the delicate...
reflection.zh: 这项研究强调了日常习惯如何影响我们的身体健康，尤其是在老年女性的骨骼健康方面。它促使我们思考，我们的身体是奇妙的受造之物，值得我们去呵护。在我们做出生活方式的选择时，可以反思诗篇作者对“我被造，奇妙可畏”的惊叹，认识到我们身体内部精妙的平衡。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

Using publicly available data from 2006-2023, the study, which was commissioned by Pesticide Action Network , found there to be an estimated 402-433m cases of unintentional acute pesticide poisoning of farmers and farm workers every year. title.en: Could humans ever communicate with whales? - video
title.zh: 人类能否与鲸鱼交流？- 视频

summary.en: Since the first recording of whale song in 1949, researchers have been fascinated by their complex vocalizations. As technology advances, scientists are deciphering these intricate patterns to better understand and protect whales from human-caused harm.
summary.zh: 自1949年首次录制鲸鱼歌声以来，研究人员一直被它们复杂的发声所吸引。随着技术的进步，科学家们正在破译这些复杂的模式，以更好地理解并保护鲸鱼免受人类的伤害。

body.en: Ever since the earliest known recording of whale song was made in 1949 , researchers have been captivated by the wails, rumbles, clicks, grunts and squeals of their communication. As technology improves, scientists are decoding the intricate patterns that make different species’ vocalisations distinctive. Madeleine Finlay hears from Emma Bryce, a journalist who has spent months investigating human efforts to understand whale song. She explains how this knowledge could help us better protect whales from human-made harms. Credits: 1. Valeria Vergara/Raincoast Conservation Foundation 2.
