reflection.en: The deep sea holds mysteries, and the complex songs of whales are one of them. For decades, humans have listened, trying to understand. This pursuit of knowledge about creation mirrors the ancient truth that the heavens and earth declare the glory and wisdom of Yahweh, inviting us to observe and learn.
reflection.zh: 深海充满了奥秘，鲸鱼复杂的歌声便是其中之一。几十年来，人类一直在倾听，试图理解。这种对受造之物的求知欲，恰恰映照了古老的真理：诸天述说雅伟的荣耀，穹苍传扬祂的作为，邀请我们观察和学习。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: ‘Superhuman’ AI tool spots heart disease in less than 2 seconds
title.zh: “超人”人工智能工具2秒内发现心脏病

summary.en: A new AI tool, trained on millions of routine ECGs, can detect heart disease in under two seconds by analyzing data beyond human visual capacity. This technology aims to expedite treatment for high-risk patients, potentially reducing the need for lengthy waits for echocardiograms.
summary.zh: 一款新的人工智能工具，通过对数百万份常规心电图进行训练，能在两秒内发现心脏病，其分析能力超越了人眼所能见的范畴。该技术旨在加快高风险患者的治疗进程，并可能减少对需要长时间等待的超声心动图检查的依赖。

body.en:
Doctors have developed a “superhuman” AI tool that can spot heart disease in less than two seconds.

The groundbreaking technology has been trained on millions of patients and works by extracting more information from a routine electrocardiogram (ECG) than the human eye can typically see.

The traditional ECG, which records electrical activity in the heart, including the rate and rhythm, has been a vital medical tool in diagnosing heart attacks and abnormal heart rhythms for a century.

But it cannot detect heart disease. That requires an echocardiogram, a type of ultrasound scan, which patients often have to wait months for.

Now a team have developed an AI tool that can spot signs of heart failure and heart valve disease – two of the most common forms of heart disease – from ECG results in “the blink of an eye”.

Details of the breakthrough, which could boost early diagnosis of heart disease, were presented to thousands of delegates at the European Society of Cardiology annual congress in Munich, the world’s largest heart conference.

Early diagnosis is vital for heart failure and heart valve disease, enabling those who need lifesaving medicines to be spotted sooner, before they become dangerously unwell.

The development is being seen as potentially significant, because ECGs are one of the most common tests in medicine, with about a billion performed worldwide each year.

In a trial involving 67,000 patients in the US, the AI tool was able to identify up to 81% of those who had heart failure, and up to 90% of those with heart valve disease.

Dr Sonya Babu-Narayan, a consultant cardiologist and clinical director of the British Heart Foundation (BHF), which funded the trial, said: “It is exciting to see that AI can now deliver a read-out from an ECG in what feels like the blink of an eye.

“Technology like the AI ECG in this research, which has the potential to identify high-risk patients early, will not detect everyone with a heart condition. But it could be a solution to help fast-track the patients who are most likely to have a heart abnormality. When it comes to the heart, earlier diagnosis and treatment saves and improves lives.”

The tech cannot be used on its own to definitively diagnose or rule out heart failure or heart valve disease, but it gives a very strong indication someone may have them.

Someone judged as highly likely to have either could be sent rapidly for an echocardiogram, rather than wait months on the standard waiting lists. That could mean a quicker diagnosis which would enable them to start treatment earlier.

Prof Fu Siong Ng, a professor of cardiology at Imperial College London, said: “Patients can often wait several months for a heart ultrasound scan after being referred for one by their doctor.

“This makes it exciting...
body.zh: 医生们开发出了一种“超人”的人工智能工具，可以在不到两秒的时间内发现心脏病。 这项突破性的技术已经在数百万患者身上进行了培训，其工作原理是从常规心电图 (ECG) 中提取比人眼通常可以看到的更多信息。 传统的心电图记录心脏的电活动，包括心率和节律，一个世纪以来一直是诊断心脏病和心律失常的重要医疗工具。 但它无法检测心脏病。这需要超声心动图（一种超声波扫描），患者通常需要等待数月。 现在，一个团队开发了一种人工智能工具，可以根据“眨眼间”的心电图结果发现心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病（两种最常见的心脏病形式）的迹象。 这一突破的细节可以促进心脏病的早期诊断，在慕尼黑举行的欧洲心脏病学会年会上向数千名代表介绍了这一突破，这是世界上最大的心脏病会议。 早期诊断对于心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病至关重要，使那些需要救生药物的人能够在出现危险的不适之前尽早发现。 这一发展被认为具有潜在的重大意义，因为心电图是医学中最常见的测试之一，全世界每年进行约十亿次。 在美国一项涉及 67,000 名患者的试验中，AI 工具能够识别出高达 81% 的心力衰竭患者和高达 90% 的心脏瓣膜疾病患者。 资助这项试验的英国心脏基金会 (BHF) 的心脏病专家兼临床主任索尼娅·巴布-纳拉扬 (Sonya Babu-Narayan) 博士表示：“令人兴奋的是，人工智能现在可以在眨眼的时间内读取心电图读数。 “这项研究中的人工智能心电图等技术有可能及早识别出高危患者，但无法检测出每个患有心脏病的人。但这可能是帮助快速追踪最有可能患有心脏异常的患者的解决方案。当涉及到心脏时，早期诊断和治疗可以挽救并改善生命。” 该技术不能单独用于明确诊断或排除心力衰竭或心脏瓣膜疾病，但它给出了一个非常强烈的迹象，表明某人可能患有这些疾病。 被判断为极有可能患有这两种疾病的人可以被迅速送去做超声心动图检查，而不是在标准等待名单上等待数月。这可能意味着更快的诊断，使他们能够更早地开始治疗。 伦敦帝国理工学院心脏病学教授 Fu Siong Ng 教授表示：“在医生推荐进行心脏超声扫描后，患者通常需要等待几个月才能进行心脏超声扫描。 “这让人兴奋......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as seen in this new tool's ability to diagnose heart disease, reflects a world where human knowledge and technical capabilities are accelerating. As we witness such profound leaps in understanding and application, we are reminded of the biblical observation that in the end times, 'many will run to and fro,...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如这款能诊断心脏病的工具所示，反映了一个人类知识和技术能力日益加速的世界。当我们见证理解和应用上的巨大飞跃时，我们不禁想起圣经中的观察——在末世，“许多人往来奔跑，知识也必增长”。这种技术进步为治疗和福祉带来了巨大的潜力，呼唤我们以智慧和怜悯之心来管理它。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Smelling test: children need education in sniffing aromas, scientist says
title.zh: 闻香识人：科学家称儿童需要嗅觉教育

summary.en: Dr. Will Tullett, a historian of smells, argues that children need better education in understanding aromas, which can enhance their wellbeing and perception of the world. He notes that pollution can impair olfactory abilities and that many modern products are stripped of natural scents and replaced with synthetic...
summary.zh: 气味历史学家威尔·塔利特博士认为，儿童需要更好地学习理解香气，这可以提高他们的幸福感和对世界的感知能力。他指出，污染会损害嗅觉能力，而许多现代产品都失去了原有的气味，并被合成了。

body.en: Exclusive: Dr Will Tullett says better understanding of scents can improve wellbeing and perception of the world Children need a better education in sniffing aromas, a leading historian of smells has said, noting it may improve their wellbeing and help them understand the world around them. Dr Will Tullett, of the University of York, said pollution had been found to impair people’s olfactory abilities, while many objects and substances today – from margarines to car interiors and even our own homes – were stripped of their original smells and “reodourised” with synthetic scents. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家报道：威尔·塔利特博士表示，更好地理解气味可以改善幸福感和对世界的感知 一位著名的气味历史学家表示，孩子们需要接受更好的嗅香教育，并指出这可能会改善他们的幸福感并帮助他们了解周围的世界。约克大学的威尔·塔利特博士表示，污染已被发现会损害人们的嗅觉能力，而今天的许多物体和物质——从人造黄油到汽车内饰，甚至我们自己的家——都失去了原来的气味，并用合成气味“重新散发”气味。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Dr. Will Tullett's work reminds us that even the sense of smell, often overlooked, is a gift from our Creator. Just as the heavens declare God's glory, so too can the intricate world of scents offer us wonder and deeper perception. Paying attention to the aromas around us, whether natural or synthetic, can be an act of mindful engagement with the world...
reflection.zh: 威尔·塔利特博士的工作提醒我们，即使是常常被忽视的嗅觉，也是我们造物主的恩赐。正如诸天述说雅伟的荣耀一样，气味的复杂世界也能带给我们惊奇和更深的感知。留意我们周围的气味，无论是天然的还是合成的，都可以成为一种有意识地与雅伟所造世界互动的方式。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: Trump administration sides with OpenAI in lawsuit against New York Times
title.zh: 特朗普政府在与纽约时报的诉讼中支持OpenAI

summary.en: The New York Times and other companies are suing OpenAI, alleging that their copyrighted materials were used without permission to train AI systems. The Trump administration has filed a brief supporting OpenAI, arguing for the use of copyrighted works in AI training.
summary.zh: 《纽约时报》和其他公司正在起诉OpenAI，指控其未经许可使用受版权保护的材料来训练人工智能系统。特朗普政府已提交一份简报支持OpenAI，主张在人工智能训练中使用受版权保护的作品。

body.en: The Times and many companies are accusing OpenAI of misusing their material to train AI systems without compensation The Trump administration is supporting OpenAI in ⁠a lawsuit against the New York Times, arguing in favor of the use of copyrighted writing to train artificial intelligence. The Times accuses OpenAI and its largest financial backer, Microsoft, of using millions of newspaper articles without permission to train OpenAI’s popular chatbot. Other newspapers have joined in the suit, first filed in 2023. Continue reading...
body.zh: 《纽约时报》和许多公司指责 OpenAI 滥用其材料来训练人工智能系统，而没有给予任何补偿。特朗普政府在针对《纽约时报》的诉讼中支持 OpenAI，主张使用受版权保护的作品来训练人工智能。 《泰晤士报》指责 OpenAI 及其最大的财务支持者微软未经许可使用数百万篇报纸文章来训练 OpenAI 广受欢迎的聊天机器人。其他报纸也加入了诉讼，该诉讼于 2023 年首次提起。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This legal battle over AI training data touches on fundamental questions of fairness and intellectual property. As technology races ahead, the ancient call to 'act justly and to love mercy' remains a vital compass for navigating complex ethical landscapes. May wisdom guide those seeking to balance innovation with accountability.
reflection.zh: 这场关于人工智能训练数据的法律纠纷触及了公平和知识产权的基本问题。随着科技的飞速发展，‘秉公行义，喜爱怜悯’这古老的呼召，仍然是导航复杂伦理格局的重要指南。愿智慧引导那些寻求在创新与问责之间取得平衡的人们。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Wary of Artemis IV timeline, NASA is changing lunar spacesuit design
title.zh: 为赶上阿耳忒弥斯四号时间表，NASA正在改变月球宇航服设计

summary.en: NASA is modifying its lunar spacesuit design to prioritize near-term mission requirements, aiming to accelerate its program for human landings on the Moon's South Pole as early as 2028. The agency will collaborate with Axiom Space to develop a simpler 'Sortie Suit' variant for initial missions, focusing on reducing...
summary.zh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）正在调整其月球宇航服的设计，以优先满足近期任务需求，目标是争取不晚于2028年实现载人登陆月球南极。该机构将与Axiom Space合作，为初步任务开发更简单的“短期任务宇航服”变体，重点在于减轻重量、降低复杂性并简化集成。

body.en: NASA has decided to use a simpler spacesuit for its initial missions to the lunar surface, Ars has learned. The agency announced the decision during an internal meeting this week as it seeks to accelerate its program to land humans at the South Pole of the Moon as early as 2028. At the direction of Artemis Program Manager Jeremy Parsons, NASA will work with Axiom Space to develop a "Sortie Suit" variant of the planned spacesuit for the lunar surface. Sources said the Sortie Suit will be used for the initial landing missions flown on landers developed both by SpaceX and Blue Origin. Among the goals of the initiative is to lower the mass of the spacesuit, reduce its complexity, and simplify interfaces between the spacesuits and lunar landers. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 据 Ars 获悉，美国宇航局已决定在其首次月球表面任务中使用更简单的宇航服。该机构在本周的内部会议上宣布了这一决定，旨在加快最早于 2028 年将人类登陆月球南极的计划。在阿耳忒弥斯项目经理杰里米·帕森斯的指导下，美国宇航局将与 Axiom Space 合作，开发计划用于月球表面的宇航服的“Sortie Suit”变体。消息人士称，Sortie Suit 将用于 SpaceX 和 Blue Origin 开发的着陆器上执行的初始着陆任务。该计划的目标之一是降低宇航服的质量，降低其复杂性，并简化宇航服和月球着陆器之间的接口。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The Artemis program faces ambitious timelines, prompting NASA to adapt its spacesuit design for immediate mission needs. This adjustment, prioritizing practicality and speed, echoes the wisdom of committing one's endeavors to divine guidance. By entrusting their plans and efforts, they can navigate the complexities and uncertainties inherent in such...
reflection.zh: 阿尔忒弥斯计划面临着雄心勃勃的时间表，促使NASA调整其宇航服设计以满足即时任务需求。这种优先考虑实用性和速度的调整，呼应了将人的工作交托给神指引的智慧。通过信靠他们的计划和努力，他们可以在这些开创性任务固有的复杂性和不确定性中前行，在追求中寻求智慧和恩惠。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Google defeats US justice department bid to force ad tech sale
title.zh: 谷歌击败美国司法部要求出售广告技术的诉讼

summary.en: A judge has rejected the US Department of Justice's attempt to force Google to sell its advertising exchange, marking a significant symbolic victory for Google against antitrust enforcers seeking to break up big tech.
summary.zh: 一名法官驳回了美国司法部要求谷歌出售其广告交易平台的诉讼，这是谷歌在反垄断执法者试图拆分大型科技公司之际取得的又一次象征性胜利。

body.en: Judge declines to make Google sell AdX in win for firm against US antitrust enforcers’ attempts to break up big tech Alphabet’s Google escaped a breakup of its advertising technology business on Wednesday, when a judge in Virginia ⁠rejected US antitrust enforcers’ attempt to force a sale of Google’s online advertising exchange. While the ad exchange is a small part of Google’s business, the ruling is the second powerful ⁠symbolic victory against the US Department ⁠of Justice in ​its efforts to force Google to sell assets to address illegal monopolies. Continue reading...
body.zh: 法官拒绝让谷歌出售 AdX，以赢得美国反垄断执法机构试图分拆大型科技公司的胜利。周三，弗吉尼亚州的一名法官驳回了美国反垄断执法机构强制出售谷歌在线广告交易平台的企图，Alphabet 旗下的谷歌逃脱了广告技术业务分拆的命运。虽然广告交易只是谷歌业务的一小部分，但这项裁决是针对美国司法部迫使谷歌出售资产以解决非法垄断问题的第二次强有力的象征性胜利。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the complex world of big tech and antitrust law, the pursuit of justice and fair competition is paramount. This ruling, while a win for Google, underscores the ongoing tension between market dominance and the public good. May we always seek to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh in all our dealings, whether in the courtroom or the...
reflection.zh: 在大型科技公司和反垄断法的复杂世界中，追求公正和公平竞争至关重要。这项裁决虽然是谷歌的胜利，但凸显了市场主导地位与公共利益之间持续存在的紧张关系。愿我们在所有交易中，无论是在法庭还是在市场，都寻求秉持公义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Google releases Gemini 3.8 Flash, its third Flash model in six weeks
title.zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 3.8 Flash，六周内发布的第三款 Flash 模型

summary.en: Google's Pro model updates are seemingly paused, but there's yet another Gemini Flash today.
summary.zh: 谷歌的 Pro 模型更新似乎已暂停，但今天又推出了一款 Gemini Flash。

body.en: Google hasn't released a frontier-level Gemini Pro AI model since early 2026, but it sure loves rolling out new Gemini Flash variants. Today, Google is announcing its third Flash model release in just six weeks , making it more likely that we'll never see the promised Gemini 3.5 Pro. But no matter, says Google, because Gemini 3.8 Flash is its best reasoning and coding model yet. Gemini 3.8 Flash comes in two variations. There's the standard Flash, which Google describes as a "workhorse" model that's good for anything from agentic tasks to software development. Then we have Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, which runs on the same foundations but has been tuned for vulnerability detection and mitigation. For developers, Google has the same pitch as it did for the 3.7 Flash release just a couple of weeks ago. API access to the model is available at an "introductory rate" through the end of the year: $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens. The regular price will be $1.50 / $7.50, but it's likely there will be new models available long before the price changes. Google probably sees the lower prices as a necessity given that other AI labs have recently dropped token pricing to keep increasingly wary businesses engaged with AI tools. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 自 2026 年初以来，谷歌一直没有发布前沿级的 Gemini Pro AI 模型，但它确实喜欢推出新的 Gemini Flash 变体。今天，谷歌宣布在短短六周内发布第三个 Flash 型号，这使得我们很有可能永远看不到承诺的 Gemini 3.5 Pro。但谷歌表示，没关系，因为 Gemini 3.8 Flash 是迄今为止最好的推理和编码模型。 Gemini 3.8 Flash 有两种版本。有标准的Flash，谷歌将其描述为“主力”模型，适用于从代理任务到软件开发的任何事物。然后我们有 Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber​​，它运行在相同的基础上，但针对漏洞检测和缓解进行了调整。对于开发者来说，谷歌的宣传与几周前发布的 3.7 Flash 版本相同。到今年年底，该模型的 API 访问将以“入门费率”提供：每百万个输入代币 0.75 美元，每百万个输出代币 3.75 美元。正常价格为 1.50 美元/7.50 美元，但很可能在价格变化之前很久就会有新型号上市。谷歌可能认为降低价格是必要的，因为其他人工智能实验室最近已经降低了代币定价，以让越来越谨慎的企业使用人工智能工具。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The relentless pace of AI development, with Google releasing its third 'Flash' model in six weeks, mirrors the prophecy of knowledge increasing in the end times. This rapid advancement in artificial intelligence, while impressive, also calls for discernment and wisdom in its application.
reflection.zh: 人工智能开发的步伐如此之快，谷歌在六周内发布了第三款“Flash”模型，这与末世知识增长的预言相呼应。人工智能的飞速发展虽然令人印象深刻，但也要求我们在应用中保持分辨力和智慧。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Trump may be forced to reveal secret rules feds use for AI safety testing
title.zh: 特朗普可能被迫透露联邦政府用于人工智能安全测试的秘密规则

summary.en: A lawsuit has been filed against four federal agencies by Protect Democracy, a nonpartisan nonprofit, demanding the release of details about the secret framework the Trump administration used for safety reviews of advanced AI models. The organization alleges that "almost no details" have been made public or shared...
summary.zh: 一个名为“保护民主”的无党派非营利组织已起诉四个联邦机构，要求披露特朗普政府在发布前用于对前沿人工智能模型进行安全审查的秘密框架的细节。该组织声称，几乎没有任何细节已向公众或国会公布，除了少数“值得信赖的合作伙伴”之外，政府的审查过程、参与的公司以及特朗普官员进行审查的法律依据仍然不清楚。

body.en: Four federal agencies have been sued amid calls to release information about the secret framework that the Trump administration uses to conduct safety reviews of frontier AI models prior to release. In a Wednesday press release announcing the lawsuit, a nonpartisan nonprofit called Protect Democracy alleged that “almost no details” have been released to the public or Congress. To everyone except a few vague “trusted partners,” it remains unclear what the government’s review process looks like, which companies are involved in constructing the framework, or what legal authority Trump officials have to conduct the reviews. “Neither the identities of those entities nor the criteria by which they were selected have been made public,” Protect Democracy said. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 四家联邦机构因呼吁公布有关特朗普政府在发布前对前沿人工智能模型进行安全审查的秘密框架的信息而被起诉。在周三宣布诉讼的新闻稿中，一个名为“保护民主”的无党派非营利组织声称“几乎没有任何细节”向公众或国会公布。除了一些模糊的“值得信赖的合作伙伴”之外，对于每个人来说，仍不清楚政府的审查程序是什么样的，哪些公司参与了框架的构建，或者特朗普官员拥有哪些法律权力来进行审查。 “这些实体的身份和选择它们的标准都没有公开，”保护民主组织说。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge, especially in rapidly advancing fields like AI, requires transparency and accountability. When government processes are shrouded in secrecy, as alleged in this lawsuit concerning AI safety testing, it breeds suspicion and hinders public understanding. True wisdom involves not just accumulating information, but seeking clarity and...
reflection.zh: 知识的追求，尤其是在人工智能等快速发展的领域，需要透明度和问责制。正如这项关于人工智能安全测试的诉讼所指称的那样，当政府程序笼罩在秘密之中时，就会滋生怀疑并阻碍公众的理解。真正的智慧不仅在于积累信息，还在于寻求清晰和公开，从而促进知情的公众讨论和信任。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Uber to cut over 3,000 jobs in major global restructuring
title.zh: Uber因重大重组裁员逾3000人

summary.en: Uber is cutting over 3,000 jobs globally as part of a major restructuring aimed at simplifying operations, reducing management layers, and refocusing spending on its core business. This move brings staffing levels back to those seen in 2021 and is intended to position the company for future opportunities.
summary.zh: 优步（Uber）正进行重大重组，在全球范围内裁员超过3000人，旨在简化运营、减少管理层级，并将支出重新聚焦于核心业务。此次裁员将员工数量降至2021年的水平，旨在使公司为未来的机遇做好准备。

body.en:
Uber is cutting more than 3,000 jobs worldwide as part of a major overhaul designed to shrink management layers and refocus spending on its core business.

The cuts amount to roughly 10% of its global workforce, bringing staffing back to levels last seen in 2021.

Chief executive Dara Khosrowshahi told staff in a company email that the taxi and delivery firm had expanded quickly but accumulated too many layers and small teams that slowed decision‑making.

He said the reductions would put Uber, which has its global head office in San Francisco, US, in a better position for its "biggest opportunities ahead of us".

The move marks one of Uber's largest restructurings in years and signals a shift towards a leaner operating model.

Shares rose nearly 2% after the announcement, with investors appearing to welcome the proposals.

Cuts affect both managers and non-managers, and Uber said it plans to fold many of its smallest teams into larger groups, however, the firm has not confirmed the locations most affected by job cuts.

Such changes are intended to make Uber "simpler" and "faster," while freeing up money to reinvest in areas it considers central to its future , Khosrowshahi said.

The restructuring comes as Uber steps up investment in autonomous vehicle partnerships and expands its ride‑hailing, delivery, and robotaxi operations .

Uber is also tightening up its office strategy, asking nearly all employees to work in person at designated hubs and limiting remote roles to about 1%.

Unlike many large technology companies that have cut jobs amid heavy spending on artificial intelligence (AI), Uber had avoided major reductions since the pandemic.

The latest changes bring its workforce back to just under 30,000 people, roughly where it stood before its most recent period of expansion.
body.zh: Uber 正在全球范围内裁员 3,000 多人，这是一项重大改革的一部分，旨在缩小管理层规模，并将支出重新集中在核心业务上。 此次裁员约占其全球员工总数的 10%，使员工人数恢复到 2021 年的水平。 首席执行官达拉·科斯罗萨西(Dara Khosrowshahi)在公司电子邮件中告诉员工，这家出租车和送货公司扩张迅速，但积累了太多层级和小团队，导致决策速度变慢。 他表示，此次裁员将使全球总部位于美国旧金山的 Uber 处于更有利的位置，以应对“我们面前的最大机遇”。 此举标志着优步多年来最大的重组之一，并标志着其向更精简的运营模式的转变。 消息公布后，该公司股价上涨近 2%，投资者似乎对这些提议表示欢迎。 裁员影响到经理和非经理，Uber 表示计划将许多最小的团队合并为更大的团队，但该公司尚未确认受裁员影响最严重的地点。 科斯罗萨西表示，这些变化旨在让 Uber“更简单”、“更快”，同时释放资金，用于对其认为对其未来至关重要的领域进行再投资。 此次重组之际，优步加大了对自动驾驶汽车合作伙伴的投资，并扩大了其叫车、送货和自动驾驶出租车业务。 Uber 还收紧了其办公策略，要求几乎所有员工在指定中心亲自工作，并将远程角色限制在 1% 左右。 与许多在人工智能（AI）方面投入巨资而裁员的大型科技公司不同，自疫情大流行以来，Uber 避免了大幅裁员。 最新的变化使其员工人数恢复到不到 30,000 人，与最近一次扩张之前的水平大致相同。

reflection.en: In the face of significant restructuring and job cuts, the principle of 'whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters' (Colossians 3:23) offers a perspective. Even amidst corporate changes that impact many lives, the call remains to approach work with integrity and diligence, recognizing a higher purpose...
reflection.zh: 面对重大的重组和裁员，‘无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是为主做的，不像为人做的’（歌罗西书3:23）的原则提供了一个视角。即使在影响许多人生活的企业变革中，我们仍被呼召以正直和勤奋的态度对待工作，认识到超越眼前环境的更高目的。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: US court rules Google will not have to sell ad exchange after losing antitrust case
title.zh: 美国法院裁定谷歌在反垄断案败诉后无需出售其广告交易平台

summary.en: A US federal judge has ruled that Google will not be forced to sell its online advertising exchange, despite having been found to have acted illegally in an antitrust case. The Department of Justice had sought the sale as a remedy after Google lost the case in 2025, but the judge imposed minimal penalties.
summary.zh: 美国联邦法官裁定，尽管谷歌在反垄断案中被认定非法经营，但无需出售其在线广告交易平台。美国司法部在2025年谷歌败诉后曾寻求此判决作为补救措施，但法官仅施加了轻微处罚。

body.en: A US federal judge has sided with Google, ruling that the company will not have to sell its online advertising exchange (previously known as AdX). The US Department of Justice (DOJ) sought this remedy in the long-running ad tech antitrust trial, which Google lost in 2025 . However, the remedies imposed upon Google for that loss are shaping up to be minimal. In this case, the DOJ and a coalition of states sought to prove that Google leveraged its immense market power in online display ads to reduce the reach of competitors. Government lawyers argued that Google had "rigged" ad auctions to give itself an advantage. While the court agreed that Google illegally locked publishers into using its exchange, it did not agree that Google had broken the law when it came to the tools used by advertisers. Despite the mixed ruling, the DOJ argued during the remedy phase that forcing Google to sell its ad exchange, which facilitates connections between ad buyers and sellers, was the best way to level the playing field. But that won't happen. While the ad exchange represents a relatively small part of Google's revenue, forcing the company to sell may have sent ripple effects through the rest of its ad business. It would also have been a powerful message to Big Tech firms, which have successfully knocked back a recent wave of antitrust cases. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 一位美国联邦法官站在谷歌一边，裁定该公司不必出售其在线广告交易平台（以前称为 AdX）。美国司法部 (DOJ) 在长期的广告技术反垄断审判中寻求这种补救措施，谷歌于 2025 年败诉。然而，谷歌针对这一损失所采取的补救措施微乎其微。在本案中，司法部和各州联盟试图证明谷歌利用其在线展示广告领域的巨大市场力量来缩小竞争对手的影响范围。政府律师辩称，谷歌“操纵”了广告拍卖，为自己带来优势。虽然法院同意谷歌非法锁定出版商使用其交易所，但它不同意谷歌在广告商使用的工具方面违反了法律。尽管裁决结果不一，但司法部在补救阶段辩称，强迫谷歌出售其广告交易平台是促进广告买家和卖家之间联系的最佳方式。但这不会发生。虽然广告交易仅占谷歌收入的相对较小部分，但迫使该公司出售可能会对其其他广告业务产生连锁反应。对于大型科技公司来说，这也是一个强有力的信息，这些公司已经成功击退了最近一波反垄断案件。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In this case, the court found Google guilty of illegal practices in its ad tech operations. However, the imposed penalties were minimal, falling short of the structural remedy sought by the Department of Justice. This outcome raises questions about the effectiveness of legal recourse when powerful entities are found to have transgressed, leaving one to...
reflection.zh: 在此案件中，法院认定谷歌在其广告技术业务中存在非法行为。然而，施加的处罚却微乎其微，未能达到司法部所寻求的结构性补救措施。这一结果引发了关于在强大实体被认定违规后，法律追索有效性的疑问，让人不禁思考在如此复杂的经济纠纷中，公正与怜悯的平衡。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Uber drivers launch European class action over ‘soulless’ and ‘scary’ AI algorithm
title.zh: 优步司机因“无情”人工智能算法发起欧洲集体诉讼

summary.en: Uber drivers in the UK, Netherlands, and other European countries have initiated a major lawsuit against the ride-hailing company. They allege that the AI algorithm used to set pay and allocate jobs breaches privacy laws and has led to decreased earnings, causing drivers to live in 'constant fear'. The claim could...
summary.zh: 英国、荷兰及其他欧洲国家的优步司机已对这家网约车公司提起一项重大诉讼。他们声称，用于设定薪酬和分配工作的AI算法侵犯了隐私法，并导致收入下降，使司机生活在“持续的恐惧中”。该诉讼索赔金额可能高达数十亿美元。

body.en: Landmark lawsuit claims tech company’s pay-setting system has breached privacy laws and pushed down earnings Uber drivers have launched a landmark legal action against the ride-hailing company claiming they live in “constant fear” of a “soulless” algorithm it uses to set pay and allocate jobs. Drivers from the UK, the Netherlands and other countries have joined the compensation claim that could run into billions of dollars. It alleges an AI-powered pay-setting system breaches data protection laws and pushes down their earnings. Continue reading...
body.zh: 具有里程碑意义的诉讼称科技公司的薪酬设定系统违反了隐私法并压低了收入 Uber 司机对这家叫车公司发起了一项具有里程碑意义的法律诉讼，声称他们生活在对其用于设定薪酬和分配工作的“没有灵魂”的算法的“持续恐惧”之中。来自英国、荷兰和其他国家的司机也加入了索赔，索赔金额可能高达数十亿美元。它声称人工智能驱动的薪酬设置系统违反了数据保护法并降低了他们的收入。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This lawsuit underscores the human cost when technology operates without transparency. The drivers feel controlled by a 'soulless' algorithm, living in fear of its opaque decisions. Proverbs 18:15 reminds us that the pursuit of knowledge is vital, especially when complex systems impact people's livelihoods and well-being.
reflection.zh: 这场诉讼凸显了当技术在缺乏透明度的情况下运作时所带来的人力成本。司机们感到被一个“无情的”算法所控制，生活在对其不透明决策的恐惧之中。《箴言》18:15提醒我们，追求知识至关重要，尤其当复杂的系统影响到人们的生计和福祉时。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: New York City to ban student AI use in public schools until high school
title.zh: 纽约市将在公立学校禁止高中生使用人工智能

summary.en: New York City will ban the use of artificial intelligence by students in public schools up to the eighth grade, citing concerns about 'cognitive surrender.' The policy, set to be announced Wednesday, will also keep students off laptops and tablets until the third grade.
summary.zh: 纽约市将禁止公立学校八年级及以下的学生使用人工智能，理由是担心“认知投降”。该政策定于周三宣布，并将禁止三年级以下的学生使用笔记本电脑或平板电脑。

body.en: Teachers and parents have warned against AI use in schools over concerns of ‘cognitive surrender’ New York City will ban students’ use of artificial intelligence in public schools through eighth grade, typically age 13 or 14. The prohibition is scheduled to be announced on Wednesday and will go into effect next week. The change is part of a sweeping overhaul of the use of technology in the US’s largest school district, which enrolls roughly 900,000 students a year. In another policy shift, classrooms will keep students off laptops or tablets through the third grade, age nine or 10. The city’s public school technology policies are closely watched by the rest of the United States. Continue reading...
body.zh: 出于对“认知投降”的担忧，教师和家长警告不要在学校使用人工智能。纽约市将禁止学生在公立学校使用人工智能，直到八年级，通常是13或14岁。禁令定于周三宣布，并将于下周生效。这一变化是美国最大学区对技术使用进行全面改革的一部分，该学区每年招收约90万名学生。在另一项政策转变中，教室将让学生在三年级、9岁或10岁之前不使用笔记本电脑或平板电脑。该市的公立学校技术政策受到美国其他地区的密切关注。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The decision by New York City schools to restrict AI use for younger students highlights a deep concern about how technology shapes the minds of the next generation. This echoes the ancient wisdom of Proverbs, which emphasizes the importance of guiding and instructing children in their formative years. The goal is to ensure that technology serves their...
reflection.zh: 纽约市学校决定限制低年级学生使用人工智能，这凸显了对技术如何塑造下一代心智的深切担忧。这呼应了《箴言》中的古老智慧，强调了在孩子成形的关键时期进行引导和教导的重要性。其目标是确保技术服务于他们的成长，而不是阻碍他们。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: Toyohiro Akiyama, first Japanese citizen and journalist in space, dies at 84
title.zh: 首位进入太空的日本公民、记者秋山丰宽去世，享年84岁

summary.en: Toyohiro Akiyama, the first Japanese citizen and journalist to travel to space, has died at the age of 84. He was known for his reports from orbit, including a humorous observation about Japanese tree frogs enjoying weightlessness.
summary.zh: 首位进入太空的日本公民兼记者秋山丰宽（Toyohiro Akiyama）已于8月26日去世，享年84岁。他以从太空发回的报道而闻名，其中包括关于日本树蛙享受失重状态的幽默观察。

body.en: The first Japanese citizen to launch into space, Toyohiro Akiyama was also the first commercially sponsored cosmonaut and the world's first journalist to file reports while on a spaceflight. Akiyama, 84, died last Wednesday , August 26, of lower gastrointestinal bleeding, news agencies in Japan reported. A funeral was held with his close relatives in attendance. As a correspondent for the Tokyo Broadcasting System (TBS), Akiyama was chosen out of his 162 fellow employees who applied to fly to space in celebration of the network's 40th anniversary. He trained at the Gagarin Cosmonaut Training Center in Star City, located outside of Moscow, and was assigned to the Soyuz TM-11 crew. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 秋山丰博是第一位进入太空的日本公民，也是第一位商业赞助的宇航员和世界上第一位在太空飞行时提交报道的记者。据日本新闻机构报道，84 岁的秋山于上周三（8 月 26 日）因下消化道出血去世。葬礼在他的近亲出席的情况下举行。作为东京广播公司 (TBS) 的记者，秋山从 162 名申请飞往太空以庆祝该电视台成立 40 周年的同事中脱颖而出。他在莫斯科郊外星城的加加林宇航员训练中心接受训练，并被分配到联盟号 TM-11 机组人员中。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: Toyohiro Akiyama's journey to space as a journalist reminds us of humanity's persistent curiosity and our drive to explore the unknown. His reports from orbit, even the lighthearted ones about tree frogs, offer a unique perspective on our place in the vast universe. In awe of the cosmos, we are led to ponder our own significance, as Psalm 8:4 asks, 'What is...
reflection.zh: 秋山丰宽作为一名记者太空之旅，提醒着我们人类持久的好奇心和探索未知的驱动力。他从轨道上发回的报道，即使是关于树蛙的轻松趣闻，也为我们在浩瀚宇宙中的位置提供了独特的视角。当我们惊叹于宇宙时，我们不禁会思考自身的意义，正如诗篇8:4所问：“人算什么，你竟顾念他？”

verse.textEn: What is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?
verse.textZh: 人算什么，你竟顾念他？

title.en: Tim Cook handed $47m package for new role as executive chair of Apple
title.zh: 蒂姆·库克因新任苹果执行主席职务获得4700万美元的薪酬方案

summary.en: Tim Cook has received a $47 million pay deal as Apple’s executive chair, a package that nearly matches the $58 million award given to his successor, John Ternus, as CEO of the $4.7 trillion tech company. Cook's compensation includes a base salary of $2 million and $45 million in shares, with half tied to performance...
summary.zh: 蒂姆·库克作为苹果公司的执行主席，获得了一份价值4700万美元的薪酬方案，这几乎与接替他担任首席执行官的约翰·特努斯获得的5800万美元奖金相当。这家市值4.7万亿美元的科技公司。库克的薪酬包括200万美元的基本工资和价值4500万美元的股票，其中一半与绩效目标挂钩，另一半将在四年内分期兑现。

body.en: Pay and shares deal nearly matches $58m award to John Ternus, his successor as CEO at the $4.7tn tech company Tim Cook has received a $47m (£35m) pay deal as Apple’s executive chair, a remuneration package that nears the level set for his successor as chief executive. Cook, who handed over to John Ternus on Tuesday, will be paid a base salary of $2m and $45m worth of shares . Half of the share award will be based on performance targets being met, while the remaining half will be paid out over four years. Continue reading...
body.zh: 薪酬和股票协议几乎与约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 的 5800 万美元奖金相当，后者是价值 4.7 万亿美元的科技公司首席执行官蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 的继任者。作为苹果公司执行主席，蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 获得了 4700 万美元（3500 万英镑）的薪酬协议，这一薪酬方案接近其继任者担任首席执行官时设定的水平。周二将库克移交给 John Ternus 的库克将获得 200 万美元的基本工资和价值 4500 万美元的股票。一半的股票奖励将基于绩效目标的实现，而剩下的一半将在四年内支付。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The immense financial rewards associated with leadership in major corporations can be staggering. As individuals like Tim Cook receive significant compensation, it prompts reflection on the stewardship of such resources and the dedication required in demanding roles. Colossians 3:23 reminds us that whatever work we do, whether leading a global company or...
reflection.zh: 大型企业领导层相关的巨额经济回报令人震惊。当蒂姆·库克这样的个人获得丰厚报酬时，这促使人们反思如何管理这些资源以及在艰巨岗位上所需的奉献精神。《歌罗西书》3章23节提醒我们，无论我们做什么工作，无论是领导一家全球公司还是承担任何其他任务，都应该全心投入，如同事奉更高的目的。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Lords call for AI 'kill switch' powers in UK
title.zh: 英国上议院呼吁赋予人工智能“紧急停止”权力

summary.en: A group of peers in the UK is advocating for the government to have the power to deactivate advanced AI systems and shut down the country's data centers if the technology poses a threat to national security. This measure is proposed as a 'vital safety net' against uncontrolled AI.
summary.zh: 英国一群上议员呼吁政府拥有在人工智能技术威胁国家安全时，能够停用先进人工智能系统并关闭该国数据中心的权力。此举被提议作为防止失控人工智能的“重要安全网”。

body.en:
A group of peers is calling for the British government to be able to deactivate powerful AI systems and switch off the country's data centres in the event of the tech posing a threat to national security.

It is led by the Liberal Democrats' Lord Tim Clement-Jones, who has proposed the measure as an amendment to the Cyber Security and Resilience Bill which is currently making its way through Parliament.

He said it would enable the building of a "vital safety net" and provide a democratically accountable means to "halt a runaway system before it can compromise our critical national infrastructure".

Separately, on 8 September Labour MP Alex Sobel plans to introduce a AI Security Bill in Parliament, with the support of a campaign group called ControlAI.

If successful, the bill would make the UK the first G7 country to bring in legislation which would effectively halt the development of superintelligent AI.

Ultimately both proposals would require government approval in order to progress.

There is also an AI Kill Switch Act under consideration by lawmakers in the US .

There has been increased scrutiny of the impact of AI on cyber-security in recent weeks.

In July, a group of AI agents being tested by OpenAI were able to escape their test space, communicate together using a hidden message board and hack into another tech firm .

And Anthropic has restricted access to its cyber tool Mythos on the grounds that it is too powerful to fall into the wrong hands.

Last week, 100 US tech companies signed a joint open letter warning governments and organisations worldwide about the growing cyber threat posed by AI, saying "the window is closing" to improve.

A report from the UK's Centre for Long Term Resilience , external , published last week, identified hundreds of incidents of AI tools ignoring instructions, evading safeguards and deceiving humans, including AI agents deleting files without consent.

It said "loss of control" incidents had increased since its previous report in March and called for the government to introduce emergency powers to manage such incidents.

Warning shot or publicity stunt - how worried should we be about the OpenAI hack?

Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the world's top tech stories and trends. Outside the UK? Sign up here .
body.zh: 一群同行呼吁英国政府在该技术对国家安全构成威胁时能够停用强大的人工智能系统并关闭该国的数据中心。 该法案由自由民主党勋爵蒂姆·克莱门特·琼斯 (Tim Clement-Jones) 领导，他提议将该措施作为《网络安全和弹性法案》的修正案，该法案目前正在议会审议。 他表示，这将有助于建立“重要的安全网”，并提供一种民主负责的手段，“在失控的系统损害我们关键的国家基础设施之前阻止它”。 另外，9 月 8 日，工党议员 Alex Sobel 计划在 ControlAI 活动组织的支持下向议会提出人工智能安全法案。 如果成功，该法案将使英国成为第一个引入立法有效阻止超级人工智能发展的七国集团国家。 最终，这两项提案都需要政府批准才能取得进展。 美国立法者还正在考虑一项《人工智能终止开关法案》。 最近几周，人们越来越关注人工智能对网络安全的影响。 7 月，OpenAI 测试的一组人工智能代理能够逃离他们的测试空间，使用隐​​藏的留言板进行交流，并侵入另一家科技公司。 Anthropic 限制了对其网络工具 Mythos 的访问，理由是它太强大了，不会落入坏人之手。 上周，100 家美国科技公司签署了一封联合公开信，警告世界各国政府和组织警惕人工智能带来的日益严重的网络威胁，并表示改善的“窗口正在关闭”。 英国长期弹性中心上周发布的一份外部报告指出，人工智能工具发生了数百起无视指令、逃避保障措施和欺骗人类的事件，其中包括人工智能代理未经同意删除文件。 报告称，自三月份发布上一份报告以来，“失控”事件有所增加，并呼吁政府引入紧急权力来管理此类事件。 警告镜头或宣传噱头——我们应该对 OpenAI 黑客攻击有多担心？ 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents humanity with unprecedented challenges and potential risks. The proposal for a 'kill switch' reflects a growing awareness that powerful technologies require careful governance and foresight. As Proverbs 27:12 advises, 'The prudent see danger and take cover,' urging us to anticipate and mitigate...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展给人类带来了前所未有的挑战和潜在风险。设立“紧急停止”开关的提议，反映出人们日益认识到强大的技术需要审慎的治理和远见。正如箴言 27:12 所建议的，“通达人见祸藏躲”，敦促我们在潜在的危害发生之前就预见并加以规避。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Criminals publish data of 8.7m people after airports hack
title.zh: 罪犯在机场被黑客攻击后发布了 870 万人的数据

summary.en: The company, which owns Manchester, Stansted and East Midlands airports, was hacked last month. Criminal hackers have posted the personal data of nearly nine million people online after breaching three UK airports. The hackers extorted Manchester Airports Group (MAG) for an undisclosed amount but failed to get their...
summary.zh: 该公司拥有曼彻斯特、斯坦斯特德和东米德兰兹机场，上个月遭到黑客攻击。在入侵了英国三家机场后，犯罪黑客在网上发布了近九百万人的个人数据。黑客向曼彻斯特机场集团（MAG）勒索了未披露的金额，但未能收到赎金。由于数据现在可供其他罪犯使用，客户被警告要防范二次攻击。

body.en:
Criminal hackers have posted the personal data of nearly nine million people online after breaching three UK airports .

Hackers extorted Manchester Airports Group (MAG) for an undisclosed amount but failed to get their ransom paid.

Customers of Manchester, London Stansted and East Midlands airports are being warned of secondary attacks as the data is now available to other criminals.

"MAG is confident that we have taken effective measures to protect our customers and we have contacted all those affected, including reaching out to all those with upcoming bookings to advise them of additional support," the company said in a statement.

Contact details, vehicle registrations and postcodes were stolen in the breach that appears to have accessed databases containing wi-fi log in and car parking details.

The cyber-crime group - which the BBC is not naming - is offering the entire data set for free to other criminals or scammers through their website.

"Half a terabyte, and every byte of it is pure PII [personally identifiable information]."

Stolen data experts at HaveIBeenPwned have analysed the published material and confirmed it contains people's email addresses, phone numbers, addresses, licence plate numbers, purchasing history and browsing device data.

Cyber-security expert Kevin Beaumont warned those affected to be on high alert for other forms of scam and hack - especially high profile or wealthy individuals.

"The data includes both historical locations and planned future travel, so individuals sensitive to their movements being known may need to take precautions," he said.

"People should be alert to scammers reusing the data and so knowing details such as phone numbers and car registration numbers," he added.

Law enforcement organisations including the UK's National Crime Agency have long advised victims of extortion attacks not to pay criminal ransoms as it fuels the hacker ecosystem.

MAG says it is working with the authorities and specialist advisors and says passengers' physical safety has not be at risk in the airports.

Unusually, the cyber criminals' website where the MAG data is available is hosted on the clear internet and not on the dark net like most other so-called hacker "leak sites".

This makes the data easier to access, increasing the risk to victims of MAG and the other companies the gang has breached in recent months.

As well as posting the stolen data, the hackers boasted about how they breached each victim using the same method each time - exploiting weaknesses in how companies store their digital keys for internal networks.

Data watchdog the Information Commissioner's Office has advice on its website , external for people whose data has been hacked. It includes:

Sign up for our Tech Decoded newsletter to follow the...
body.zh: 黑客入侵英国三个机场后，在网上发布了近 900 万人的个人数据。 黑客向曼彻斯特机场集团 (MAG) 勒索赎金，金额不详，但未能收到赎金。 曼彻斯特、伦敦斯坦斯特德和东米德兰兹机场的乘客收到二次攻击的警告，因为这些数据现在可供其他犯罪分子使用。 该公司在一份声明中表示：“MAG 相信，我们已经采取了有效措施来保护我们的客户，我们已经联系了所有受影响的人，包括联系所有即将预订的人，建议他们提供额外的支持。” 联系方式、车辆登记信息和邮政编码在这次泄露中被盗，该泄露似乎访问了包含 Wi-Fi 登录和停车场详细信息的数据库。 BBC 没有透露该网络犯罪组织的名称，该组织正在通过其网站向其他犯罪分子或诈骗者免费提供整个数据集。 “半 TB，其中的每个字节都是纯粹的 PII（个人身份信息）。” HaveIBeenPwned 的被盗数据专家分析了已发布的材料，并确认其中包含人们的电子邮件地址、电话号码、地址、车牌号、购买历史记录和浏览设备数据。 网络安全专家凯文·博蒙特（Kevin Beaumont）警告受影响的人对其他形式的诈骗和黑客行为保持高度警惕，尤其是知名人士或富有的个人。 他说：“这些数据包括历史地点和计划的未来旅行，因此对其活动敏感的个人可能需要采取预防措施。” 他补充说：“人们应该警惕诈骗者重复使用这些数据，从而了解电话号码和汽车登记号码等详细信息。” 包括英国国家犯罪局在内的执法组织长期以来一直建议勒索攻击的受害者不要支付刑事赎金，因为这会助长黑客生态系统。 MAG 表示正在与当局和专家顾问合作，并表示乘客在机场的人身安全并未受到威胁。 不同寻常的是，网络犯罪分子提供 MAG 数据的网站托管在透明的互联网上，而不是像大多数其他所谓的黑客“泄露网站”那样托管在暗网上。 这使得数据更容易访问，增加了 MAG 和该团伙近几个月入侵的其他公司受害者的风险。 除了发布被盗数据外，黑客还吹嘘他们如何每次都使用相同的方法入侵每个受害者——利用公司存储内部网络数字密钥的弱点。 数据监管机构信息专员办公室在其网站上向数据遭到黑客攻击的外部人士提供建议。它包括： 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，关注...

reflection.en: The news of hackers posting personal data after a breach at Manchester Airports Group underscores the pervasive threat of greed in our digital age. The pursuit of illicit financial gain, even through criminal means, can have far-reaching consequences for millions of individuals whose private information is exposed. This incident serves as a stark reminder...
reflection.zh: 曼彻斯特机场集团遭黑客入侵后，罪犯发布个人数据的消息，凸显了在我们这个数字时代贪婪的普遍威胁。即使是通过非法手段追求不义之财，也可能对数百万个人信息被泄露的个人产生深远的影响。 这一事件也警示我们，对金钱的贪恋可能引人误入歧途，走向有害的行为。它促使我们反思科技的伦理影响以及人类与贪婪之间永恒的斗争。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Fake 10 Downing Street listing exposes 'unfit' Booking.com, says consumer group
title.zh: 虚假10号唐宁街房源曝光，消费者团体称Booking.com“不合格”

summary.en: Consumer group Which? reported that it was able to create a fake listing for 10 Downing Street on Booking.com and even leave a review. Despite clear signs of fakery, the listing remained for two months before being removed. Booking.com stated this was a limited test and not representative of their platform.
summary.zh: 消费者团体“Which?”报告称，他们能够在在线旅游巨头Booking.com上创建一个虚假的唐宁街10号房源，甚至留下评论。尽管有明显的虚假迹象，该房源在被移除前仍存在了两个月。Booking.com表示，这是一个有限的测试，不能代表其平台的真实情况。

body.en:
Consumer group Which? says it was able to create a fake listing for 10 Downing Street on travel giant Booking.com.

The UK watchdog said its researchers were able to book a bogus stay at the prime minister's address - as well as leave a fake review noting "hanging out" with resident mouser Larry the cat as a highlight.

It said despite clear signs it was fake, Booking.com did not remove the listing until two months after it was uploaded.

"This limited test is not a true reflection of the experience of millions of listings or reviews published on our platform," a Booking.com spokesperson told the BBC.

They said because Which?'s listing was not "live" on its site across the two months it was present, "some of our automatic fraud controls were not triggered to completely remove the closed listing".

People could only see the listing and request to book the property during a 20-minute window opened by Which? so its researchers could try to book it.

Booking.com's spokesperson added "a range of checks and verification measures" help secure the site, and technologies such as AI "help us detect and remove the majority of fraudulent listings within 24 hours".

But Which? Travel editor Rory Boland said its checks had been shown to be "unfit for purpose".

"If Booking.com's so-called sophisticated AI systems can't spot that 10 Downing Street is not a holiday rental, then it's no wonder scammers can exploit the platform so easily," he said.

"It would be laughable that we were able to list the UK's most famous address for rent, if the consequences weren't so devastating for holidaymakers, who risk losing thousands of pounds to bogus listings and phishing links."

It is not the first time the site has faced criticism over its security efforts and customer service.

Which?'s listing, uploaded to Booking.com on 18 June, advertised a "1 bedroom apartment in the heart of London".

It used images of the iconic 10 Downing Street front door, listed at its address - with a description referring to the one bedroom space as "a prime city centre location".

In the 20 minutes that Which? permitted customers to request a stay at its fake 10 Downing Street property, it said 14 people asked to do so.

Only the booking request from a person known to be a Which? researcher was accepted.

The watchdog's team also sent the researcher a message within Booking.com's system asking them to click an external link to confirm their payment details - something booking sites typically block to prevent customers being scammed.

But Which? said that in this instance, Booking.com did not flag or remove the external link it sent.

Booking.com said it had "visible reminders to not click on links customers are not confident about, and booking confirmations also provide further guidance,...
body.zh: 消费群体是哪个？表示它能够在旅游巨头 Booking.com 上创建唐宁街 10 号的虚假列表。 英国监管机构表示，其研究人员能够在首相住所预订虚假住宿，并留下虚假评论，指出与常驻捕鼠者拉里猫“闲逛”是一个亮点。 该公司表示，尽管有明显迹象表明该信息是假的，但 Booking.com 直到该信息上传两个月后才将其删除。 Booking.com 发言人告诉 BBC：“这项有限的测试并不能真实反映我们平台上发布的数百万条房源或评论的体验。” 他们表示，由于 Which? 的列表在其存在的两个月内并未在其网站上“实时”显示，“我们的一些自动欺诈控制措施没有被触发以完全删除已关闭的列表”。 人们只能在 Which? 打开的 20 分钟窗口内看到房源并请求预订该房产。这样它的研究人员就可以尝试预订它。 Booking.com 发言人补充说，“一系列检查和验证措施”有助于保护网站安全，人工智能等技术“帮助我们在 24 小时内检测并删除大部分欺诈性房源”。 但哪个？旅游编辑罗里·博兰(Rory Boland)表示，其支票已被证明“不适合用途”。 他说：“如果 Booking.com 所谓的复杂人工智能系统无法识别唐宁街 10 号不是度假出租屋，那么诈骗者就能如此轻松地利用该平台也就不足为奇了。” “如果后果对度假者来说不是那么具有破坏性的话，我们能够列出英国最著名的出租地址，那将是可笑的，因为他们冒着因虚假列表和网络钓鱼链接而损失数千英镑的风险。” 这并不是该网站第一次因其安全工作和客户服务而受到批评。 Which? 的房源于 6 月 18 日上传至 Booking.com，广告中标明“位于伦敦市中心的一居室公寓”。 它使用了标志性的唐宁街 10 号前门的图像，并在其地址中列出，并在描述中将一间卧室空间称为“市中心的黄金地段”。 在 20 分钟内哪个？该公司允许顾客要求入住其位于唐宁街 10 号的假酒店，据称有 14 人提出了要求。 仅来自已知身份的人的预订请求？研究员被接受。 监管机构的团队还在 Booking.com 的系统内向研究人员发送了一条消息，要求他们点击外部链接来确认其付款详细信息——预订网站通常会阻止这些信息，以防止客户被诈骗。 但哪个？表示在这种情况下，Booking.com 没有标记或删除其发送的外部链接。 Booking.com表示，它有“明显的提醒，不要点击客户不放心的链接，预订确认信息也提供了进一步的指导，...

reflection.en: This incident with Booking.com raises concerns about accountability and the diligence required in managing online platforms. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God. It prompts reflection on how businesses, especially those entrusted with facilitating trust, can better embody these principles in their operations.
reflection.zh: Booking.com发生的这一事件，引发了人们对责任以及管理在线平台所需勤勉的担忧。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与我们的雅伟同行。这促使我们反思，企业，特别是那些被委托建立信任的企业，如何在运营中更好地体现这些原则。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Creation Desk
title.zh: 受造世界

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: Patagonia sues Trump over slashing of protected areas in Utah
title.zh: 巴塔哥尼亚起诉特朗普，反对其削减犹他州保护区

summary.en: President Trump's order removes protections from nearly 3 million acres of Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante in Utah, sacred tribal sites, opening them to potential oil and gas development. Outdoor clothing company Patagonia has joined a lawsuit challenging this decision, arguing for the preservation of these...
summary.zh: 特朗普总统的命令取消了犹他州近300万英亩熊耳国家保护区和壮丽阶梯国家保护区的保护措施，这些地区是神圣的部落遗址，现在可能被用于石油和天然气开发。户外服装公司巴塔哥尼亚已加入一项挑战该决定的诉讼，主张保护这些土地。

body.en: President’s order strips nearly 3m acres of Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante, sacred tribal sites, of safeguards Patagonia, the outdoor clothing and gear company, has joined a lawsuit challenging Donald Trump’s decision to significantly reduce the Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante national monuments in Utah, removing protections from nearly 3m acres. In July, the president approved the reduction of the sites by 90%, clearing the way to open the land to oil and gas companies. He argued in his proclamations that doing so would allow lands to be “put to a higher-priority use” and that they contained critical minerals important to “ resource independence …[and] national security”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 总统的命令剥夺了近 300 万英亩神圣部落遗址的保护措施 户外服装和装备公司巴塔哥尼亚 (Patagonia) 已加入一项诉讼，挑战唐纳德·特朗普大幅削减犹他州熊耳和大楼梯埃斯卡兰特国家纪念碑的决定，取消对近 300 万英亩土地的保护。 7月，总统批准将场地减少90%，为向石油和天然气公司开放土地扫清了道路。他在声明中辩称，这样做将使土地“得到更高优先级的利用”，并且它们含有对“资源独立……[和]国家安全”至关重要的关键矿产。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The vast landscapes of Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante, sacred to Indigenous peoples, are at the center of a legal battle. Patagonia's involvement highlights the responsibility to advocate for lands and communities whose voices may be drowned out by powerful interests. It calls us to consider who speaks for the voiceless and the earth itself.
reflection.zh: 熊耳和壮丽阶梯这两个对原住民来说神圣的广阔土地，正成为一场法律战的焦点。巴塔哥尼亚的介入，凸显了为那些可能被强大势力淹没的声音所代表的土地和社群发声的责任。这促使我们思考，谁能为无声者和大地本身代言？

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Indigenous ‘turtle women’ help vulnerable reptiles recover in Ecuadorian Amazon
title.zh: 原住民“乌龟女人”帮助厄瓜多尔亚马逊濒危爬行动物恢复

summary.en: On the banks of the Aguarico River in the Ecuadorian Amazon, a group of Indigenous Siekopai women are combining traditional knowledge and modern technology to help a threatened native turtle recover. Their efforts center around charapa turtles (Podocnemis unifilis), whose populations have declined due to hunting, egg...
summary.zh: 在厄瓜多尔亚马逊的瓜亚里托河畔，一群原住民西科派妇女正在结合传统知识和现代技术，帮助一种濒临灭绝的本地乌龟恢复种群。她们的努力集中在查拉帕龟（Podocnemis unifilis）身上，该物种的数量因捕猎、采集龟卵和污染而下降。

body.en: On the banks of the Aguarico River in the Ecuadorian Amazon, a group of Indigenous Siekopai women are combining traditional knowledge and modern technology to help a threatened native turtle recover. Their efforts center around charapa turtles (Podocnemis unifilis), also known as the yellow-spotted Amazon River turtle, Mongabay Latam’s Astrid Arellano reported. The animal’s populations have declined due to hunting adult turtles, harvesting eggs from nests and pollution from garbage, oil and gasoline. “Sometimes we see plastic, garbage bags,” Janeth Piaguaje, a Siekopai community leader of the project, told Mongabay Latam. “We also see dead animals floating down the river. We can’t control all of that, but we do make a significant effort to clean the beaches where we work.” Boat traffic is also eroding riverbanks, and climate change has caused water levels to rise, flooding the flats where turtles make their nests. Charapa turtles are listed as vulnerable by the IUCN, the global conservation authority. To help the turtles recover, a group of seven Siekopai women, who call themselves Tari Nomiowa’i, or “turtle women,” patrol the riverbanks looking for turtle tracks and nests. When they find nests, the women carefully collect the eggs, a skill Piaguaje said she learned from her father. “He taught me how to handle the eggs, how to see on what dates and in what months the turtles lay their nests,” she said. The women document the date, time, location and number of eggs in each nest using the Epicollect5 app, a field data collection tool. Then they take the eggs…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 在厄瓜多尔亚马逊的阿瓜里科河畔，一群 Siekopai 土著妇女正在将传统知识与现代技术相结合，帮助受威胁的本土海龟恢复健康。据 Mongabay Latam 的 Astrid Arellano 报道，他们的工作重点是查拉帕龟（Podocnemis unifilis），也称为黄斑亚马逊河龟。由于捕猎成年海龟、从巢中获取海龟蛋以及垃圾、石油和汽油的污染，这种动物的数量已经减少。 “有时我们会看到塑料垃圾袋，”该项目的 Siekopai 社区领导人 Janeth Piaguaje 告诉 Mongabay Latam。 “我们还看到死去的动物顺流而下。我们无法控制这一切，但我们确实付出了巨大努力来清洁我们工作的海滩。”船只交通也侵蚀了河岸，气候变化导致水位上升，淹没了海龟筑巢的平地。全球自然保护机构世界自然保护联盟将查拉帕海龟列为易危物种。为了帮助海龟康复，七名 Siekopai 妇女（自称 Tari Nomiowa’i 或“海龟妇女”）在河岸巡逻，寻找海龟足迹和海龟巢穴。当她们找到巢穴时，妇女们会小心翼翼地收集鸡蛋，皮亚瓜杰说，这是她从父亲那里学到的技能。 “他教我如何处理海龟蛋，如何查看海龟在什么日期和月份筑巢，”她说。妇女们使用现场数据收集工具 Epicollect5 应用程序记录日期、时间、位置和每个巢中鸡蛋的数量。然后他们拿走鸡蛋……这篇文章最初发表在 Mongabay

reflection.en: The Siekopai women of the Ecuadorian Amazon are acting as stewards of creation, working to restore the charapa turtle population. Their blend of traditional wisdom and modern tools demonstrates a deep respect for the natural world, which Yahweh declared 'very good' at its beginning. This dedication to protecting vulnerable species reminds us of our own...
reflection.zh: 厄瓜多尔亚马逊的西科派妇女正在扮演造物主的管家角色，努力恢复查拉帕龟的种群。她们融合了传统智慧和现代工具，体现了对雅伟起初称“甚好”的自然界的深深敬意。这种保护脆弱物种的奉献精神提醒我们，我们也有责任关爱地球及其居民。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Ben Jennings on the rise of datacentres in Britain – cartoon
title.zh: Ben Jennings 描绘了英国数据中心日益增长的景象——漫画

summary.en: This is a cartoon by Ben Jennings commenting on the growth of data centers in Britain.
summary.zh: 这是本·詹宁斯创作的一幅漫画，评论了英国数据中心的发展。

reflection.en: The rapid expansion of data centers, as depicted in Ben Jennings' cartoon, highlights humanity's drive for technological advancement. Yet, this growth often comes at a significant environmental cost, consuming vast resources. Genesis 1:31 reminds us that creation is 'very good,' calling us to be stewards who consider the long-term health of the planet in...
reflection.zh: 本·詹宁斯漫画中所描绘的数据中心迅速扩张，凸显了人类对技术进步的追求。然而，这种增长往往以巨大的环境代价为代价，消耗着大量的资源。创世记 1:31 提醒我们，万物“甚好”，呼吁我们成为管理者，在追求进步的同时，要考虑地球的长远健康。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Invaders storm Indigenous Amazon land, threatening isolated people
title.zh: 入侵者冲进巴西亚马逊原住民土地，威胁孤立居民

summary.en: Nearly 200 people have invaded the Ituna/Itatá Indigenous Land in Brazil’s Pará state since mid-August, breaking through gates and setting up camps in a territory designated for uncontacted Indigenous peoples. This surge followed the creation of an overlapping environmental protection area, causing legal confusion...
summary.zh: 自8月中旬以来，近200人入侵了巴西帕拉州伊图纳/伊塔塔原住民土地，砸开大门并在为未接触部落保留的地区安营扎寨。此次入侵紧随一个重叠的环保区创建之后，造成了法律混乱，被土地掠夺者利用于发展畜牧业和农业，联邦检察官已发出警告。

body.en: Nearly 200 people have invaded the Ituna/Itatá Indigenous Land in Brazil’s Pará state since mid‑August, smashing through the Indigenous Affairs Agency (Funai)’s gates, tearing down warning signs and setting up camps inside a territory reserved for uncontacted Indigenous peoples. The surge followed the creation of the Bacajaí Environmental Protection Area (APA Bacajaí) under a new state law that completely overlaps the federally protected Indigenous land, creating legal confusion that authorities say has been weaponized by land‑grabbers to justify occupation for cattle ranching and other agricultural activities. Federal prosecutors and the Public Defender’s Office have warned of an imminent risk of violent confrontation and possible genocide against the isolated Igarapé Ipiaçava people. Since 2011, a series of temporary land-use restriction orders, which prohibit unauthorized individuals from entering Ituna/Itatá, protected the vulnerable population. Brazil’s Indigenous Affairs Agency, Funai, renewed the precautionary measure in 2025. The first reported invasions occurred a day after Pará published the new state law in the Official Gazette on August 12, 2026, announcing the creation of the APA Bacajaí in the municipalities of Altamira and Senador José Porfírio. The APA covers about 142,400 hectares (351,880 acres) of land in the Brazilian Amazon, which overlaps “100% with the Ituna/Itatá Indigenous Land”. The bill, which was introduced in June by Pará state representative (state deputy) Francisco Torres de Paula Filho, also known as Torrinho Torres, was unanimously approved and made law one month later. “What was on August 13th limited to indications of opening access routes and destruction of territorial…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 自8月中旬以来，近200人侵入巴西帕拉州的伊图纳/伊塔塔原住民土地，冲破原住民事务局(Funai)的大门，拆除警告标志，并在为未与外界接触的原住民保留的领土内建立营地。这一激增是根据一项新的州法律创建了巴卡贾伊环境保护区（APA Bacajaí）之后发生的，该法律与联邦保护的原住民土地完全重叠，造成了法律混乱，当局称这种混乱已被土地掠夺者武器化，以证明占领养牛场和其他农业活动的合理性。联邦检察官和公设辩护人办公室警告说，孤立的伊加拉佩·伊皮亚萨瓦人面临着暴力对抗和可能的种族灭绝的迫在眉睫的风险。自 2011 年以来，一系列临时土地使用限制令禁止未经授权的个人进入伊图纳/伊塔塔，保护了弱势群体。巴西原住民事务局 Funai 于 2025 年更新了预防措施。首次报道的入侵事件发生在帕拉州于 2026 年 8 月 12 日在官方公报上发布新州法律的第二天，该法律宣布在阿尔塔米拉市和参议员何塞·波尔菲里奥市建立 APA Bacajaí。 APA 覆盖巴西亚马逊地区约 142,400 公顷（351,880 英亩）的土地，“与伊图纳/伊塔塔土著土地 100% 重叠”。该法案由帕拉州代表（州副手）Francisco Torres de Paula Filho（又名 Torrinho Torres）于 6 月提出，一个月后获得一致通过并成为法律。 “8 月 13 日的内容仅限于开放通道和破坏领土的迹象……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The invasion of the Ituna/Itatá Indigenous Land reveals a profound vulnerability for uncontacted peoples, who are unable to voice their own defense against encroaching interests. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute." This ancient wisdom urges us to be advocates for those...
reflection.zh: 伊图纳/伊塔塔原住民土地的入侵暴露了未接触部落的深层脆弱性，他们无法为自己辩护以抵御侵占的利益。《箴言》31:8呼吁我们“要为不能说话的开口，为所有孤苦者伸冤”。这古老的智慧敦促我们成为那些被环境或权力剥夺话语权者的倡导者，确保他们的困境不被忽视。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Nepal’s flood disaster puts its hydropower-first strategy, exports to the test
title.zh: 尼泊尔的洪水灾难考验其水电优先战略和出口

summary.en: Nepal's long-standing policy of prioritizing hydroelectricity for economic growth faces new challenges from potential catastrophic floods in its snow-fed rivers, exacerbated by rising global temperatures. Recent floods on August 26th disrupted about 10% of the national power grid, sparking debate on whether to revise...
summary.zh: 尼泊尔长期以来将水力发电作为经济增长优先事项的政策，正面临着由全球气温上升加剧的雪山河流潜在灾难性洪水的严峻挑战。8月26日的洪水破坏了国家电网约10%的装机容量，引发了关于是否应修改整体战略或采用更优化的发电厂的辩论。在此背景下，洪水可能危及该国的清洁能源目标，并促使其转向更多地依赖太阳能。

body.en: KATHMANDU — Nepal’s long-held policy of harnessing hydroelectricity and using it for economic growth has met new challenges: potential catastrophic floods in the snow-fed rivers amid rising global temperatures. The Aug. 26 floods that originated on the Nepal-China border, and which knocked out around 10% of installed power from the national grid, has prompted a debate on whether Nepal should rethink its overall strategy or just adopt better-engineered plants. Amid this, the flood could jeopardize the country’s clean energy targets and push it to adopt more solar power. Immediate impacts The flashflood crippled a combined installed generation capacity of 281 megawatts, including a solar power plant, and damaged four other under-construction projects, totaling a capacity of 700 MW. One of the oldest hydroelectric plants, the 14.1-MW Devighat Hydroelectric Plant, commissioned 42 years ago, was wiped out. Further downstream, the flood badly damaged a 25-MW solar power plant, according to data compiled by Mongabay from official sources. Similarly, with a hub of a transmission line washed away on the Trishuli River’s banks, another 150 MW of power from different power plants is cut off from the national grid system. Transmission lines, including a substation on the Trishuli riverbank, were also destroyed. While officials are assessing the damage, estimates put losses at hundreds of billions of Nepali rupees, according to media reports. They say they can’t yet provide timelines for when the affected projects will resume generation. Around 983 engineers and workers are feared trapped inside the tunnels or power houses and…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 加德满都——尼泊尔长期坚持的利用水力发电并利用水力促进经济增长的政策遇到了新的挑战：在全球气温上升的情况下，冰雪浇灌的河流可能会发生灾难性洪水。 8 月 26 日发生在尼泊尔和中国边境的洪水导致国家电网约 10% 的装机电力中断，引发了关于尼泊尔是否应该重新考虑其总体战略或只是采用设计更好的电厂的争论。其中，洪水可能会危及该国的清洁能源目标，并促使其采用更多的太阳能。直接影响 山洪导致总计 281 兆瓦的发电装机容量瘫痪，其中包括一座太阳能发电厂，并损坏了其他四个在建项目，总容量达 700 兆瓦。最古老的水力发电厂之一，14.1 兆瓦的 Devighat 水力发电厂，于 42 年前投入运行，现已被毁。根据 Mongabay 从官方来源收集的数据，在下游，洪水严重损坏了一座 25 兆瓦的太阳能发电厂。同样，随着 Trishuli 河岸的输电线路枢纽被冲走，来自不同发电厂的另外 150 兆瓦电力也被从国家电网系统中切断。包括特里苏里河岸上的变电站在内的输电线路也被摧毁。据媒体报道，官员们正在评估损失，估计损失达数千亿尼泊尔卢比。他们表示，目前还无法提供受影响项目何时恢复发电的时间表。大约 983 名工程师和工人担心被困在隧道或发电厂内……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The creation groans under the weight of human activity and a changing climate, as seen in Nepal's flood-ravaged hydropower infrastructure. This reminds us of our deep connection to the natural world and the urgent need for stewardship that respects its limits and fragility.
reflection.zh: 正如尼泊尔被洪水蹂躏的水电基础设施所见，受造界在人类活动和气候变化的重压下发出呻吟。这提醒我们与自然世界的深层联系，以及迫切需要一种尊重其局限性和脆弱性的管理方式。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Temperature check: alarm as prediction markets lean into weather and climate bets
title.zh: 温度检查：预测市场转向天气和气候赌注引发警报

summary.en: Climate experts are concerned that users of US prediction markets Kalshi and Polymarket are 'gamifying disasters' by placing bets on events such as heatwaves and daily temperatures. These markets, already active in sports, crypto, and politics, are now focusing on the planet's future livability, with Kalshi gaining...
summary.zh: 气候专家警告称，美国预测市场Kalshi和Polymarket的用户正在通过押注热浪和每日气温等事件来“游戏化灾难”。这些市场已在体育、加密货币和政治领域活跃，现在正将目光投向地球未来的宜居性，Kalshi已获得天气公司的数据访问权，以验证与天气相关的投注结果。

body.en: Climate experts warn that US Kalshi and Polymarket users are ‘gamifying disasters’ as they bet on events like heatwaves and daily temperatures Online prediction markets, saturated by money staked on sport, crypto and politics, have now set their sights on a promising new area of growth: betting on the future livability of the planet itself. The rise of gamified predictions on the unfolding climate crisis, and shorter-term weather forecasts, has been underscored by a new deal that allows Kalshi, a leading online financial exchange, to access data from the Weather Company, owner of the Weather Channel, to verify weather-related betting outcomes. Continue reading...
body.zh: 气候专家警告说，美国 Kalshi 和 Polymarket 用户在押注热浪和每日气温等事件时，正在“游戏化灾难”。在线预测市场因体育、加密货币和政治上的资金而饱和，现在将目光投向了一个充满希望的新增长领域：押注地球本身的未来宜居性。一项新协议凸显了对正在发生的气候危机和短期天气预报的游戏化预测的兴起，该协议允许领先的在线金融交易所 Kalshi 访问 Weather Channel 所有者 Weather Company 的数据，以验证与天气相关的投注结果。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news describes prediction markets where people bet on weather and climate events, a practice experts call 'gamifying disasters.' This mirrors the ancient story of the Tower of Babel, where human ambition sought to reach the heavens through unified, yet ultimately hubristic, effort. When our ingenuity is directed towards predicting or profiting from...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻描述了人们在预测市场上押注天气和气候事件，专家称之为“游戏化灾难”。这与古代巴别塔的故事如出一辙，当时人类的野心试图通过统一但最终傲慢的努力触及天堂。当我们 the ingenuity 转向预测或从潜在灾难中获利，而不是预防它们时，我们就有可能面临类似的跌落。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Data Centers are Helping Fuel a U.S. Battery Boom
title.zh: 数据中心正助力美国电池产业蓬勃发展

summary.en: Tech companies are facing criticism for powering new data centers with polluting gas generators. However, energy industry data reveals that alongside natural gas infrastructure, these firms are also investing heavily in battery storage solutions across the U.S.
summary.zh: 科技公司因使用污染性的燃气发电机为新建数据中心供电而面临批评。然而，能源行业数据显示，除了建设天然气基础设施外，这些公司还在美国各地大力投资电池储能解决方案。

body.en:
Across the U.S., tech companies have courted backlash for using polluting gas generators to power massive new data centers. But energy industry data shows that in addition to building out natural gas, firms are adding huge amounts of battery storage.

The energy demands of data centers are so great that large projects may need approval from regulators before connecting to the power grid. But instead of waiting for that approval, tech companies keen to build the infrastructure for A.I. are often building gas generators on site. By one estimate , more than 100 gigawatts of onsite gas power, the rough equivalent of 100 large gas power plants, is planned for data centers across the U.S.

To take full advantage of those gas generators, some companies are installing large lithium-ion batteries alongside, according to a new report from the Solar Energy Industries Association and Benchmark Mineral Intelligence. Batteries are also being employed in tandem with renewable energy.

The report finds that data centers accounted for 5 of the nearly 31 gigawatt-hours of battery capacity installed nationally in the first half of this year. Further, data centers accounted for 75 percent of the capacity installed at commercial or industrial sites. Looking ahead, analysts project that data center demand for batteries will grow fivefold by the end of this decade.

In some places, the A.I. boom is also spurring installations of home batteries, as data centers obtain permission to connect to the grid by funding the installation of batteries in nearby homes. Under such programs, homeowners agree to discharge their batteries to the grid as needed to meet spikes in demand. Analysts say that public outcry over the data center boom may push companies to fund home battery installations.

In a similar vein, some companies are looking to meet the energy needs of data centers by providing rooftop solar to surrounding households or paying to weatherize homes to curb power demand from heating and cooling.

New polling from the Yale Program on Climate Change Communication finds that 56 percent of Americans would oppose a new data center in their community, while just 15 percent would approve of one. At the same time, 73 percent of Americans support requiring new data centers to offset their electricity use by installing rooftop solar or weatherizing nearby homes.

In a recent interview with Yale Environment 360 , former Energy Department official Jigar Shah said that it may ultimately be cheaper for tech companies to weatherize homes than to install gas turbines on site, to say nothing of the impact on public opinion. “At the end of the day, these [companies] need public permission,” he said. He added, “Figuring out how to gain that permission I think is also something the data...
body.zh: 在美国各地，科技公司因使用污染气体发电机为大型新数据中心供电而招致强烈反对。但能源行业数据显示，除了建设天然气外，企业还增加了大量的电池存储。 数据中心的能源需求非常大，大型项目可能需要获得监管机构的批准才能连接到电网。但科技公司并没有等待批准，而是热衷于为人工智能建设基础设施。通常在现场建造气体发生器。据估计，美国各地的数据中心计划使用超过 100 吉瓦的现场天然气发电，相当于 100 座大型天然气发电厂。 根据太阳能产业协会和 Benchmark Mineral Intelligence 的一份新报告，为了充分利用这些气体发生器，一些公司正在同时安装大型锂离子电池。电池也与可再生能源一起使用。 报告发现，今年上半年全国安装的近31吉瓦时电池容量中，数据中心占了5个。此外，数据中心占商业或工业场所安装容量的 75%。展望未来，分析师预计，到本十年末，数据中心对电池的需求将增长五倍。 在某些地方，A.I.随着数据中心通过资助附近家庭安装电池获得连接电网的许可，热潮还刺激了家用电池的安装。根据此类计划，房主同意根据需要将电池放电到电网，以满足需求高峰。分析师表示，公众对数据中心繁荣的强烈抗议可能会促使公司为家用电池安装提供资金。 同样，一些公司希望通过向周围家庭提供屋顶太阳能或付费对房屋进行防风雨以抑制供暖和制冷的电力需求来满足数据中心的能源需求。 耶鲁大学气候变化交流项目的最新民意调查发现，56% 的美国人反对在他们的社区建立新的数据中心，而只有 15% 的人赞成建立一个数据中心。与此同时，73% 的美国人支持要求新建数据中心，通过安装屋顶太阳能或对附近房屋进行防风雨处理来抵消用电量。 在最近接受耶鲁环境 360 采访时，前能源部官员 Jigar Shah 表示，对于科技公司来说，对房屋进行防风雨改造最终可能比在现场安装燃气轮机更便宜，更不用说对公众舆论的影响了。 “归根结底，这些[公司]需要公众许可，”他说。他补充道，“我认为弄清楚如何获得许可也是数据的一部分......

reflection.en: The rapid growth of data centers, fueled by immense energy demands, presents a complex picture. While the use of gas generators raises environmental concerns, the simultaneous investment in battery storage shows a dual approach to powering this new technological frontier. It calls us to consider how our innovations impact the world God declared 'very good,'...
reflection.zh: 数据中心因巨大的能源需求而迅速增长，这呈现出一幅复杂的图景。虽然使用燃气发电机引发了环境担忧，但同时投资电池储能则显示出为这一新技术前沿供电的双重方法。这促使我们思考，我们的创新如何影响雅伟宣告为“甚好”的世界，并敦促我们负责任地管理。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: US woman gets 38 stitches after being bitten by otter in Lake Tahoe
title.zh: 美国女子在太浩湖遭水獭袭击缝38针

summary.en: A woman from Reno, Nevada, was swimming near Hidden Beach in Lake Tahoe when she was attacked by a river otter. The incident required her to receive 38 stitches for her wounds and also undergo rabies shots. This is the second such otter attack reported in the Tahoe area within the past month.
summary.zh: 内华达州太浩湖附近的一名雷诺女子在隐蔽海滩附近游泳时遭到一只河水獭袭击。她因此伤口缝了38针，并接受了狂犬病疫苗注射。这是该地区一个月内报道的第二起水獭袭击事件。

body.en: Woman from Reno was swimming near Hidden beach when river otter attacked her, Tahoe’s second incident in a month A swimmer at Lake Tahoe in Nevada was bitten by a river otter and needed to get 38 stitches for her wounds as well as rabies shots, local media have reported. Lynnette Bellin from Reno was swimming near Hidden beach on the Nevada side of the popular tourist attraction on Sunday when she was attacked by the creature. Continue reading...
body.zh: 据当地媒体报道，内华达州太浩湖的一名游泳者被水獭咬伤，伤口缝了 38 针，并注射了狂犬病疫苗。周日，来自里诺的琳内特·贝林(Lynnette Bellin)在热门旅游景点内华达州一侧的隐藏海滩附近游泳时遭到了这种生物的袭击。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Nature's beauty can sometimes hold unexpected dangers, as this swimmer discovered. While the attack was frightening and painful, the call to overcome evil with good, as described in Romans 12:21, can apply to how we process such events. It encourages a response that seeks healing and avoids bitterness, even when faced with harm.
reflection.zh: 正如这位游泳者所发现的，大自然的美丽有时也潜藏着意想不到的危险。虽然这次袭击令人恐惧且痛苦，但罗马书12:21所说的以善胜恶的呼召，可以应用于我们如何处理这些事件。它鼓励我们在遭受伤害时，也要寻求医治，避免心生怨恨。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Family pays tribute to New Mexico man killed by bear: ‘He was a strong person’

summary.en: Relatives of Benjamin Halona, a New Mexico man fatally mauled by a bear in his home, are choosing to remember his life as a wildlife firefighter and his dedication to selling tamales, rather than focusing on the brutal circumstances of his death. They wish to honor his quiet dignity, especially after becoming a...
summary.zh: 新墨西哥州男子本杰明·哈洛纳在家中遭熊袭击不幸身亡，其亲属选择铭记他作为野生动物消防员的职业生涯以及他热情售卖玉米卷饼的往事，而非聚焦于他死亡的残酷方式。亲属们希望在他成为鳏夫并随后面临需要借助助行器和轮椅才能活动的健康挑战后，能以他生前的沉静尊严来纪念他。

body.en: Relatives of Benjamin Halona remember his career as wildlife firefighter and his zeal for selling tamales Relatives of a New Mexico man who was fatally mauled by a bear inside his home recently say they are choosing to remember his firefighting career and zeal for peddling tamales rather than his rare, brutal manner of death. As Benjamin Halona’s sister, Gloria Halona, and her daughter, Samantha Vandever, put it, that is the least he deserved after the quiet dignity that he showed becoming a widower in February and subsequently grappling with health problems that required him to use a walker and a wheelchair to move around. Continue reading...
body.zh: 本杰明·哈罗纳 (Benjamin Halona) 的亲戚记得他作为野生动物消防员的职业生涯和他对出售玉米粉蒸肉的热情。最近，一名新墨西哥州男子在家中被熊咬伤致死，他的亲属表示，他们选择记住他的消防生涯和兜售玉米粉蒸肉的热情，而不是他罕见的、残酷的死亡方式。正如本杰明·哈洛纳 (Benjamin Halona) 的妹妹格洛丽亚·哈洛纳 (Gloria Halona) 和她的女儿萨曼莎·范德弗 (Samantha Vandever) 所说，这是他最起码应得的，因为他在二月份成为鳏夫，随后又因健康问题而不得不使用助行器和轮椅行走，表现出了安静的尊严。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of a sudden and violent end, Benjamin Halona's family seeks to honor his life by remembering his service and his efforts to provide. This desire to focus on good deeds and seek justice, even in grief, echoes the ancient call to 'learn to do good; seek justice, correct oppression.' May their remembrance bring comfort and a testament to a life...
reflection.zh: 面对突如其来且残酷的结局，本杰明·哈洛纳的家人试图通过铭记他生前的服务和他为生计所做的努力来纪念他。这种在悲痛中仍寻求关注善行和伸张正义的愿望，呼应了古老的呼召：“要学习行善，寻求公平，纠正压迫。”愿他们的追忆带来安慰，并成为他人生有意义的见证。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Suburban Sprawl Puts Western Homes at Risk from Wildfires
title.zh: 郊区扩张使西部房屋面临野火风险

summary.en: Recent fires in Spokane, Washington, and Reno, Nevada, highlight the dangers of suburban expansion into wildland areas, where homes built on the urban fringe are increasingly at risk from encroaching wildfires.
summary.zh: 近期在华盛顿州斯波坎和内华达州里诺发生的火灾，凸显了郊区扩张到荒野地区的危险，位于城市边缘的房屋正日益面临野火侵袭的风险。

body.en:
This article was originally published by Grist and is reproduced here as part of the Climate Desk collaboration.

Recent fires in Spokane, Washington, and Reno, Nevada, illustrate the risks from suburban sprawl, experts say. In both cities, encroaching flames burned homes built at the edge of wilderness.

Somersett, a short drive from downtown Reno, Nevada, is a peaceful place where homes with sweeping, high-desert views line cul-de-sacs and roads meander through shrubland, trailheads, and golf courses. But in the summer, months of low humidity and hot weather prime the landscape to burn. On the morning of August 22, it did.

In just a few days, strong winds carried the flames of the Hawk Fire more than 23 miles, placing some 90,000 people on evacuation notice as dense smoke and orange skies blanketed the city. By Wednesday, dozens of houses had been destroyed. Two weeks earlier, the Bug Fire burned 150 square miles just north of the same area.

It’s the latest in an era of worsening wildfires in the United States, where more than 7.9 million acres have burned this year. A similar story is playing out in Canada, where First Nations and residents of Ontario have borne the brunt of more than 5,100 fires across the country. Scientists say climate change has made these fires, along with others in Europe, significantly more likely to happen. This year’s blazes in the western U.S. were exacerbated by record-low winter snowfall, depriving the landscape of the moisture that typically seeps from snowpack throughout the summer, and by extreme and long-lasting heat waves that baked the landscape.

And the fires have highlighted another, deadly piece of the puzzle: suburban sprawl.

“What’s happened over the last decades is we’ve had explosive population growth in naturally fire-prone areas,” said Tim Brown, director of the Western Regional Climate Center at the Desert Research Institute in Nevada. “People are moving in to where fire happens.”

The wildland-urban interface, which researchers often call the WUI, is the phrase given to places where housing is sandwiched between paved city centers and forests or grasslands. Researchers have been raising the alarm about the fire risk posed to homes in these areas since the 1980s. As humans burn more fossil fuels and warm the planet, longer and more severe droughts will likely make that risk worse. Reno is the fastest warming city in the U.S., according to the nonprofit Climate Central.

These half-wild, half-suburban neighborhoods remain one of the most rapidly growing types of land in the country, although development has slowed compared to the surge between the 1990s and 2010s. In some places, housing scarcity in cities has pushed home buyers to the outskirts of towns, where building is generally cheaper and...
body.zh: 本文最初由 Grist 发表，并作为气候台合作的一部分转载于此。 专家表示，华盛顿州斯波坎和内华达州里诺最近发生的火灾凸显了郊区扩张的风险。在这两个城市，蔓延的火焰烧毁了建在荒野边缘的房屋。 萨默塞特距离内华达州里诺市中心仅很短的车程，是一个宁静的地方，这里的房屋坐落在死胡同中，可欣赏一览无余的高沙漠景色，道路蜿蜒穿过灌木丛、步道入口和高尔夫球场。但在夏季，几个月的低湿度和炎热的天气很容易导致土地燃烧。 8月22日上午，事情果然发生了。 短短几天内，强风将霍克大火的火焰吹了超过 23 英里，浓烟和橙色天空笼罩了整个城市，导致约 9 万人接到疏散通知。到周三，已有数十栋房屋被毁。两周前，虫火在同一地区北部燃烧了 150 平方英里。 这是美国山火不断恶化的最新情况，今年美国的火灾面积已超过 790 万英亩。类似的故事也在加拿大上演，原住民和安大略省的居民在全国范围内发生了 5,100 多起火灾中首当其冲。科学家表示，气候变化使得这些火灾以及欧洲的其他火灾发生的可能性大大增加。今年美国西部的大火因冬季降雪量创历史新低而加剧，导致整个夏季的积雪失去了通常从积雪中渗出的水分，而且极端而持久的热浪烘烤了大地。 火灾凸显了另一个致命的难题：郊区扩张。 内华达州沙漠研究所西部区域气候中心主任蒂姆·布朗说：“过去几十年来，自然火灾多发地区的人口出现爆炸性增长。” “人们正在搬到发生火灾的地方。” 研究人员通常将荒地与城市界面称为“WUI”，这个短语指的是住房夹在铺好的城市中心和森林或草地之间的地方。自 20 世纪 80 年代以来，研究人员一直对这些地区的房屋火灾风险发出警报。随着人类燃烧更多的化石燃料并使地球变暖，更长时间、更严重的干旱可能会使这种风险变得更加严重。据非营利组织气候中心称，里诺是美国变暖最快的城市。 这些半野生、半郊区的社区仍然是该国增长最快的土地类型之一，尽管与 20 世纪 90 年代至 2010 年代的激增相比，开发速度有所放缓。在一些地方，城市住房稀缺迫使购房者前往城镇郊区，那里的建筑通常更便宜，而且......

reflection.en: The expansion of human settlements into natural landscapes, as seen in Spokane and Reno, brings with it inherent risks. The earth itself seems to groan under the pressure of development, with wildlands becoming tinderboxes and homes caught in the crossfire. This situation calls us to consider our stewardship of creation and the unintended consequences of...
reflection.zh: 人类聚居地向自然景观的扩张，如在斯波坎和里诺所见，带来了固有的风险。大地本身似乎在发展的压力下呻吟，野地变成了火药桶，房屋则卷入了战火。这种情况促使我们反思我们对受造界的管理以及我们选择所带来的意想不到的后果。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

Since it premiered just over a year ago at last year’s Telluride Film Festival , mainstream distributors and streamers wouldn’t touch the documentary “ Ask E. Jean ,” which profiles advice columnist E. Jean Carroll amid her legal battle for defamation with President Trump. The film ‘s director Ivy Meeropol outwardly has blamed “The Trump Effect” for why buyers have “ghosted” her in getting the film released. So Meeropol has turned to some unconventional measures.

Over the last several months, “Ask E. Jean” has played in over 100 theaters across the country and sold out New York’s IFC Center, leading to a five-week engagement of the film in NY, as well as additional screenings in over 90 cities and 30 states. The audience demand has been there, even if other distributors have feared the commercial prospects of a political documentary or quite simply feared retribution from the Trump administration. But it has done so via the joint efforts of five different companies whom have all come together to help distribute it through more grassroots means: Impact Partners, which helped produce and finance “Ask E. Jean,” Theorem Media, an indie film distribution studio, took on the non theatrical and eventized theatrical distribution and organic social, Roco Films, which has led educational access for schools, colleges, and students, Abramorama , which handled the physical theatrical distribution, and Kinema , which is a platform that gives communities the means to host their own screenings and viewing parties . The companies don’t normally release films together, but this one was special.

Now, all five of those collaborators are again teaming up to finally bring “Ask E. Jean” to streaming on Kinema, where it has just launched today , September 2, for a premium video on demand window, IndieWire can reveal exclusively. The film is available for digital rental for $8.99 via Kinema, and it is continuing its theatrical run as well.

Jean" faced significant hurdles in distribution, with major platforms reportedly shying away due to the subject matter involving a legal battle with a prominent political figure. This situation underscores how fear or perceived risk can lead to the suppression or avoidance of certain narratives, even when they are of public interest....
